body.translated_text: (AVParis_32,10) [The group] for splendor: 'Those who are thrice seven,' 'In this one, wealth,' 'At dawn, Agni,' 'Elephant-splendor,' 'In the lion, in the tiger,' 'Glory,' 'The oblation,' 'For me, Indra,' 'On the mountain,' 'In the Aragarāṭas,' 'As Soma,' 'In the morning pressing,' 'And whatever splendor,' 'In dice,' 'By which,' 'Great,' 'Of the unslaughtered cow,' 'The hip' — [these are] the splendor-giving [hymns]. Thus [ends] the Splendor-group (<s>varcasya-gaṇa</s>).

body.text: (AVParis_32,11) svastyayano amūḥ pāre pātaṃ na indrāpūṣaṇā tvaṣṭā me daivyaṃ yena soma namo devavadhebhyo 'bhayaṃ mitrāvaruṇāv upa prāgāt sahasrākṣo 'namitraṃ no adharād yamomṛtyur bṛhaspatir naḥ pari pātu tyam ū ṣu trātāram indraḥ sutrāmā sa sutrāmā ā mandrair indra marmāṇi te varma me dyāvāpṛthivī aindrāgnaṃ varma girayas te yat te madhyaṃ yās te prācīr mā naḥ paścād iti svastyayanāni || iti svastyayanagaṇaḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_32,11) [The group] for safe journey: 'Those [stars] beyond,' 'Protect us, Indra and Pūṣan,' 'Tvaṣṭar, my divine,' 'By which, O Soma,' 'Salutation to the divine weapons,' 'Fearlessness,' 'Mitra and Varuṇa,' 'Come forward,' 'The thousand-eyed,' 'Without enemies,' 'For us from below,' 'Yama, Death,' 'Bṛhaspati for us,' 'Protect,' 'That one indeed,' 'The protector,' 'Indra, the well-protecting,' 'He, the well-protecting,' 'With sweet [hymns], O Indra,' 'Your vital points,' 'Armor for me,' 'Heaven and Earth,' 'The Aindrāgna armor,' 'The mountains for you,' 'What is your middle,' 'What are your eastern,' 'Not us from behind' — [these are] the safe-journey [hymns]. Thus [ends] the Safe-journey-group (<s>svastyayana-gaṇa</s>).

body.text: (AVParis_32,12) abhayaḥ svastidā viśāṃ brāhmaṇena paryuktāsi na tā arvā reṇukakāṭo abhayaṃ mitrāvaruṇāv abhayaṃ dyāvāpṛthivī asmai grāmāya hataṃ tardaṃ pūṣemā āśā indraḥ sutrāmā maitaṃ panthāṃ svastidā viśāṃ patir nama te ghoṣiṇībhya ā te rāṣṭram idam uc chreyo yata indra bhayāmaha ity abhayāni || ity abhayagaṇaḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_32,12) [The group] for fearlessness: 'Blessings-giving to the people,' 'By the Brāhmaṇa you are surrounded,' 'Not they, the near,' 'Reṇukakāṭa,' 'Fearlessness, Mitra and Varuṇa,' 'Fearlessness, Heaven and Earth,' 'For this village,' 'Slay the Tarda,' 'Pūṣan, these directions,' 'Indra, the well-protecting,' 'May this [road],' 'Blessings-giving to the people,' 'Lord,' 'Salutation to the loud-sounding ones,' 'To you, the kingdom,' 'This [goes] up for betterment,' 'From which, O Indra, we fear' — [these are] the fearlessness [hymns]. Thus [ends] the Fearlessness-group (<s>abhaya-gaṇa</s>).

body.text: (AVParis_32,13) aparājito vidmā śarasya mā no cidann adārasṛt svastidā saṃśitaṃ me tvayā manyo yas te manyo etā devasenā avamanyur nirhastaḥ pari vartmāny abhibhūr indro jāyaty abhi tvendrety aparājitāni || ity aparājitagaṇaḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_32,13) [The group] for invincibility: 'We know the arrow,' 'Let not our food,' 'The non-shattering,' 'Blessings-giving,' 'Sharpened for me,' 'By you, O Manyu,' 'O Manyu, you who,' 'These divine armies,' 'Avamanyu,' 'Unarmed,' 'Around the tracks,' 'The overpowering one,' 'Indra is born,' 'Over you, Indra' — [these are] the invincibility [hymns]. Thus [ends] the Invincibility-group (<s>aparājita-gaṇa</s>).

body.text: (AVParis_32,14) śarmavarmā yaḥ sapatna itaś ca yad amutaś cāpendra dviṣato yūyaṃ naḥ pravata imam agna āyuṣe tisro devīr uruvyacā no indrasya śarmāsīti uttamāṃ varjayitvā yena devā asurāṇām anaḍudbhyas tvam iti dve tanūṣ ṭe vājin vājasya nu prasave devānāṃ patnīr adhi brūhi rakṣohaṇaṃ vājinaṃ ye srāktyaṃ varma me dyāvāpṛṭhivī aindrāgnaṃ varma bahulaṃ varma mahyam ayaṃ mitraḥ pṛthivyod akrāmad aspatnaṃ purastād iti śarmavarmā || iti śarmavarmā gaṇaḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_32,14) [The group] for shelter and armor: 'Who is a rival,' 'From here and,' 'From there,' 'O Indra, of haters,' 'You for us,' 'Forward, this one,' 'O Agni, for life,' 'Three goddesses,' 'Wide-extending,' 'For us, Indra's shelter' — omitting the last; 'By which the gods,' 'Of the Asuras,' 'From bulls,' 'Your' — two; 'Body for you, O Steed,' 'Of vitality, now,' 'In the impulse of the gods,' 'Wives of the gods,' 'Speak above,' 'The demon-slaying,' 'Victorious steed,' 'Which [is] Srāktya,' 'Armor for me, Heaven and Earth,' 'The Aindrāgna armor,' 'Abundant armor for me,' 'This Mitra,' 'From earth he stepped forth,' 'Without rivals,' 'From in front' — [this is] the Shelter-and-Armor [group]. Thus [ends] the Shelter-and-Armor-group (<s>śarmavarmā-gaṇa</s>).

body.text: (AVParis_32,15) devapurā ye purastād brahma jajñānaṃ sahasradhāra evāgnir mā pātu agniṃ te vasuvantaṃ mitraḥ pṛthivyod akrāmad apa ny adhuḥ pauruṣeyaṃ vadhaṃ jitam asmākam iti devapurīyaḥ || iti devapurīyagaṇaḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_32,15) [The group] for the divine fortress: 'Those in front,' 'Brahman was born,' 'Thousand-streamed,' 'Thus Agni protect me,' 'Agni for you, possessing wealth,' 'Mitra from earth stepped forth,' 'They drove away the human weapon,' 'Conquered, ours' — [this is] the divine-fortress [group]. Thus [ends] the Divine-fortress-group (<s>devapurīya-gaṇa</s>).

body.text: (AVParis_32,16) rudro ye 'syāṃ prācī dig itirudragaṇaḥ || iti rudragaṇaḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_32,16) [The] Rudra[-group]: 'Those who in this eastern direction' — [this is] the Rudra-group. Thus [ends] the Rudra-group (<s>rudra-gaṇa</s>).

body.text: (AVParis_32,17) raudro rudra jalāṣabheṣaja ye 'syāṃ prācī dig ud itas trayo akraman bhavāśarvau manve vāṃ brahma jajñānam anāptā ye sahasradhāra eva grīṣmo hemanto anaḍudbhyas tvaṃ mahyam āpo vaiśvānaro yamo mṛtyur yāṃ te rudra yo agnau rudro bhavāśarvau mṛḍataṃ bhavāśarvāv idaṃ brūmo yas te sarpo vṛścikas tasmai prācyā diśo antardeśād iti raudragaṇaḥ || iti raudragaṇaḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_32,17) [The] Raudra[-group]: 'Rudra,' 'Water-medicine,' 'Those in this eastern direction,' 'From here, three stepped forth,' 'Bhava and Śarva,' 'I consider you two,' 'Brahman was born,' 'Unobtained,' 'Those who,' 'Thousand-streamed,' 'Thus,' 'Summer, winter,' 'From bulls, your,' 'Great, waters,' 'Vaiśvānara,' 'Yama, Death,' 'Your Rudra,' 'Who in fire,' 'Rudra,' 'Bhava and Śarva, be gracious,' 'Bhava and Śarva, this we declare,' 'Your serpent,' 'The scorpion,' 'To him, from the eastern direction and the inner region' — [this is] the Raudra-group. Thus [ends] the Raudra-group (<s>raudra-gaṇa</s>).

body.text: (AVParis_32,18) citrāgaṇo mā no vidann adārasṛt svastidā viśām amūhoāre aghadviṣṭā agne yat te tapa iti pañca sūktāni rudra jalāṣabheṣaja ye 'syāṃ prācī dig vi devā uta devā agner manva itiprabhṛtīni mṛgārasūktāny uttamaṃ varjayitvāpa naḥ śośucad aghaṃ pṛthivyām agnaye mamāgne vrahma jajñānam anāptā ye sahasradhāre savitā prasavānāṃ nava prāṇān pātaṃ nas tvaṣṭā me yena soma namo devavadhebhyo 'bhayaṃ mitrāvaruṇāv upa prāgāt sahasrākṣaḥ siṃhe vyāghre 'bhayaṃ dyāvāpṛthivī grīṣmo hemanto 'naḍudbhyas tvaṃ mahyam āpo vaiśvānaro yamo mṛtyur abhi tvendra viśvajit trāyamāṇāyai imaṃ me agne viṣāṇā pāśān śakadhūmaṃ somārudreti dve bṛhaspatir nas tyam ū ṣu trātāram indraḥ sutrāmā ā mandrair indra marmāṇi te antakāya mṛtyavā ā rabhasvāyaṃ pratisaro 'yaṃ me varaṇo bhavāśarvau mṛḍataṃ prāṇāya namo 'gniṃ brūma ity arthasūktaṃ satyaṃ bṛhad iti dve prathame girayas te yat te madhyaṃ yās te prācīr mā naḥ paścād grīṣmas te bhūme varṣāṇy upasthās te bhūme mātaḥ sahasraśṛṅgo vṛṣabho jātavedā mā pra gāma patho yo yajñasya tasmai prācyā diśo antardeśād iti paryāyaś citrāgaṇaḥ || iti citrāgaṇaḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_32,18) [The] Citrā[-group]: 'Let not our food,' 'The non-shattering,' 'Blessings-giving to the people,' 'Those beyond,' 'Evil-hating,' 'O Agni, that fire of yours' — five hymns; 'Rudra, water-medicine,' 'Those in this eastern direction,' 'Apart, the gods,' 'And the gods,' 'Of Agni,' 'From Manyu' and so forth — the Mṛgāra hymns, omitting the last; 'Remove from us the blazing evil,' 'Of Earth,' 'For Agni,' 'My, O Agni,' 'Brahman was born,' 'Unobtained,' 'Those who,' 'Thousand-streamed,' 'Thus,' 'Of Savitṛ, of the impulses,' 'Nine life-breaths,' 'Protect us,' 'Tvaṣṭar, my,' 'By which, O Soma,' 'Salutation to divine weapons,' 'Fearlessness, Mitra and Varuṇa,' 'Come forward,' 'Thousand-eyed,' 'In the lion, in the tiger,' 'Fearlessness, Heaven and Earth,' 'Summer, winter,' 'From bulls, your,' 'Great, waters,' 'Vaiśvānara,' 'Yama, Death,' 'Over you, Indra,' 'All-conquering,' 'The protecting,' 'This to me,' 'O Agni,' 'Horn,' 'Bonds,' 'The Śakadh,' 'Soma-Rudra' — two; 'Bṛhaspati for us,' 'That one indeed,' 'The protector,' 'Indra the well-protecting,' 'With sweet [hymns], O Indra,' 'Your vital points,' 'For Death, for Death,' 'Take hold,' 'This amulet-cord,' 'This Varaṇa for me,' 'Bhava and Śarva, be gracious,' 'To life-breath, salutation,' 'We declare Agni' — the Purpose-hymn; 'Truth, great' — two, the first [sections]; 'The mountains for you,' 'What is your middle,' 'What are your eastern,' 'Not us from behind,' 'Summer for you, O Earth,' 'The rains,' 'Your lap, O Earth,' 'Mother,' 'Thousand-horned bull,' 'Jātavedas,' 'May we not go from the path,' 'Who of the sacrifice,' 'To him, from the eastern direction and the inner region' — [this] section [is] the Citrā-group. Thus [ends] the Citrā-group (<s>citrā-gaṇa</s>).

body.text: (AVParis_32,19) patnīvanto aditir dyauḥ sinīvāli kuhūṃ devīm iti trīṇi sūktāni patnīvantaḥ || iti patnīvantagaṇaḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_32,19) [The group bearing] wives: 'Aditi,' 'The sky,' 'Sinīvālī,' 'The goddess Kuhū' — three hymns [constitute] the Wives-bearing [group]. Thus [ends] the Wives-bearing-group (<s>patnīvanta-gaṇa</s>).

body.text: (AVParis_32,19b) svasti mātra indra juṣasvāyā viṣṭhā śive te stāṃ pādābhyāṃ te saṃ te śirṣṇo vatso virāja ity ekā uccā patantam iti dve bhūyān indro viṣāsahiṃ sahamānam ity ādityagaṇaḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_32,19b) 'Auspicious to the mother,' 'Indra, enjoy this,' 'Come,' 'Dwelling,' 'Auspicious be your two feet,' 'Union for your head,' 'The calf of Virāj' — one; 'Flying high' — two; 'Greater, Indra,' 'O Vanquisher, conquering' — [this is] the Āditya-group (<s>āditya-gaṇa</s>).

body.text: (AVParis_32,20) śaṃ no devī śaṃ na indrāgnī śaṃ no vāto vātu śāntā dyauḥ pippalādiśāntigaṇaḥ || iti pippalā[di]śāntigaṇaḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_32,20) 'Auspicious to us, O Goddess,' 'Auspicious to us, Indra and Agni,' 'May the wind blow us auspiciousness,' 'Peaceful is the sky' — [this is] the <s>Pippalādi</s> Peace-group. Thus [ends] the <s>Pippalādi</s> Peace-group (<s>pippalādi-śānti-gaṇa</s>).

body.text: (AVParis_32,21) gane yad iti pañca sūktāni pañcāpatyāni bhavanti pāñcajanyāni bhavanti pāñcāpatyo gaṇaḥ || iti pañcāpatyagaṇaḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_32,21) 'In the troop, that' — five hymns [which] become the five-offspring ones, become the belonging-to-five-peoples; [this is] the Five-offspring-group. Thus [ends] the Five-offspring-group (<s>pañcāpatya-gaṇa</s>).

body.text: (AVParis_32,22) ambayo yanti śambhumayobhubhyāṃ brahma jajñānam asya vāmasya yo rohita ud asya krtavo mūrdhāham iti dve sūkte viṣāsahim iti salilagaṇaḥ || iti salilagaṇaḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_32,22) 'The mothers go,' 'Auspicious, bliss-giving' — the two; 'Brahman was born,' 'Of this lovely one,' 'Who is Rohita,' 'Up, of this,' 'Deeds,' 'Head, I' — the two hymns; 'The Vanquisher' — [this is] the Water-group. Thus [ends] the Water-group (<s>salila-gaṇa</s>).

body.text: (AVParis_32,23) ye triṣaptā iti viśvakarmā gaṇaḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_32,23) 'Those who are thrice-seven' — [this is] the <s>Viśvakarman</s>-group.

body.text: (AVParis_32,24) aghadviṣṭā devajātā śaṃ no devī varaṇo vārayā[tai] pippalī vidradhasya yā babhrava iti gaṇakarmā gaṇo bhaisajyaś ca bhavati || iti bhaiṣajyagaṇaḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_32,24) 'Evil-hating,' 'God-born,' 'Auspicious to us, O Goddess,' 'The Varaṇa repels,' 'Pippalī,' 'Of abscess,' 'Those which are tawny' — [this is] the group for general ritual work, and it is also medicinal. Thus [ends] the Healing-group (<s>bhaiṣajya-gaṇa</s>).

body.text: (AVParis_32,25) ayaṃ te yonir ā no bhara dhītī vā ya ity arthasūktam utthāpano gaṇaḥ || ity utthāpanagaṇaḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_32,25) 'This is your womb,' 'Bring to us,' 'Of wisdom,' 'Or which' — the Purpose-hymn; [this is] the Raising-up-group. Thus [ends] the Raising-up-group (<s>utthāpana-gaṇa</s>).

body.text: (AVParis_32,26) ambayo yanti śambhumayobhū hiraṇyavarṇā niḥsālāṃ ye agnayo brahma jajñānam ity ekaita devā mṛgārasūktāny uttamaṃ varjayitvāpa naḥ śośucad aghaṃ punantu mā sasruṣīr himavataḥ pra sravanti vāyog pūtaḥ pavitreṇa śaṃ ca no mayaś ca no 'naḍudbhyas tvaṃ mahyam āpo vaiśvānaro raśmibhir yamo mṛtyur viśvajit saṃjñānaṃ no yady antarikṣe punar maitv indriyaṃ śivā naḥ śaṃ no vāto vātu agniṃ brūmo vanaspatīn iti śāntigaṇaḥ || iti sarvaiḥ sūktaiḥ kauśikoktabṛhacchāntigaṇaḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_32,26) 'The mothers go,' 'Auspicious, bliss-giving,' 'Golden-hued,' 'Out of the house,' 'Those Agnis,' 'Brahman was born' — one; 'These gods,' the Mṛgāra hymns omitting the last; 'Remove from us the blazing evil,' 'May they purify me,' 'Flowing from the Himavat,' 'Forth they flow,' 'Purified by Vāyu,' 'With the purifier,' 'Auspicious and blissful for us,' 'From bulls, your,' 'Great, waters,' 'Vaiśvānara,' 'With rays,' 'Yama, Death,' 'All-conquering,' 'Agreement,' 'For us, if,' 'In the atmosphere,' 'Again may the faculty come,' 'Auspicious for us,' 'May the wind blow auspiciousness,' 'We declare Agni,' 'The lords of the forest' — [this is] the Peace-group. Thus, with all [these] hymns, [ends] the Great Peace-group as stated by <s>Kauśika</s> (<s>kauśikokta-bṛhacchānti-gaṇa</s>).

body.text: (AVParis_32,27) ambayo yanti śambhumayobhū hiraṇyavarṇā uta devā yady antarikṣe punar naitv indriyaṃ śivā naḥ śaṃ no vāto vātv agniṃ brūmo vanaspatīn iti śāntātīyo laghuśāntigaṇaḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_32,27) 'The mothers go,' 'Auspicious, bliss-giving,' 'Golden-hued,' 'And the gods,' 'If in the atmosphere,' 'Again may the faculty not [depart],' 'Auspicious for us,' 'May the wind blow auspiciousness,' 'We declare Agni,' 'The lords of the forest' — [this is] the Abridged Peace-group following the <s>Śāntātīya</s> (<s>laghu-śānti-gaṇa</s>).

body.text: (AVParis_32,28) ye triṣaptā mamāgne varcaḥ prātar agniṃ girāv aragarāṭeṣu divas pṛthivyā hastivarcasaṃ siṃhe vyāghre yaśo havir yas te gandha iti tisṛbhir varcasyagaṇaḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_32,28) 'Those who are thrice-seven,' 'My, O Agni, splendor,' 'At dawn, Agni,' 'On the mountain,' 'In the Aragarāṭas,' 'Of heaven,' 'Of earth,' 'Elephant-splendor,' 'In the lion, in the tiger,' 'Glory,' 'The oblation,' 'Your fragrance' — with three [verses], [this is] the Splendor-group (<s>varcasya-gaṇa</s>).

body.text: (AVParis_32,29) yā asurā manuṣyā mā no vidan namo devavadhebhya ity abhayagaṇaḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_32,29) 'Those Asuras,' 'Humans,' 'Let not our [food],' 'Salutation to the divine weapons' — [this is] the Fearlessness-group (<s>abhaya-gaṇa</s>).

body.text: (AVParis_32,30) bhūto bhūteṣv iti rājānam abhiṣekagaṇaḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_32,30) 'Existing among beings' — [this is] the Royal-consecration-group for the king (<s>abhiṣeka-gaṇa</s>).

body.text: (AVParis_32,31) [ya] āśānām āśāpālebhyo agner manva iti sapta sūktāni yā oṣadhayaḥ somarājñīr vaiśvānaro na ā gamac chumbhanī dyāvāpṛthivī yad arvācī[na]m agniṃ brūmo vanaspatīn iti muñcantu nā bhavāśārvā yā devīr yan mātalī rathakrītam ity etāś catasro varjayitvā aṃholiṅgagaṇaḥ ||
body.translated_text: For the guardians of the directions, to the protectors of the directions — 'Of <s>Agni</s>, the descendant of <s>Manu</s>' — these seven <s>sūkta</s>s; 'The herbs that have <s>Soma</s> as king,' '<s>Vaiśvānara</s> has come to us,' 'The purifying one,' 'Heaven and Earth,' 'Whatever is near,' 'We declare <s>Agni</s>, the trees' — these [and] 'May they release us,' '<s>Bhava</s> and <s>Śarva</s>,' 'The divine ones,' 'What <s>Mātali</s> purchased with a chariot' — excluding these four, [this is] the group of inauspicious-sign [hymns].

body.text:
(Pariśiṣṭa_33. ghṛtakambalam)
(AVParis_33,1.1) oṃ brahmaṇe brahmavedāya namaskṛtvā svayaṃbhuve | ghṛtakambalaṃ pravakṣyāmi brahmaṇo nigado yathā ||
body.translated_text: (<s>Pariśiṣṭa</s> 33. The <s>Ghṛtakambala</s>) Oṃ. Having saluted the self-born <s>Brahman</s>, the knower of the <s>Brahmaveda</s>, I shall expound the <s>Ghṛtakambala</s> (ghee-blanket rite), as per the instruction of <s>Brahman</s>.

body.text: (AVParis_33,1.2) bṛhaspatir mahendrāya cakāra ghṛtakambalam ||
body.translated_text: <s>Bṛhaspati</s> performed the <s>Ghṛtakambala</s> for the great <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: (AVParis_33,1.13) athendro ha vā asuraiḥ parājitaś cintām āpede
children.translated_text: Now then, <s>Indra</s>, having been defeated by the <s>Asura</s>s, fell into anxiety.

children.text: (AVParis_33,1.4) taṃ savitābravīt prāyaścittaṃ kuruṣvāpratiruddho bhaviṣyasīti
children.translated_text: <s>Savitṛ</s> said to him: 'Perform the expiation (<s>prāyaścitta</s>); you shall become unobstructed.'

children.text: (AVParis_33,1.5) tam indro 'bravīt || bhagavan tvam evāpratiruddhaḥ prāyaścittaṃ kurv iti ||
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s> said to him: 'O blessed one, you yourself [being] unobstructed — perform the expiation.'

body.text:
(AVParis_33,1.6) sa prāyaścittam akarot
(AVParis_33,1.7) puṇye nakṣatre bārhaspatye muhūrte 'bhijity audumbaraṃ kumbhaṃ droṇena sāḍhakena pūrayitvā tasminn eva vāsaprabhṛtayaḥ oṣadhayo darbhaprabhṛtayaś ca bilvagaurasarṣapāś cety etān saṃbhārān saṃbhṛtya ghṛtakumbhaṃ barhiṣy ādhāyaitair gaṇair ājyaṃ juhuyāt ||
body.translated_text: He performed the expiation: On an auspicious <s>nakṣatra</s>, at the <s>muhūrta</s> of <s>Bṛhaspati</s>, under <s>Abhijit</s>, having filled an <s>udumbara</s> (fig-wood) jar with a <s>droṇa</s> and a half, [placing] in it herbs beginning with garments, and those beginning with <s>darbha</s> grass, and <s>bilva</s> (wood-apple), white mustard seeds — having gathered these materials, having placed the ghee-jar on the <s>barhis</s> (sacred grass), he should offer ghee with these hymn-groups.

body.text: (AVParis_33,1.8) pra pateta ity ekenāṅgādaṅgāc chamalam avalikhya sapatnaṃ bhrātṛvyaṃ hṛdaye imarmaṇi vāsināvidhya gomayena kāṣāyeṇa vācchādya śānter apratighātakaṃ karma tato jyeṣṭhaṃ ghṛtakambalaṃ brahmaṇaḥ putram akarot

children.text: (AVParis_33,1.9) tasya ha vā etasya ghṛtakambalasya sāvitrīgaṇaśarīrasya śantātīyaḥ śiraḥ triṣaptīyo mukhaṃ rudraraudrau cakṣuṣī ghṛtaliṅga āsyaṃ nairṛto jihvā dantoṣṭhāv abhayāparājitau kṛtyādūṣaṇacātanau śrotre śarmavarmasvastyayanau bāhū mātṛnāmavāṣṭoṣpatyau pādau....pāyuś ca bhaiṣajyaṃ nyāyaḥ prāṇāpānāv iti mīmāṃsata ity
children.translated_text: Of this <s>Ghṛtakambala</s>, whose body is the <s>Sāvitrī</s> hymn-group — the <s>Śantātīya</s> is the head, the <s>Triṣaptīya</s> the face, the two <s>Raudra</s>s (of <s>Rudra</s>) the eyes, the <s>Ghṛtaliṅga</s> the mouth, the <s>Nairṛta</s> the tongue, the <s>Abhaya</s> and <s>Aparājita</s> the teeth and lips, the <s>Kṛtyādūṣaṇa</s> and <s>Cātana</s> the ears, the <s>Śarmavarma</s> and <s>Svastyayana</s> the arms, the <s>Mātṛnāma</s> and <s>Vāṣṭoṣpatya</s> the feet... the <s>Bhaiṣajya</s> the posterior, the <s>Nyāya</s> the <s>prāṇa</s> and <s>apāna</s> (vital breaths) — thus they deliberate.

children.text: (AVParis_33,1.10) eṣa ha vai jyeṣṭho ghṛtakambalo brahmaṇaḥ putro 'parājitagaṇeneṣṭvendro 'surān ajayan mṛtyum alakṣmīm arātiṃ duḥsvapnadurbhūtāny ajayad
children.translated_text: This indeed is the eldest <s>Ghṛtakambala</s>, the son of <s>Brahman</s>; having sacrificed with the <s>Aparājita</s> (invincible) hymn-group, <s>Indra</s> conquered the <s>Asura</s>s, conquered death, ill-fortune, hostility, bad dreams, and evil portents.

children.text: (AVParis_33,1.11) yathā caivaṃvidvān ghṛtakambalaṃ kurute sarvakāmān āpnoti sarvavyādhirahito bhavati brahmalokam avāpnotīti brāhmaṇam ||
children.translated_text: And he who, knowing thus, performs the <s>Ghṛtakambala</s> obtains all desires, becomes free from all diseases, and attains the world of <s>Brahman</s> — thus the <s>Brāhmaṇa</s> (scriptural commentary).

body.translated_text: 'Let it fly forth' — with one [verse], scraping impurity from limb to limb, piercing the enemy-rival in the heart or vital spot with a needle, covering with cow-dung and saffron-dye — thus the <s>śānti</s> (pacification) rite that is irresistible — then he made the <s>Ghṛtakambala</s>, the eldest, the son of <s>Brahman</s>.

body.text: (AVParis_33,2.1) yadā sarvam idaṃ vyāptam asurair nāvaśeṣitam | sthātuṃ devāḥ parābhūtās te 'tharvāṇam upāgatāḥ ||
body.translated_text: When all this was pervaded by the <s>Asura</s>s, with nothing remaining, the gods, being overpowered, unable to stand — they approached <s>Atharvā</s>.

body.text: (AVParis_33,2.2) karmādy ekaṃ kuruṣva tvaṃ yad bhṛgvaṅgirasor matam | asurāṇāṃ vadhārthāyety uktaḥ kartātha so 'bhavat ||
body.translated_text: 'Perform one primary rite, which is approved by <s>Bhṛgu</s> and <s>Aṅgiras</s>, for the destruction of the <s>Asura</s>s' — thus told, he became the performer.

body.text: (AVParis_33,2.3) paracakropasṛṣṭasya rājño vijayam icchataḥ | pratiruddhasya vā bhūyaḥ śrīkāmasyecchataḥ śriyam ||
body.translated_text: For a king beset by a hostile army and desiring victory, or one who is obstructed and again desirous of prosperity, desiring fortune —

body.text: (AVParis_33,2.4) prādurbhāvādbhutānāṃ ca grahāṇāṃ vigrahe tathā | śaṅkamāno 'bhicārād vā kārayed ghṛtakambalam ||
body.translated_text: At the appearance of portents, in the conflict of planets likewise, or one suspecting sorcery — he should have the <s>Ghṛtakambala</s> performed.

body.text: (AVParis_33,2.5) ghṛtamātrā tu vijñeyā māgadhaprasthasaṃmitā | śatāni pañca droṇānāṃ palaikaśatam eva vā ||
body.translated_text: The measure of ghee should be known as measured by the <s>Māgadha</s> <s>prastha</s>; five hundred <s>droṇa</s>s, or exactly one hundred <s>pala</s>s.

body.text: (AVParis_33,3.1) [sarvapāpapraṇāśāya sarvakāmārthasiddhaye | sarvarogakṣayārthāya prayojyo ghṛtakambalaḥ] ||
body.translated_text: For the destruction of all sins, for the accomplishment of all desired purposes, for the cure of all diseases — the <s>Ghṛtakambala</s> is to be employed.

body.text: (AVParis_33,3.2) ghṛtapramāṇaṃ vakṣyāmi māṣakaṃ pañcakṛṣṇalam | māṣakāṇi catuhṣaṣṭiḥ palam ekaṃ vidhīyate ||
body.translated_text: I shall declare the measure of ghee: a <s>māṣaka</s> is five <s>kṛṣṇala</s>s; sixty-four <s>māṣaka</s>s are prescribed as one <s>pala</s>.

body.text: (AVParis_33,3.3) dvātriṃśatpalakaṃ prasthaṃ māgadhaiḥ parikīrtitam | āḍhakaṃ tu catuḥprasthaṃ caturbhir droṇam āḍhakaiḥ ||
body.translated_text: A <s>prastha</s> is thirty-two <s>pala</s>s, as declared by the <s>Māgadha</s>s; an <s>āḍhaka</s> is four <s>prastha</s>s; a <s>droṇa</s> is four <s>āḍhaka</s>s.

body.text: (AVParis_33,3.4) droṇapramāṇaṃ vijñeyaṃ brahmaṇā nirmitaṃ purā | dvādaśābhyadhikair nityaṃ palānāṃ pañcabhiḥ śataiḥ ||
body.translated_text: The measure of a <s>droṇa</s> is to be known as created by <s>Brahman</s> of old — always five hundred <s>pala</s>s plus twelve.

body.text: (AVParis_33,3.5) [ghṛtamātrā tu vijñeyā māgadhaprasthasaṃmitā | śatāni pañca droṇānāṃ palānāṃ vā śatottare] ||
body.translated_text: The measure of ghee is to be known as measured by the <s>Māgadha</s> <s>prastha</s>; five hundred <s>droṇa</s>s, or one hundred <s>pala</s>s and more.

body.text: (AVParis_33,3.6) ghṛtadroṇaśatenokta eko droṇavaras tathā | yathāśakti prayuñjīta ghṛtaṃ kṛtvātha bhāgaśaḥ ||
body.translated_text: With a hundred <s>droṇa</s>s of ghee is declared one excellent <s>droṇa</s> likewise; one should employ ghee according to one's ability, dividing it into portions.

body.text: (AVParis_33,3.7) caturbhāgo 'bhiṣekāya caturbhāgas tu hūyate | bhāgo deyaḥ sadasyebhyaḥ kartā bhāgena yujyate ||
body.translated_text: One-fourth for the <s>abhiṣeka</s> (consecration), one-fourth is offered [into the fire]; one portion is to be given to the assembly members; the performer receives [the remaining] portion.

body.text: (AVParis_33,4.1) puṣye prayogaṃ kurvīta prājāpatye 'tha mārute | vaiṣṇave pūṣadaivatye uttareṣv atha vā triṣu ||
body.translated_text: One should perform the rite under <s>Puṣya</s>, or under the [<s>nakṣatra</s>] of <s>Prajāpati</s>, or of <s>Māruta</s> (<s>Svāti</s>), or of <s>Vaiṣṇava</s> (<s>Śravaṇa</s>), or of <s>Pūṣan</s> (<s>Revatī</s>), or under any of the three northern [<s>nakṣatra</s>s].

body.text: (AVParis_33,4.2) taptakṛchrāvasāne vā sarvakṛchrasya cāntataḥ | yasmin vā snātakā brūyus tatra kuryād vicakṣaṇaḥ ||
body.translated_text: Or at the completion of a <s>Taptakṛcchra</s> (hot penance), or at the end of a <s>Sarvakṛcchra</s> (complete penance); or wherever the <s>snātaka</s>s (graduated students) advise — there the discerning one should perform [it].

body.text: (AVParis_33,4.3) pākayajñavidhānena kṛtvopakramaṇaṃ budhaḥ | niśākāle bahirgrāme kuryād agniniveśanam ||
body.translated_text: Having begun according to the procedure of the domestic sacrifice (<s>pākayajña</s>), the wise one should establish the fire outside the village at nighttime.

body.text: (AVParis_33,4.4) yajeta nirṛtiṃ tatra kṛṣṇavāsāś catuṣpathe | yathoktaṃ nairṛtair mantrair havirbhiś ca yathākramam ||
body.translated_text: One should worship <s>Nirṛti</s> (goddess of destruction) there, wearing black garments, at a crossroads, with the prescribed <s>Nairṛta</s> <s>mantra</s>s and oblation-materials in proper order.

body.text: (AVParis_33,4.5) tṛtīyena tu sūktena nivedya balim antataḥ | yathāvyāvartane caiva yad uktaṃ tat samācaret ||
body.translated_text: With the third <s>sūkta</s>, having presented the <s>bali</s> (food-offering) at the end; and as prescribed for the turning, one should observe what is stated.

body.text: (AVParis_33,5.1) tataḥ snātaḥ śuklavāsāḥ prāśya śāntyudakaṃ śuciḥ | paryukṣyopasamādhāya ghṛtasaṃskāra iṣyate ||
body.translated_text: Then, having bathed, wearing white garments, having sipped the <s>śāntyudaka</s> (peace-water), pure, having sprinkled and consecrated — the preparation of the ghee is desired.

body.text: (AVParis_33,5.2) pūrvaṃ mahāvyāhṛtibhiḥ sāvitryā tadanantaram | śāntiś ca brahma jajñānaṃ brahma bhrājad itīti ca ||
body.translated_text: First with the great <s>Vyāhṛti</s>s (sacred exclamations), then with the <s>Sāvitrī</s>; and the <s>Śānti</s> (peace) [hymns], and '<s>Brahma</s> was born of knowledge,' and '<s>Brahman</s>, shining, arose' — and thus.

body.text: (AVParis_33,5.3) agne gobhir agne 'bhyāvartinn agne jātavedaḥ saha rayyā punar ūrjeti ||
body.translated_text: 'O <s>Agni</s>, with cattle,' 'O <s>Agni</s>, turning back,' 'O <s>Agni</s> <s>Jātavedas</s>, together with wealth,' 'Again with nourishment' — thus.

body.text: (AVParis_33,5.4) agnim īLe purohitam agna ā yāhi vītaye | bṛhaspatir na ity ekā bṛhaspate yuvaṃ tathā ||
body.translated_text: 'I praise <s>Agni</s>, the <s>purohita</s>,' 'O <s>Agni</s>, come for enjoyment;' '<s>Bṛhaspati</s> indeed' — one [verse]; 'O <s>Bṛhaspati</s>, you two' — likewise.

body.text: (AVParis_33,5.5) etair ājyaṃ ca juhuyāt saṃpātān ānayed ghṛte | kṛtyādūṣaṇamantraiś ca kuryāc chāntyudake vidhim ||
body.translated_text: With these he should offer ghee, and bring the residue into the ghee; with the <s>Kṛtyādūṣaṇa</s> (sorcery-removing) <s>mantra</s>s he should perform the <s>śāntyudaka</s> procedure.

body.text: (AVParis_33,5.6) saṃpātān ānayet tatra cātanair mātṛnāmabhiḥ | vāstoṣpatyair vāṣṭoṣpatāv ānayet samadūṣaṇam ||
body.translated_text: He should bring the residue there, with the <s>Cātana</s> (expulsion) [hymns] and the <s>Mātṛnāma</s> (mother-names); with the <s>Vāṣṭoṣpatya</s> (of <s>Vāstoṣpati</s>) [hymns], he should bring [the residue] to <s>Vāstoṣpati</s>, the remover of evil.

body.text: (AVParis_33,5.7) nidhāya havir āsādya ghṛtakumbhaṃ susaṃskṛtam | ghṛtabhāgau tu yāv anyau pūrveṇāgner nidhāpayet ||
body.translated_text: Having deposited the offering-material and placed the well-prepared ghee-jar, the other two portions of ghee he should deposit to the east of the fire.

body.text: (AVParis_33,5.8) darbhādīn tu vāsādīṃś ca saṃbhārān gaurasarṣapān | bilvaṃ ca kumbhe nidhāyāpareṇāgner nidhāpayet ||
body.translated_text: The materials — <s>darbha</s> grass and the like, garments and the like, white mustard seeds, and <s>bilva</s> — having deposited in the jar, he should place to the west of the fire.

body.text: (AVParis_33,6.1) sāvitraḥ śantātīyaś ca kṛtyādūṣaṇa eva ca | abhayāparājitāyuṣyā varcasyaś ca tataḥ paraḥ ||
body.translated_text: The <s>Sāvitra</s> and <s>Śantātīya</s> [hymn-groups], and the <s>Kṛtyādūṣaṇa</s> (sorcery-removing) likewise, the <s>Abhaya</s> (fearlessness), <s>Aparājita</s> (invincible), <s>Āyuṣya</s> (life-giving), and <s>Varcasya</s> (radiance-giving) — and after that,

body.text: (AVParis_33,6.2) saṃsaktīyaḥ suṣuptīyaḥ svastyayanaḥ śarmavarma ca | cātano mātṛnāmāni bhaiṣajyaṃ nyāya eva ca ||
body.translated_text: The <s>Saṃsaktīya</s>, the <s>Suṣuptīya</s>, the <s>Svastyayana</s> (benediction), the <s>Śarmavarma</s> (shelter-armor); the <s>Cātana</s> (expulsion), the <s>Mātṛnāma</s> (mother-names), the <s>Bhaiṣajya</s> (healing), and the <s>Nyāya</s> (justice) indeed.

body.text: (AVParis_33,6.3) ghṛtaliṅgau tathā raudrau saṃpātān ānayed ghṛte | gaṇānteṣu yathāśakti brāhmaṇān svastivācayet ||
body.translated_text: And the two <s>Ghṛtaliṅga</s> (ghee-sign) and the two <s>Raudra</s> (of <s>Rudra</s>) [hymn-groups] — he should bring the residue into the ghee; at the ends of the hymn-groups, according to ability, he should have the Brahmins pronounce blessings.

body.text: (AVParis_33,6.4) yo 'sminn akṣībhyāṃ te sahasrākṣaṃ brahma jajñānam | brahma bhrājad ud agād idam āpas tathāpaś ca ||
body.translated_text: 'He who with two eyes,' 'O you, the Thousand-eyed,' '<s>Brahman</s> was born of knowledge,' '<s>Brahman</s> shining arose,' 'This one arose,' 'The Waters' — and also 'The Waters' —

body.text: (AVParis_33,6.5) abhiṣiñcet sarvamantrair āyuṣyair abhayais tathā | mṛṇmayaś cātra bhavati dveṣyasya ca parākṛtiḥ ||
body.translated_text: He should consecrate with all the <s>mantra</s>s, the life-giving and the fearlessness [hymns] likewise; and an earthen [effigy] is made there for the overthrow of the enemy.

body.text: (AVParis_33,6.6) abhiṣiñcet sarvamantrair āyuṣyair abhayais tathā | mṛṇmayaś cātra bhavati dveṣyasya ca parākṛtiḥ ||
body.translated_text: He should consecrate with all the <s>mantra</s>s, the life-giving and the fearlessness [hymns] likewise; and an earthen [effigy] is made there for the overthrow of the enemy.

body.text: (AVParis_33,6.7) tasyopariṣṭād abhiṣicya kuryān mātrātalekhanīm | aṅgādaṅgād athānyena pra pateti catasṛbhiḥ ||
body.translated_text: Having consecrated from above, he should make the measure-line [on the effigy], scraping from limb to limb with the other [instrument], with the four [verses beginning] 'Let it fly forth.'

body.text: (AVParis_33,6.8) bhrātṛvyaham iti vaiśvānaroyanty avasānena | dyāvādinā paryāyeṇa samalaṃkṛṭam ullikhet ||
body.translated_text: 'The rival-enemy' — with the <s>Vaiśvānara</s> [hymn], ending with the conclusion; with the '<s>Dyāva</s>' (Heaven) and the like, in sequence, he should scrape off the well-adorned [effigy].

body.text: (AVParis_33,6.9) dviṣantaṃ me parāvad vi dviṣantaṃ nir dahantu me | bhrātṛvyatān iti dvābhyāṃ paryāyāś ca trayaḥ parāḥ ||
body.translated_text: 'My hater, far away;' 'My hater, burn out for me;' 'The rival-enemies' — with these two, and three further rounds.

body.text: (AVParis_33,6.10) anvālabhya tu kartāram upaviṣṭa udaṅmukhaḥ | svapnatakmāṣṭanayanaiḥ saubhāgyair varmabhis tathā ||
body.translated_text: Having touched the performer, seated facing north — with the dream-dispelling, the eight-eyed, the fortune-bringing, and armor [hymns] likewise,

body.text: (AVParis_33,6.11) rudraraudraparair mantrair ājyahomo vidhīyate | srāktyaṃ vā yadi vāśvattham audumbaram athāpi vā ||
body.translated_text: With the <s>Rudra</s>, <s>Raudra</s>, and subsequent <s>mantra</s>s, the ghee-oblation is prescribed; [using fuel] of <s>srākta</s> (silk-cotton), or <s>aśvattha</s> (fig), or <s>udumbara</s> (cluster fig),

body.text: (AVParis_33,6.12) śaṅkhaṃ ca maṇim ābadhya pratisarair abhimantrayet | anvārabhyābhiṣekaṃ tu raudrābhyāṃ juhuyāt tataḥ ||
body.translated_text: And having tied on a conch and a jewel, he should consecrate with protective threads (<s>pratisara</s>); having touched [the performer] for the <s>abhiṣeka</s> (consecration), he should then offer with the two <s>Raudra</s> [hymns].

body.text: (AVParis_33,7.1) yat te vāsa [iti] paridhānaṃ yathoktaṃ paridhāpayet | rocanā guggulu ghṛtam abhyañjanam athāñjanam ||
body.translated_text: 'Whatever garment of yours' — with this he should dress [the person] in the prescribed garment; <s>rocanā</s> (yellow pigment), <s>guggulu</s> (bdellium), ghee for anointing, and collyrium.

body.text: (AVParis_33,7.2) tata etair alaṃkṛtya īkṣayetādarṣe mukham | daśa gā dakṣiṇāṃ dadyād vṛṣabhaṃ ghṛtam eva ca ||
body.translated_text: Then, having adorned with these, he should behold his face in a mirror; ten cows, a bull, and ghee should be given as <s>dakṣiṇā</s> (ritual fee).

body.text: (AVParis_33,7.3) brāhmaṇān svastivācyātha prāṅmukhaḥ saṃviśet tataḥ | rakṣohaṇam [ity] anuvākaṃ japet kartātha ṛtvijaḥ ||
body.translated_text: Having had the Brahmins pronounce blessings, facing east, he should then lie down; the performer and the priests should recite the <s>anuvāka</s> (section) 'Destroyer of <s>Rākṣasa</s>s.'

body.text: (AVParis_33,7.4) śarmavarmaitad uktaṃ snātasya rakṣobhyo 'bhayaṃkaram iti ||
body.translated_text: The '<s>Śarmavarma</s>' (shelter-armor) — this is said [to be recited] for the bathed one, producing fearlessness from demons.

body.text: (AVParis_33,7.5) na rākṣasā na gandharvā na piśācā na cāsurāḥ | krūrāḥ puruṣamarmajñā na hiṃsanti ghṛtārcitam ||
body.translated_text: Neither <s>Rākṣasa</s>s, nor <s>Gandharva</s>s, nor <s>Piśāca</s>s, nor <s>Asura</s>s — the cruel ones who know the vital points of a person — can harm one who is honored with ghee.

body.text: (AVParis_33,7.6) siddhābhiṣeko naiśaś ca ghṛtakambalam eva ca | lakṣaḥ puṣyābhiṣekaś ca pradhānāvabhṛtas tathā ||
body.translated_text: The accomplished <s>abhiṣeka</s> (consecration), the nocturnal [rite], the <s>Ghṛtakambala</s> itself, the <s>Lakṣa</s> (hundred-thousand) [oblation], the <s>Puṣyābhiṣeka</s>, and the chief <s>avabhṛtha</s> (concluding bath) likewise —

body.text: (AVParis_33,7.7) mahāśāntitrayastriṃśat tatra ṣaṭ prastaraiḥ saha | niyatānyevadṛchāyā kartavyā bhūtim icchatā ||
body.translated_text: The <s>Mahāśānti</s> (great pacification) thirty-three [hymn-groups], with six <s>prastara</s> (grass-bundles) — these must be performed by one desiring prosperity, both prescribed and occasional.

body.text:
(Pariśiṣṭa_34. anulomakalpaḥ)
(AVParis_34,1.0) oṃ namo 'tharvavedāya ||
body.translated_text: (<s>Pariśiṣṭa</s> 34. The <s>Anulomakalpa</s>) Oṃ, salutation to the <s>Atharvaveda</s>.

body.text: (AVParis_34,1.1) akṣarāni vilomāni na svaraṃ pratilomayet | pratyārambhanighāteṣu sthānāny anyāni nirdiśet ||
body.translated_text: The syllables in reverse — one should not reverse the accent (<s>svara</s>); at points of resumption and ending, other positions should be indicated.

body.text: (AVParis_34,1.2) yakāras tu takārānto antyasvaritasaṃjñitaḥ | sa tūdāttaḥ sa evādau dakāraḥ śiṣyate guruḥ ||
body.translated_text: The <s>ya</s>-syllable ending in <s>ta</s>-syllable is designated as having the final <s>svarita</s> (circumflex); it is <s>udātta</s> (high-pitched); at the beginning, the <s>da</s>-syllable remains as <s>guru</s> (heavy).

body.text: (AVParis_34,1.3) dakārāt svaryate nīcam upodātte pra yojayet | anyāni tu yathāpūrvam udāttapracitāni tu ||
body.translated_text: From the <s>da</s>-syllable, one should intone low on the <s>upodātta</s> (pre-high); the others are as before, with <s>udātta</s> (high) accumulation.

body.text: (AVParis_34,1.4) prathamo 'ṣṭākṣaro 'rdharco dvitīyaḥ ṣoḍaśākṣaraḥ | ādāv ante ca vijñeyā vyāhṛtiś cāpy atharvaṇām ||
body.translated_text: The first half-verse has eight syllables; the second has sixteen syllables; at the beginning and end, the <s>vyāhṛti</s> (sacred exclamation) of the <s>Atharvan</s>s should be known.

body.text: (AVParis_34,1.5) raktavarṇā vilomā ca yamena parikīrtitā | sarvaśatruvināśāya sarvakarmārthasiddhaye ||
body.translated_text: The <s>Vilomā</s> (reversed [<s>Gāyatrī</s>]) is of red color, proclaimed by <s>Yama</s>; for the destruction of all enemies, for the accomplishment of all rites.

body.text: (AVParis_34,1.6) mṛtyuś ca devatā cāsyā nichannaṃ chanda ucyate | svāhākāre tu phaṭkāraḥ koṭihome vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ ||
body.translated_text: <s>Mṛtyu</s> (Death) is its deity, and its meter is called <s>nicchanna</s> (concealed); instead of <s>svāhākāra</s>, the <s>phaṭkāra</s> [is used]; the procedure for the <s>koṭihoma</s> (ten-million oblation) is recorded.

body.text: (AVParis_34,1.7) anulomāṃ vilomāṃ vā gāyatrīṃ yaḥ paṭhet sadā | sarvārthās tasya sidhyanti na cānarthān samaśnute ||
body.translated_text: He who always recites the <s>Gāyatrī</s>, whether in regular (<s>anuloma</s>) or reversed (<s>viloma</s>) order — all his purposes are accomplished, and he does not encounter misfortune.

body.text: (AVParis_34,1.8) t yā da co pra naḥ yo yo dhi || hi ma dhī sya va de rgo bha yam ṇī re rva tu vi tsa ta t ||
body.translated_text: [Reversed Gāyatrī syllables:] ta ya da co pra naḥ yo yo dhi || hi ma dhī sya va de rgo bha yam ṇī re rva tu vi tsa ta t ||

body.text:
(Pariśiṣṭa_35. āsurīkalpaḥ)
(AVParis_35,1.1) oṃ kaṭuke kaṭukapattre subhage āsuri rakte raktavāsase | atharvaṇasya duhite aghore aghorakarmakārike ||
body.translated_text: (<s>Pariśiṣṭa</s> 35. The <s>Āsurīkalpa</s>) Oṃ. 'O sharp one, sharp-leaved one, fortunate <s>Āsurī</s>, red one, red-clothed one! O daughter of <s>Atharvan</s>, terrible one, performer of terrible rites!'

body.text: (AVParis_35,1.2) amukaṃ hanahana dahadaha pacapaca mathamatha | tāvad daha tāvat paca yāvan me vaśam ānayasi svāhā ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 35.1.2) 'Burn such-and-such, burn, burn! Scorch, scorch! Cook, cook! Churn, churn! Burn and cook so long until you bring [him/her] under my control, <s>svāhā</s>!'

body.text: (AVParis_35,1.3) śayyāvasthitāyās tāvaj japed yāvat svapiti || prasthitāyā gatiṃ daha svāhā || upaviṣṭāyā bhagaṃ daha svāhā || suptāyā mano daha svāhā prabuddhāyā gṛdayaṃ daha svāheti ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 35.1.3) For one lying in bed, one should recite until she sleeps. 'Of one setting out — burn her movement, <s>svāhā</s>! Of one seated — burn her womb, <s>svāhā</s>! Of one sleeping — burn her mind, <s>svāhā</s>! Of one awakened — burn her heart, <s>svāhā</s>!'

body.text: (AVParis_35,1.4) athāta āsurīkalpam upadeśād atharvaṇaḥ | nāsyās tithir na nakṣatraṃ nopavāso vidhīyate ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 35.1.4) Now, the <s>Āsurī</s>-rite (demoniac rite), from the instruction of <s>Atharvan</s>: for this, no [specific] lunar day is prescribed, nor <s>nakṣatra</s>, nor fasting.

body.text: (AVParis_35,1.5) ghṛtādidravyasarveṣu āsurī śatajāpitā | pattrādyavayavaś cāsyā jikaiṣā cānuyāyinī ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 35.1.5) The <s>Āsurī</s> [plant], recited over a hundred times in all substances beginning with ghee — its leaves and other parts, and the <s>jikaiṣā</s> plant, follow [as accompaniments].

body.text: (AVParis_35,1.6) hantukāmo hi śatrūṃś ca vaśīkurvaṃś ca bhūpatīn | āsurīślakṣṇapiṣṭājyaṃ juhuyād ākṛtiṃ budhaḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 35.1.6) He who desires to destroy enemies and bring kings under control — the wise one should offer, with <s>Āsurī</s> finely ground with ghee, into a figure [of the target].

body.text: (AVParis_35,1.7) arkendhanāgniṃ prajvālya chittvāstreṇākṛtiṃ tu tām | pādāgrato 'ṣṭasahasraṃ juhuyād yasya vaśy asau ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 35.1.7) Having kindled a fire with <s>arka</s>-wood fuel, having cut the figure with the weapon-<s>mantra</s>, one should offer eight thousand [oblations] from the feet forward — [the target] of whom becomes subject.

body.text: (AVParis_35,1.8) ghṛtāktayā strī vaśinī pālāśāgnau dvijottamāḥ | guḍāktayā kṣatriyās tu vaiśyās tu dadhimiśrayā ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 35.1.8) A woman becomes subject when [the <s>Āsurī</s>] is smeared with ghee [and offered] in a <s>palāśa</s> (flame-of-the-forest) fire, O best of twice-born; <s>Kṣatriya</s>s [are subjected] when smeared with jaggery; <s>Vaiśya</s>s when mixed with curds.

body.text: (AVParis_35,1.9) śūdrās tu lavaṇamiśrai rājikāṃ piṣṭayed budhaḥ | ā saptāhāt sarva ete āsurīhomato vaśāḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 35.1.9) For <s>Śūdra</s>s, the wise one should grind <s>rājikā</s> (mustard) mixed with salt. Within seven days, all these become subject through the <s>Āsurī</s> oblation.

body.text: (AVParis_35,1.10) kaṭutailena trisaṃdhyaṃ kulocchedaṃ karoti hi | śunāṃ tu lomabhiḥ sārdham apasmārī tribhir dinaiḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 35.1.10) With pungent oil at the three <s>sandhyā</s>s (twilight junctions), it indeed brings the destruction of a lineage. With dog's hair as well, one becomes epileptic within three days.

body.text: (AVParis_35,1.11) nivṛttiḥ kṣīramadhvājyair lavaṇena tu sajvarī | arkaidhaḥsamidagnau tu kāryo visphoṭasaṃbhavaḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 35.1.11) The reversal [is accomplished] with milk, honey, and ghee; with salt, however, [it brings] fever. In a fire of <s>arka</s>-wood fuel, one should cause the outbreak of boils.

body.text: (AVParis_35,1.12) teṣām upaśamaṃ vidyāt surāśvaryā ghṛtena ca | arkakṣīrāktayāṛkāgnāv akṣiṇī sphoṭayed dviṣaḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 35.1.12) One should know the pacification of these through liquor and ghee. With [the <s>Āsurī</s>] smeared with <s>arka</s>-milk in an <s>arka</s>-fire, one causes the enemy's eyes to burst.

body.text: (AVParis_35,1.13) gatāsumāṃsaṃ tasyaiva nirmālyaṃ citibhasma ca | eṣāṃ cūrṇena saṃspṛṣṭo hāsyaśīlo 'bhijāyate ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 35.1.13) The flesh of a dead [animal], its leftover offering-garland, and cremation-pyre ashes — one touched by the powder of these becomes given to [uncontrollable] laughter.

body.text: (AVParis_35,1.14) ajākṣīrāktayā homāt tasya mokṣo vidhīyate | tagaraṃ kuṣṭhamāṃsī ca tasyāḥ pattrāṇi caiva hi ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 35.1.14) Release from that is prescribed through oblation with goat's milk. <s>Tagara</s> (valerian), <s>kuṣṭha</s> (costus), <s>māṃsī</s> (spikenard), and its leaves —

body.text: (AVParis_35,1.15) etaiḥ ślakṣṇais tu saṃspṛṣṭaḥ pṛṣṭhataḥ paridhāvati | tasyāḥ phalāni mūlāni surabhīhastimedasā ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 35.1.15) one touched by these finely ground runs after [the practitioner] from behind. Its fruits and roots, with <s>surabhī</s> (fragrant herb), elephant grease —

body.text: (AVParis_35,1.16) sūkṣmāt taddravyasaṃsparśād anudhāvaty acetasaḥ | achidrapattrāṇy asita uśīraḥ sarṣapās tathā ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 35.1.16) from the subtle touch of those substances, the mindless one runs after [the practitioner]. Unbroken leaves, black [ones], <s>uśīra</s> (vetiver), and mustard seeds —

body.text: (AVParis_35,1.17) etacśūrṇāt pūrvaphalaṃ ghṛte caivāparājayaḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 35.1.17) from the powder of these, the previous result [obtains]; and in ghee, invincibility.

body.text: (AVParis_35,2.1) kusumāni manahśilāpriyaṅgutagarāṇi ca | gajendramadasaṃyuktaṃ kiṃ kurvāṇas tv akṛd varam ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 35.2.1) Flowers, <s>manaḥśilā</s> (realgar), <s>priyaṅgu</s> (millet), and <s>tagara</s> — combined with the ichor of a great elephant — what [would he not do]? He produces the supreme.

body.text: (AVParis_35,2.2) yāś ca striyo 'bhigacchanti tā vaśāḥ padālepataḥ | sapuṣpāṃ tāṃ samādāya añjanaṃ nāgakeśaram ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 35.2.2) Whatever women one approaches — they become subject through the anointing of the feet. Taking her [the <s>Āsurī</s>] with flowers, <s>añjana</s> (collyrium), and <s>nāgakeśara</s> (ironwood) —

body.text: (AVParis_35,2.3) anenāktābhyām akṣibhyāṃ yamyaṃ paśyet sa kiṃkaraḥ | añjanaṃ tagaraṃ kuṣṭhaṃ devījaṃ kāṣṭham eva ca ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 35.2.3) with eyes anointed by these, whatever one looks at southward becomes one's servant. <s>Añjana</s>, <s>tagara</s>, <s>kuṣṭha</s>, <s>devī</s>-born wood —

body.text: (AVParis_35,2.4) māṇsī ca sarvabhūtānāṃ saubhāgyasya tu kāraṇam | tatsamidhāṃ lakṣahomān nidhānaṃ paśyate mahat ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 35.2.4) and <s>māṃsī</s> (spikenard) — [these are] the cause of auspiciousness for all beings. From a <s>lakṣahoma</s> of those as fire-sticks, one sees a great treasure.

body.text: (AVParis_35,2.5) sarpirdadhimadhvaktapattrāṇāṃ vṛddhaputrī sahasrataḥ | rājyaṃ tu labhate vaśyaṃ tatpattratrisahasrataḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 35.2.5) Of leaves smeared with ghee, curds, and honey — [offering] <s>vṛddhaputrī</s> [plant] a thousand times, one obtains a kingdom under control; from three thousand of those leaves,

body.text: (AVParis_35,2.6) svarṇasahasrasyāptis tu tatpuṣpāṇāṃ tu lakṣataḥ | sahasrajāpāc ca tadvad udake kṣīrabhakṣiṇaḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 35.2.6) the acquisition of a thousand gold [coins comes] from a <s>lakṣa</s> (hundred thousand) of those flowers. And likewise from a thousand recitations in water, [for one] subsisting on milk,

body.text: (AVParis_35,2.7) vāripūrṇe 'tha kalaśe lokeśīpallavān kṣipet | snānād alakṣmyā mucyeta sauvarṇakalaśe 'pi tu ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 35.2.7) in a water-filled vessel, one should cast the sprouts of the <s>Lokeśī</s> [plant]; by bathing, one is freed from misfortune; even in a golden vessel.

body.text: (AVParis_35,2.8) vināyakebhyaḥ snānato daurbhāgyāc caiva durbhagāt | pṛṣṭhataś cānudhāvanti saṃspṛṣṭa udakena tu ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 35.2.8) From the <s>Vināyaka</s>s (obstacles), by bathing, and from ill-fortune; they run after from behind, one who is touched with that water.

body.text: (AVParis_35,2.9) uśīraṃ tagaraṃ kuṣṭhaṃ mustā tatpattrasarṣapāḥ | cūrṇenābhihatas tūrṇam īśvaro 'pi vaśo bhavet ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 35.2.9) <s>Uśīra</s>, <s>tagara</s>, <s>kuṣṭha</s>, <s>mustā</s> (nutgrass), its leaves, and mustard seeds — one struck by the powder of these quickly, even a lord becomes subject.

body.text: (AVParis_35,2.10) tulasībhūmahādevīcūrṇaspṛṣṭas tathā vaśī | rājābhayaṃ sureśvarīmārjanād bhāraṇāt tathā ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 35.2.10) One touched by the powder of <s>tulasī</s> (holy basil), earth, and <s>Mahādevī</s> likewise becomes subject. From sprinkling and bearing [the plant of] <s>Sureśvarī</s> (the queen of gods), the king [grants] fearlessness.

body.text: (AVParis_35,2.11) na syāt tasyādbhutaṃ kiṃ cin na kṣudropadravas tathā | nānaiśvaryaṃ nāprajatvaṃ yasya devy āsurī gṛhe ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 35.2.11) No marvel would befall him, nor any petty affliction, nor lack of sovereignty, nor childlessness — for him in whose house is the divine <s>Āsurī</s>.

body.text:
(Pariśiṣṭa_36. ucchuṣmakalpaḥ)
(AVParis_36,1.1) oṃ nama ucchuṣmebhyaḥ
(AVParis_36,1.2) ....śikhāṃ devīṃ prapadye śaṃkarāyaṇīṃ | sarvārthasādhanīṃ vibhvīṃ sarveśīṃ brahmacāriṇīm ||
body.translated_text: (Pariśiṣṭa 36: The <s>Ucchuṣma</s>-rite) (AVParis 36.1.1-2) Oṃ. Homage to the <s>Ucchuṣma</s>s (fierce Rudras). ...I take refuge in the flame-crested goddess, the daughter of <s>Śaṅkara</s>, the accomplisher of all purposes, the all-pervading, the mistress of all, the celibate.

body.text: (AVParis_36,1.3) te iṣṭakākārakarālam aticaturmukham || caturvidhais tu rūpaṃ dhyānam ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 36.1.3) [They are] of brick-like, terrifying, exceedingly four-faced form. With four kinds of forms, the meditation [is performed].

body.text: (AVParis_36,1.4) śive jaṭile brahmacāriṇi stambhani jambhani mohani huṃ phaṭ namaḥ svāhā ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 36.1.4) 'O auspicious one, O matted-haired one, O celibate one — paralyze, crush, delude — <s>huṃ phaṭ</s>, homage, <s>svāhā</s>!'

body.text: (AVParis_36,1.5) ātmarakṣā ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 36.1.5) [This is for] self-protection.

body.text: (AVParis_36,1.6) prācyāṃ diśīndro rājā devānām ādhipatyaṃ kurute | taṃ devaṃ bhagavantaṃ sagaṇaṃ sānucaraṃ saparivāraṃ saśirāḥ praṇipatya vijñāpayati | vajreṇa praharaṇenemāṃ diśaṃ vidiśaṃ ca sarvakalikaluṣam aśubhaṃ praśamayoṃ namaḥ svāhā ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 36.1.6) 'In the eastern direction, <s>Indra</s> the king exercises lordship over the gods. Having bowed with the head to that divine, blessed one, with his hosts, retinue, and attendants, one petitions: "With the thunderbolt as weapon, pacify all the impurity and inauspiciousness of this direction and intermediate direction — Oṃ, homage, <s>svāhā</s>!"'

body.text: (AVParis_36,1.7) dakṣiṇasyāṃ diśi yamo rājā pretānām ādhipatyam iti | daṇḍena praharaṇeneti ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 36.1.7) 'In the southern direction, <s>Yama</s> the king exercises lordship over the departed' — '[with the] staff as weapon,' [and so on].

body.text: (AVParis_36,1.8) pratīcyāṃ diśi varuṇo rājāpām ādhipatyam iti | pāśena praharaṇeneti ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 36.1.8) 'In the western direction, <s>Varuṇa</s> the king exercises lordship over the waters' — '[with the] noose as weapon,' [and so on].

body.text: (AVParis_36,1.9) udīcyāṃ diśi kubero rājā yakṣāṇām ādhipatyam iti | gadayā prahareṇeti ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 36.1.9) 'In the northern direction, <s>Kubera</s> the king exercises lordship over the <s>Yakṣa</s>s' — '[with the] mace as weapon,' [and so on].

body.text: (AVParis_36,1.10) dhruvāyāṃ diśi vāsukī rājā nāgānām ādhipatyam iti | daṃṣṭrayā praharaṇeneti ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 36.1.10) 'In the fixed [downward] direction, <s>Vāsuki</s> the king exercises lordship over the <s>Nāga</s>s (serpents)' — '[with the] fang as weapon,' [and so on].

body.text: (AVParis_36,1.11) ūrdhvāyāṃ diśi somo rājā nakṣatrāṇām ādhipatyaṃ kurute | taṃ devaṃ bhagavaṃ sagaṇaṃ sānucaraṃ saparivāraṃ saśirāḥ praṇipatya vijñāpayati || tejasā praharaṇenemāṃ diśaṃ vidiśaṃ ca sarvakalikaluṣam aśubhaṃ praśamayoṃ namaḥ svāhā ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 36.1.11) 'In the upward direction, <s>Soma</s> the king exercises lordship over the <s>nakṣatra</s>s. Having bowed with the head to that divine, blessed one, with his hosts, retinue, and attendants, one petitions: "With radiance as weapon, pacify all the impurity and inauspiciousness of this direction and intermediate direction — Oṃ, homage, <s>svāhā</s>!"'

body.text: (AVParis_36,1.12) athocchuṣmahṛdayam || dyurudyuru daradara vidārayavidāraya milimili namaḥ svāhā ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 36.1.12) Now the heart [<s>mantra</s>] of the <s>Ucchuṣma</s>: 'Dyurudyuru, daradara, vidārayavidāraya, milimili — homage, <s>svāhā</s>!'

body.text: (AVParis_36,1.13) ucchuṣmaśikhā || śive jaṭila iti prathamaḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 36.1.13) The <s>Ucchuṣma</s>-crest: 'Śive jaṭile...' is the first [<s>mantra</s>].

body.text: (AVParis_36,1.14) kurukuru murumuru mahā muñca mahā muñca viduvidu namaḥ svāhā || iti kavacam ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 36.1.14) 'Kurukuru, murumuru, mahā muñca, mahā muñca, viduvidu — homage, <s>svāhā</s>!' This is the armor [<s>mantra</s>].

body.text: (AVParis_36,1.15) oṃ namo mahāpiṅgalāya siṃhanādanādine namaḥ svāhā || ity astramantraḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 36.1.15) 'Oṃ, homage to the great tawny one, to the one who roars with a lion's roar — homage, <s>svāhā</s>!' This is the weapon-<s>mantra</s>.

body.text: (AVParis_36,2.1) eṣām ucchuṣmarudrāṇām ataḥ kalpo nigadyate | atharvavedodbhavānāṃ tithyṛkṣādyayogataḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 36.2.1) Of these <s>Ucchuṣma Rudra</s>s, the rite is now declared — those born from the <s>Atharvaveda</s>, independent of [specific] lunar days, <s>nakṣatra</s>s, and conjunctions.

body.text: (AVParis_36,2.2) grāme vāthāpy araṇye vā pracareta yathāvidhi | sadyaḥsiddhikarā hy ete ucchuṣmāḥ parikīrtitāḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 36.2.2) Whether in a village or even in a forest, one should practice according to rule; these <s>Ucchuṣma</s>s are proclaimed as granting immediate success.

body.text: (AVParis_36,2.3) ātmarakṣāṃ diśāṃ bandhaṃ śikhābandhaṃ ca sarvadā | etair eva yathāyogam ādau kuryād vicakṣaṇaḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 36.2.3) Self-protection, the binding of the directions, and the binding of the crest — always, the discerning one should perform these first, with the appropriate [<s>mantra</s>s].

body.text: (AVParis_36,2.4) khadirasyodumbarasya tathā bilvapalāśayoḥ | dadhisarpirmadhuyujāṃ śāntānāṃ vāpi bilvataḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 36.2.4) Of <s>khadira</s>, <s>udumbara</s>, and likewise <s>bilva</s> and <s>palāśa</s> [fire-sticks] — with curds, ghee, and honey, or peace-producing ones from <s>bilva</s>,

body.text: (AVParis_36,2.5) samitsahasratritayaṃ hutvā śāntir gavāṃ bhavet | tīkṣṇāsṛgviṣayuktānāṃ phaṭkāraś ca vināśane ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 36.2.5) having offered three thousand fire-sticks, there will be peace for cattle. [With those] mixed with sharp [elements], blood, and poison, and the <s>phaṭ</s> exclamation — [these are] for destruction.

body.text: (AVParis_36,2.6) prayogād apy asiddhiś cet tatkarmedaṃ samārabhet | ucchuṣmarūpī bhakṣayaṃs tīkṣṇaḥ saktūdakāni tu ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 36.2.6) If even from the practice there is no success, one should commence this rite: in the <s>Ucchuṣma</s> form, fierce, consuming <s>saktū</s>-flour mixed with water,

body.text: (AVParis_36,3.1) abhīṣṭāṃ vā striyaṃ gatvā dhyātvā vā reta utsṛjet | mūtrāṃ purīṣaṃ cotsṛjya gokaṅkālādhirohaṇam ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 36.3.1) having approached a desired woman or meditating [on her], one should release semen; and having discharged urine and feces, having mounted a cow's skeleton,

body.text: (AVParis_36,3.2) kṛtvā mantraṃ niśi japed yāvad gośṛṅgataś caret | jvālābhaṅgaṃ tatas tasya karmasiddhiṃ samādiśet ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 36.3.2) one should recite the <s>mantra</s> at night until one moves atop a cow's horn. From the breaking of the flame, one should then declare the success of the rite.

body.text: (AVParis_36,3.3) [dadhimadhughṛtāktānām iti śeṣaḥ] ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 36.3.3) [The remainder refers to those smeared with curds, honey, and ghee.]

body.text: (AVParis_36,4.1) saptakṣīrāñjaligrāsaḥ sruvo hy asmin praśasyate | kṣīraṃ tenātha juhuyād dhanakāmasya nityaśaḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 36.4.1) A ladle [holding] seven handfuls of milk is praised in this [rite]. With that, one should offer milk constantly for one desiring wealth.

body.text: (AVParis_36,4.2) ghṛtena tejaskāmasya āyuḥkāmasya dūrvayā | kukusaṃ tumbaraṃ vāpi vidyād uccāṭakarmaṇi ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 36.4.2) With ghee for one desiring brilliance; with <s>dūrvā</s> grass for one desiring long life. <s>Kukusa</s> or <s>tumbara</s> [pepper] — one should know [these are] for the rite of expulsion.

body.text: (AVParis_36,5.1) brāhmaṇaṃ tu vaśīkartuṃ śālipiṣṭamayīṃ tanum | kṛtvā catuṣpathaṃ gatvā gṛhītvā śastram uttamam ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 36.5.1) To bring a <s>Brāhmaṇa</s> under control — having made a figure of rice flour, having gone to a crossroads, having taken up the supreme weapon,

body.text: (AVParis_36,5.2) aṣṭottarasahasreṇa kṛtvā tadabhimantraṇam | aṣṭāṅgaṃ tena tāṃ chitvā mantrato vaśam ānayet ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 36.5.2) having consecrated it with one thousand and eight [recitations], having cut it into eight parts with that — one should bring [the target] under control through the <s>mantra</s>.

body.text: (AVParis_36,5.3) aṣṭottarasahasraṃ vā prakṛte juhuyād budhaḥ | brāhmaṇīṃ tu vaśīkartuṃ kuryān māṣamayīṃ tanum ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 36.5.3) Or the wise one should offer one thousand and eight [oblations] in the natural [fire]. To bring a <s>Brāhmaṇa</s> woman under control, one should make a figure of <s>māṣa</s> (black gram) flour.

body.text: (AVParis_36,6.1) sarpirdadhimadhvaktānāṃ lājānām āhutīḥ śubhāḥ | kanyākāmo 'ṣṭasahasraṃ hutvā kanyām avāpnuyāt ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 36.6.1) Auspicious oblations of parched grain smeared with ghee, curds, and honey — one desiring a maiden, having offered eight thousand, would obtain a maiden.

body.text: (AVParis_36,6.2) api vā piṣṭamayyāḥ prāg juhuyāt saṃdhyayāhutīḥ | darbheṣīkāṃ vābhimantrya tadgṛhe niścalāṃ nyaset ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 36.6.2) Or, of the flour-figure, one should offer oblations at the previous <s>sandhyā</s>; or having consecrated a <s>darbha</s>-grass stalk, one should place it immovably in that house.

body.text: (AVParis_36,6.3) tāvad udvejayet sā tu vajrabhūtā hi tadgṛham | kanyāyāḥ sādhanīyāyās [tu] yāval lābhas tato bhavet ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 36.6.3) It would so torment [the household] — being like a thunderbolt in that house — until the desired maiden is obtained; from that, gain would come.

body.text: (AVParis_36,7.1) pradhānam anyaṃ vā kiṃ cid vaśīkartuṃ narottamam | samidhaḥ khadirādīnām audumbaryaś ca homayet ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 36.7.1) To bring under control a chief or any other excellent man — one should offer fire-sticks of <s>khadira</s> and the like, and of <s>udumbara</s>.

body.text: (AVParis_36,7.2) śmaśānakhaṭvāṅgamayīṃ homayen mantrasādhane | palāṇḍulaśunaprasthaṃ hutvā mastaṃ na saṃśayaḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 36.7.2) For <s>mantra</s>-accomplishment, one should offer [fire-sticks] made from a cremation-ground bed-frame. Having offered onions and garlic in a <s>prastha</s> measure — intoxication [results], without doubt.

body.text: (AVParis_36,7.3) śirīṣāṅgamayīṃ rājño balis trimadhureṇa tu | brāhmaṇe pāyasamayīṃ kṣatriyasya viṣāṇikām ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 36.7.3) For a king, [one should offer a figure] made of <s>śirīṣa</s>-wood limbs, with an offering of the three sweets; for a <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>, one of rice-pudding; for a <s>Kṣatriya</s>, one with a horn-shaped [implement].

body.text: (AVParis_36,7.4) vaiśyasya sādhane homyāś cūrṇaiḥ surabhisaṃskṛtāḥ | catuṣpathe tu śūdrasya padminyutkaraṇena tu ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 36.7.4) For the subjugation of a <s>Vaiśya</s>, offerings should be made purified with fragrant powders; at a crossroads for a <s>Śūdra</s>, with the lotus extraction method.

body.text: (AVParis_36,8.1) likhitvā nāma saṃgṛhya karāgrāṅgulipīḍitām | śiraḥpīḍā jvaraḥ śūlaṃ vimatiḥ svastyasaṃgatiḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 36.8.1) Having written the name and grasped it, pressed between the fingertips — headache, fever, piercing pain, confusion, and ill-meeting [result].

body.text: (AVParis_36,8.2) balyādyā vā prayoktavyā brāhmaṇādicatuṣṭaye | evaṃ saty abhicāraś ca caturṇām api darśitaḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 36.8.2) Offerings of <s>bali</s> and the like should be employed for the four [classes] beginning with <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>s. Thus, sorcery against all four [classes] has been shown.

body.text: (AVParis_36,8.3) liṅgaṃ vā rājasarṣapaiḥ samālikhyātha dhūpayet | gaurair arghaṃ tathā dadyān mriyate sāpy asaṃśayam ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 36.8.3) Or, having drawn [a figure] with royal mustard seeds and then fumigating it — having given <s>argha</s> with white [materials] — she indeed dies, without doubt.

body.text: (AVParis_36,8.4) abhakṣabhakṣo hy asvāsthyaṃ sarvarogaprakopanam | niḥsaṃjñatā piṇḍapāto japāvṛttyā bhavanti hi ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 36.8.4) Eating what should not be eaten [brings] illness, the aggravation of all diseases, loss of consciousness, and falling of the [funeral] offering-ball — these arise from repeated recitation.

body.text: (AVParis_36,8.5) ekādaśaṃ na japtavyaṃ kulotsādas tato bhavet ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 36.8.5) The eleventh [recitation cycle] should not be performed — from that, the destruction of the lineage would occur.

body.text: (AVParis_36,9.1) oṃ namo mahāpiṅgalāya trivṛte trivṛte namaḥ svāhā ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 36.9.1) 'Oṃ, homage to the great tawny one — to the triple one, to the triple one, homage, <s>svāhā</s>!'

body.text: (AVParis_36,9.2) namaḥ sarāntitevatevasu trivṛte trivṛte triparvaṇe triśīrṣāya namaḥ svāhā ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 36.9.2) 'Homage to Sarāntitevatevasu, to the triple one, to the triple one, to the three-jointed, to the three-headed one — homage, <s>svāhā</s>!'

body.text: (AVParis_36,9.3) namaḥ kaṭavikaṭakaṇṭemāṭe pāṭale vikale asauryāsau asauryāsau pṛthivīṣṭakā iṣṭakājinātyūnyo saugaluṃtigaluṃtekaṭamasi kaṭapravṛte pradviṣa rudra raudreṇāveśayāveśaya hanahana dahadaha pacapaca mathamatha vidhvaṃsayavidhvaṃsaya viśveśvara yogeśvara maheśvara namas te 'stu mā mā hiṃsīḥ huṃ phaṭ namaḥ svāhā ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 36.9.3) 'Homage! Kaṭavikaṭakaṇṭe, Māṭe, Pāṭale, Vikale — such-and-such [against] such-and-such, such-and-such [against] such-and-such — bricks of the earth, bricks of the sacrifice-skin, Ātyūnya, Saugaluṃtigaluṃte, Kaṭamasi Kaṭapravṛte — despise! O <s>Rudra</s>, with the <s>Raudra</s> [power], cause to enter, cause to enter! Burn, burn! Scorch, scorch! Cook, cook! Churn, churn! Destroy, destroy! O lord of all, O lord of <s>yoga</s>, O great lord — homage to you! Do not harm me! <s>Huṃ phaṭ</s>, homage, <s>svāhā</s>!'

body.text: (AVParis_36,9.4) kālāya karālāya namaḥ svāhā ||
body.translated_text: Salutation to <s>Kāla</s> (Time), to <s>Karāla</s> (the Terrible One), <s>svāhā</s>!

body.text: (AVParis_36,9.5) kṛtāntāya namaḥ svāhā ||
body.translated_text: Salutation to <s>Kṛtānta</s> (the Finisher, i.e., Death), <s>svāhā</s>!

body.text: (AVParis_36,9.6) amoghāya namaḥ svāhā ||
body.translated_text: Salutation to <s>Amogha</s> (the Infallible One), <s>svāhā</s>!

body.text: (AVParis_36,9.7) aghorāya namaḥ svāhā ||
body.translated_text: Salutation to <s>Aghora</s> (the Non-Terrible One), <s>svāhā</s>!

body.text: (AVParis_36,9.8) anivartāya namaḥ svāhā ||
body.translated_text: Salutation to <s>Anivarta</s> (the Irresistible One), <s>svāhā</s>!

body.text: (AVParis_36,9.9) bhagāya namaḥ svāhā ||
body.translated_text: Salutation to <s>Bhaga</s> (the Fortunate One), <s>svāhā</s>!

body.text: (AVParis_36,9.10) bhagapramathanāya namaḥ svāhā ||
body.translated_text: Salutation to <s>Bhagapramathana</s> (the Destroyer of Fortune), <s>svāhā</s>!

body.text: (AVParis_36,9.11) vṛṣabhāya namaḥ svāhā ||
body.translated_text: Salutation to <s>Vṛṣabha</s> (the Bull), <s>svāhā</s>!

body.text: (AVParis_36,9.12) indranetrāya namaḥ svāhā ||
body.translated_text: Salutation to <s>Indranetra</s> (the One Guided by <s>Indra</s>), <s>svāhā</s>!

body.text: (AVParis_36,9.13) suvarṇacūḍāya namaḥ svāhā ||
body.translated_text: Salutation to <s>Suvarṇacūḍa</s> (the Golden-Crested One), <s>svāhā</s>!

body.text: (AVParis_36,9.14) hāhāhīhī namaḥ svāhā ||
body.translated_text: Hā hā! Hī hī! Salutation! <s>Svāhā</s>!

body.text: (AVParis_36,9.15) namas tīkṣṇāya tīkṣṇadaṃṣṭrāya bhīṣaṇāya sahasrapādāyānantaśīrṣāya vāmanāya namaḥ svāhā ||
body.translated_text: Salutation to the Sharp One, to the One with Sharp Fangs, to the Terrifying One, to the Thousand-Footed One, to the One with Infinite Heads, to the Dwarf (<s>Vāmana</s>)! Salutation! <s>Svāhā</s>!

body.text: (AVParis_36,9.16) mahāvaktrāya piṅgalanetrāya namaḥ svāhā ||
body.translated_text: Salutation to the Great-Mouthed One, to the Tawny-Eyed One! <s>Svāhā</s>!

body.text: (AVParis_36,9.17) khanakhanāya namaḥ svāhā ||
body.translated_text: Salutation to <s>Khanakhana</s> (the Digger)! <s>Svāhā</s>!

body.text: (AVParis_36,9.18) ghanaghanāya namaḥ svāhā ||
body.translated_text: Salutation to <s>Ghanaghana</s> (the Striker)! <s>Svāhā</s>!

body.text: (AVParis_36,9.19) ghusughusāya namaḥ svāhā ||
body.translated_text: Salutation to <s>Ghuṣughuṣa</s> (the Roarer)! <s>Svāhā</s>!

body.text: (AVParis_36,9.20) alepāya namaḥ svāhā ||
body.translated_text: Salutation to <s>Alepa</s> (the Unsmeared One)! <s>Svāhā</s>!

body.text: (AVParis_36,9.21) paśave namaḥ svāhā ||
body.translated_text: Salutation to <s>Paśu</s> (the Animal Lord)! <s>Svāhā</s>!

body.text: (AVParis_36,9.22) mahāpaśupataye namaḥ svāhā ||
body.translated_text: Salutation to <s>Mahāpaśupati</s> (the Great Lord of Animals)! <s>Svāhā</s>!

body.text: (AVParis_36,9.23) ucchuṣmāya namaḥ svāhā ||
body.translated_text: Salutation to <s>Ucchuṣma</s> (the Fiery One)! <s>Svāhā</s>!

body.text: (AVParis_36,9.24) ucchuṣmarudrāya namaḥ svāhā ||
body.translated_text: Salutation to <s>Ucchuṣma-Rudra</s> (the Fiery <s>Rudra</s>)! <s>Svāhā</s>!

body.text: (AVParis_36,10.1) eṣāṃ krameṇa kṛtyāni vakṣyamāṇāni yojayet | aṣṭasahasrābhijaptam anyad dravyaṃ tu homataḥ ||
body.translated_text: One should apply the rites to be described for each of these in sequence; another substance is to be recited eight thousand times and [used] for oblation.

body.text: (AVParis_36,10.2) śatror nāmnā lavaṇasya sahasram aṣṭakādhikam | hutvā dhanāyuṣor hānir jvareṇa sa ca śuṣyati ||
body.translated_text: Having offered eight thousand and eight [oblations] of salt in the enemy's name, there is loss of his wealth and life-span, and he withers with fever.

body.text: (AVParis_36,10.3) kṣipraṃ śāntir bhavet tasya kṣīrahomāt tu tāvataḥ ||
body.translated_text: Swift pacification of that [affliction] comes from an equal number of milk-oblations.

body.text: (AVParis_36,11.1) kaṇaiḥ puttalikāṃ kṛtvā gośṛṅgeṇārghadhūpabe | aṣṭasahasrābhijaptaṃ madanasya tu kaṇṭakam || tenāṣṭādaśavedhāt tu mūlakṣīrān nivartanam ||
body.translated_text: Having made a figurine from grains, [offering] with a cow's horn as the <s>argha</s>-vessel and incense, having recited eight thousand times over a thorn of the <s>Madana</s> (love-tree) — by eighteen piercings with that [thorn], cessation [comes] through root-milk [application].

body.text: (AVParis_36,12.1) dadhnā ca madhusarpirbhyāṃ ttrivarṇaiḥ sarṣapair hutaiḥ || gaurair aṣṭasahasreṇa japtair āveśayed ripūn ||
body.translated_text: By oblation of tri-colored mustard seeds together with the three-sweet (honey, ghee, sesame) mixture — having recited eight thousand [times] with white [mustard], one should cause the enemies to become possessed.

body.text: (AVParis_36,13.1) dadhyādyabhyaktalājānāṃ homād aṣṭasahasrataḥ || nāśayet satatajvaraṃ dvitīyādiṃ ca dūrataḥ ||
body.translated_text: By oblation of parched grains anointed with curds and the rest, eight thousand [times] — one should destroy continuous fever and those beginning with the second-day [type], from afar.

body.text: (AVParis_36,14.1) parijapya darbheṣīkāṃ kumbhakārādiveśmasu | nyastvā pākaṃ surāpākaṃ kaivartādi vināśayet ||
body.translated_text: Having recited over a <s>darbha</s>-stalk and placed it in the houses of potters and the like — one should destroy cooking, liquor-making, and fishing [enterprises] and the like.

body.text: (AVParis_36,15.1) akṣatais taṇḍulaiḥ kṛtvā pratidehaṃ suśobhanam | saṃsthāpya dhānyarāśau taṃ candanāduru dāhayet | baliṃ trimadhuraṃ dattvā syāt sa rāśiś caturguṇaḥ ||
body.translated_text: Having made a beautiful body-replica with unbroken rice grains, having placed it on a grain-heap, one should burn it with sandalwood and <s>aguru</s> (aloe-wood); having given a <s>bali</s> of the three-sweet [mixture], that grain-heap should become fourfold.

body.text: (AVParis_36,16.1) khādiraṃ kīlakaṃ tīkṣṇaṃ tailāktaṃ dvādaśāṅgulam | parijaptaṃ grāmamadhye nikhanet sadya udvaset ||
body.translated_text: A sharp <s>Khadira</s> (acacia) stake, twelve <s>aṅgula</s>s [long], anointed with oil, recited over — one should bury it in the middle of a village; immediately [the village] should be abandoned.

body.text: (AVParis_36,16.2) mahāpātakadoṣeṇa grāmī nirdhanatāṃ vrajet | kṣīreṇa kīlakasnānāt kuryāt tuṣṭas tu śāntikam ||
body.translated_text: By the fault of great sin, the villager goes to destitution; by bathing the stake with milk, having been satisfied, one should perform the pacification rite.

body.text: (AVParis_36,16.3) kṣīrasyāṣṭasahasraṃ ca juhuyāt tadanantaram ||
body.translated_text: And one should offer eight thousand [oblations] of milk thereafter.

body.text: (AVParis_36,17.1) kalāpamantrāṃ guṭikāṃ tannāmnā gavyamāṃsataḥ | mahāpātakasaṃbandhāj jāyate 'sya dhanakṣayaḥ ||
body.translated_text: A pellet [formed] with the bundle-mantra, from cow's flesh in that [person's] name — by connection with great sin, destruction of his wealth arises.

body.text: (AVParis_36,18.1) trivarṇasarṣapair homāt saha trimadhureṇa tu | saṃpadyate sutas tasya medhāvī śrutadhārakaḥ | taddhomāt ke cid icchanti unmattatvaṃ na saṃśayaḥ ||
body.translated_text: By oblation of tri-colored mustard seeds together with the three-sweet [mixture], a son is born to him — intelligent, retaining what he has heard; from the same oblation, some desire [to cause] madness — there is no doubt.

body.text: (AVParis_36,19.1) tilā dūrvā trimadhuraṃ homato vyādhinigraham | taṇḍulaprakṣepaś ca ||
body.translated_text: Sesame, <s>dūrvā</s> (grass), and the three-sweet [mixture] — by oblation, disease is subdued; and the scattering of rice.

body.text: (AVParis_36,20.1) tryaktodumbarasamidho dogdhrī dhenv aṣṭakapradāḥ | ekāhaṃ bhaikṣabhug bhūtvā māsāṣṭakayutasya vā ||
body.translated_text: Thrice-anointed <s>Udumbara</s> (fig) fuel-sticks, a milch cow — these are gifts of the eight[fold rite]; having lived on alms for one day, or [one who has completed] an eight-month [observance].

body.text: (AVParis_36,21.1) prādeśāntaṃ bilvavṛkṣaṃ mūlaśākhāsamanvitam | kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ caturdaśyāṃ sāyaṃ hutvā tu rukmabhāk ||
body.translated_text: A <s>bilva</s> (bael) tree of a <s>prādeśa</s> (span) in height, complete with root and branches — on the dark eighth or fourteenth, having offered in the evening, one obtains gold.

body.text: (AVParis_36,22.1) samidhāṃ vaitasīnāṃ tu agnāv arkendhanād dhute | ahorātrikahomāt syāt parjanyo bahuvarṣadaḥ | lakṣatrayaṃ bhaikṣāhāro japtvā karmaitad ārabhet ||
body.translated_text: By offering fuel-sticks of reed in the fire kindled with <s>arka</s> (sun-plant) wood — by oblation performed day and night, <s>Parjanya</s> (the rain-god) sends abundant rain; having recited three <s>lakṣa</s> (300,000) [times] while living on alms, one should commence this rite.

body.text: (AVParis_36,23.1) dugdhāktān sarṣapān hutvā tasmād bhasma mukhe kṣipet | sarveṣu vyavahāreṣu sa bhavaty aparājitaḥ ||
body.translated_text: Having offered mustard seeds anointed with milk, and then casting the ash from that into [one's] mouth — in all disputes, he becomes unconquerable.

body.text: (AVParis_36,24.1) śastraṃ japtam upādāya raṇe grasto na jīyate | khanakhanāyeti mantraḥ pūrvasevārtha ucyate ||
body.translated_text: Having taken up a weapon that has been recited over, one seized [by enemies] in battle is not defeated; the mantra '<s>Khanakhanāya</s>' is said to be for the purpose of the preliminary practice.

body.text: (AVParis_36,24.2) uttarasyā viśeṣād vā cedānīm ata uttaram | khādiratryaktasamidhāṃ pūrvasevā sahasrataḥ | atasīsamidhām evaṃ medhāvī viduṣāṃ prabhuḥ ||
body.translated_text: Especially of the latter [mantra] — now, what follows hereafter: a thousand preliminary [offerings] of thrice-anointed <s>Khadira</s> fuel-sticks; likewise of <s>Atasī</s> (linseed) fuel-sticks — [he becomes] wise, master of the learned.

body.text: (AVParis_36,25.1) gocarmamātraṃ sthaṇḍilaṃ gomayenopalepayet | tatrāgniṃ trikapāleṣu jvālayitvā praṇamya ca ||
body.translated_text: One should smear a ground-level space the size of a cowhide with cow-dung; there, having kindled fire on three potsherds and having bowed,

body.text: (AVParis_36,25.2) śirasā vānareṇātha mukhavādyaṃ tu kārayet | yatra tac chrūyate tatra āgacchanti varastriyaḥ ||
body.translated_text: With a monkey's skull, one should cause face-music to be made; wherever that is heard, there excellent women come.

body.text: (AVParis_36,25.3) damṣṭrāghaṇṭāninādās tu jvālāmukhabhayānakāḥ | yat tvaṃ kāmayase putra tat sarvaṃ dadmahe vayam ||
body.translated_text: 'With fangs, bells, and sounds, with flame-faced terrifying [forms] — whatever you desire, O son, all that we give you.'

body.text: (AVParis_36,25.4) iti bruvatyaḥ sarvās tā yatra homaḥ kṛto bhavet | tadbhasmanā tu saṃspṛṣṭāś chāgalyaḥ suprabhāvataḥ ||
body.translated_text: Thus speaking, all those [spirit-women come] wherever the oblation has been performed; and she-goats touched by that ash become supernaturally powerful.

body.text: (AVParis_36,26.1) lakṣajāpottaraṃ gatvā nadīm udadhigāminīm | vālukāsthaṇḍile liṅgaṃ tanmayaṃ tajjasadmani ||
body.translated_text: After a <s>lakṣa</s> (hundred-thousand) recitations, having gone to a river that flows to the ocean, [one should make] a <s>liṅga</s> (symbol) of its sand on a sandy ground, in a house made of that [sand],

body.text: (AVParis_36,26.2) padmāṣṭaśatam āhṛtya pūjayitvā vidhānataḥ | udake nābhimātre ca suprabhātaṃ punar japet ||
body.translated_text: Having brought eight hundred lotuses and having worshipped according to the procedure, in water up to the navel, one should recite again at the beautiful dawn.

body.text: (AVParis_36,26.3) tato māṇḍaliko rājā dīnārāṇāṃ gavāṃ śatam | praṇamya śraddhayā tasmai dadyād uddhara mām iti ||
body.translated_text: Then a regional king, [offering] a hundred <s>dīnāra</s>s (gold coins) and a hundred cows, should bow with faith and give [them] to him, [saying] 'Uplift me!'

body.text: (AVParis_36,27.1) lakṣajapād abādhyas tu paśūnāṃ damṣṭriśṛṅgiṇām | itareṣāṃ paśūnāṃ tu lakṣatritayavardhanam ||
body.translated_text: After a <s>lakṣa</s> (hundred-thousand) recitations, one becomes immune to fanged and horned animals; for other animals, there is a threefold increase in <s>lakṣa</s> [recitations].

body.text: (AVParis_36,28.1) saṃjaptaśivanirmālyadānād unmattatāṃ vrajet || śamāya candanaṃ dadyāt triṣv etaṃ mantrasaṃskṛtam ||
body.translated_text: By giving the consecrated remnant-garland of <s>Śiva</s>, one causes madness; for pacification, one should give sandalwood, consecrated by the mantra thrice.

body.text: (AVParis_36,29.1) samādhinānumantritaṃ gośṛṅgam arimandire | nikhātaṃ sadya evainaṃ mandiraṃ paridīpayet ||
body.translated_text: A cow's horn, consecrated through <s>samādhi</s> (meditation), [if] buried in an enemy's dwelling — it immediately sets that dwelling ablaze.

body.text: (AVParis_36,30.1) tīkṣṇatailaṃ kaṭu proktaṃ darvī grāmasruvas tathā | trimadhuraṃ tv atra vijñeyaṃ madhusarpistilātmakam ||
body.translated_text: Sharp oil is called pungent; the ladle, the village-ladle likewise; the three-sweet [mixture] should be known here as consisting of honey, ghee, and sesame.

body.text: (AVParis_36,30.2) saṃmukhaṃ mānasaṃ dhyāyañ śubhaṃ karma prayojayet | vimukhaṃ bhañjanādau tu naraḥ karmaṇi siddhibhāk ||
body.translated_text: Facing [the deity], meditating mentally, one should employ the auspicious rite; but facing away, in destructive [rites] and the like — a man attains success in the ritual.

body.text: (AVParis_36,30.3) aṣṭottaras trisāhasro homo hāsya prakīrtitaḥ | kīlakāstrādi yac cānyat tat sahasrābhimantritam ||
body.translated_text: The oblation of this [mantra] is declared as three thousand and eight; the stake-weapon and whatever else — that is consecrated a thousand [times].

body.text: (AVParis_36.col) ity ucchuṣmakalpaḥ samāptaḥ || iti pariśiṣṭānāṃ pūrvārdhaṃ samāptam iti ||
body.translated_text: Thus the <s>Ucchuṣma-kalpa</s> (Procedure of the Fiery One) is completed. Thus the first half of the Supplements is completed.

body.text:
(Pariśiṣṭa_37. samuccayaprāyaścittāni) [resembles in form the 13th adhyāya of the Kauśikasūtra]
(AVParis_37,1.1) oṃ bhṛgvaṅgirorūpadhāriṇe śivāya namaḥ || atha yatraitad apahanyamāne musalaṃ patati tad ghoraṃ bhavati tad apy etad ṛcoktam ||
body.translated_text: (Supplement 37: Collected Expiatory Rites [<s>Samuccaya-prāyaścitta</s>]) Oṃ. Salutation to <s>Śiva</s>, who bears the form of <s>Bhṛgu</s> and <s>Aṅgiras</s>! Now, when a pestle falls while the [mortar] is being used — that is ominous; and that too is stated in the <s>Ṛc</s> (verse):

body.text: (AVParis_37,1.2) ulūlhalān musalaṃ patitaṃ hinasti patnīṃkule jyeṣṭham | kṛṣīḥ prajāḥ paśavaḥ saṃviśeante yathendrasṛṣṭaṃ prapateta vajram iti ||
body.translated_text: "The pestle fallen from the mortar destroys the eldest in the wife's family, the fields, the offspring, the cattle — as if <s>Indra</s>'s thunderbolt had fallen."

body.text: (AVParis_37,1.3) tad vajraṃ śāntyudakena saṃprokṣya arātīyor ity ullikhya yat tvā śikva iti prakṣālya barhiṣy ādhāya juhoti ||
body.translated_text: One should sprinkle that thunderbolt with pacification-water, draw [the lines] with 'Of the two enemies,' wash with 'Whatever [harms] you, O pot,' place it on the sacred grass, and offer oblations.

body.text: (AVParis_37,1.4) vajraḥ patitas tu varaṃ hinasti taṃ tvā vayam apahanma ghoram | sa naḥ śivo 'stu dviṣatāṃ vadhāya sapatnān me dviṣato hantu sarvān ||
body.translated_text: "The thunderbolt that has fallen destroys the best — that terrible one we remove from you. May it be auspicious to us, for the slaying of haters; may it kill all my rivals and haters!"

body.text: (AVParis_37,1.5) yadvat prajāḥ papanayad dhastād yadi volūkhalāt | sapatnān me paripāhi māṃ tv evaṃ paripāhi naḥ ||
body.translated_text: "Just as it [the pestle] drove away creatures from the hand or from the mortar — protect me from rivals; thus protect us!"

body.text: (AVParis_37,1.6) yady antarikṣe yadi vāsi soccair vajraḥ sṛṣṭo yadi vā pārthivair uta | mantrāḥ prayuktā vitatā mahānto 'ghoro vajro musalaprapātaḥ ||
body.translated_text: "Whether you are in the atmosphere or up high — the thunderbolt discharged, or by earthly [agents] — the mantras employed, spread out, great — the thunderbolt of the pestle-fall is rendered non-terrible."

body.text: (AVParis_37,1.7) vajro 'si sapatnaheti tisraḥ ||
body.translated_text: "You are the thunderbolt, the rival-slayer" — three [times].

body.text: (AVParis_37,1.8) vajro 'si sapatnahā tvayādya vṛtraṃ sākṣīya | tvām adya vanaspate vṛkṣāṇām ud ayuṣmahi ||
body.translated_text: "You are the thunderbolt, the rival-slayer; with you today we would slay <s>Vṛtra</s>. O tree, lord of trees, today we have taken life from you."

body.text: (AVParis_37,1.9) sa na indrapurohito viśvataḥ pāhi rakṣasaḥ | abhi gāvo anūṣatābhi dyumnaṃ bṛhaspate ||
body.translated_text: "May he, <s>Indra</s>'s <s>purohita</s>, protect us from <s>Rākṣasa</s>s on all sides. The cows have bellowed toward [us]; O <s>Bṛhaspati</s>, [grant us] glory!"

body.text: (AVParis_37,1.10) prāṇa prāṇaṃ trāyasvāso asave mṛḍa | nirṛte nirṛtyā naḥ pāśebhyo muñca iti ||
body.translated_text: "O <s>Prāṇa</s> (Life-breath), protect life! O <s>Asu</s> (vital force), be merciful! O <s>Nirṛti</s>, release us from the bonds of <s>Nirṛti</s>."

body.text: (AVParis_37,1.11) tyam ū ṣu trātāram indraḥ sutrāmā sa sutrāmā ā mandrair indra marmāṇi te varmaṇā chādayāmīti ulūkhalamusale saṃpātān ānīya saṃsthāpya homān ulūkhalam annenaiva pūrayitvā pratipravartayed ulūkhalamusalaṃ vasanaṃ ca gāṃ ca kartre dadyāt sā tatra prāyaścittiḥ ||
