body.translated_text: "Him indeed, the protector <s>Indra</s>; the good protector, he is the good protector; with sweet [hymns], O <s>Indra</s>; I cover your vital parts with armor" — having collected the residual offerings on the mortar and pestle, having established them, [having performed] the oblations, having filled the mortar with food itself, one should set the mortar and pestle going again; and one should give a cloth, a cow, and [a fee] to the officiant. This is the expiation for that.

body.text: (AVParis_37,2.1) atha yat kāko 'bhimṛśati tan mṛtyum āśaṅkyaṃ bhavati || tad apy etad ṛcoktam ||....antakāya mṛtyava ā rabhasva prāṇāya nama iti svāheti agnau hutvā sā tatra prāyaścittiḥ ||
body.translated_text: Now, when a crow touches [someone or something], that is to be apprehended as death. And that too is stated in the <s>Ṛc</s>... 'To the Finisher, to Death, take hold; salutation to <s>Prāṇa</s>' — having offered with <s>svāhā</s> into the fire, this is the expiation for that.

body.text: (AVParis_37,3.1) athāta ājyasthālī cyavate pracalati vā kā tatra prāyaścittiḥ || saṃnatimahāvyāhṛtisāvitrīkūṣmāṇḍyaḥ sa sarvābhir juhuyāt sā tatra prāyaścittiḥ ||
body.translated_text: Now, when the ghee-vessel falls or shakes — what is the expiation for that? One should offer with all the <s>Saṃnati</s>, <s>Mahāvyāhṛti</s>, <s>Sāvitrī</s>, and <s>Kūṣmāṇḍī</s> [mantras]. This is the expiation for that.

body.text: (AVParis_37,4.1) atha pavitram <cet> praṇaśyeta karmamadhyāt pramādataḥ | anyac chittvā mantrayeta karmaśeṣam upakramet | ātmendriyasamāyuktaṃ tena mantreṇa kārayet ||
body.translated_text: Now, if the purificatory implement is lost in the middle of the rite through carelessness — having cut another one, one should recite [the mantra] over it, undertake the remainder of the rite, and have it fashioned with the [appropriate] mantra, endowed with self and senses.

body.text: (AVParis_37,4.2) vāyoḥ pūtaḥ pavitreṇa yan me chidraṃ punar maitv indriyaṃ mā na āpo medhāṃ mā no medhāṃ mā naḥ piparid aśvineti saṃnatibhir ājyaṃ juhuyād vyāhṛtibhiś ca gāṃ ca kartre dadyāt sā tatra prāyaścittiḥ ||
body.translated_text: 'Purified by the wind's filter' — 'Whatever gap is in me, may it not return' — '<s>Indriya</s> (sense-faculty)' — 'May the waters [grant] us' — 'May wisdom [grant] us' — 'May wisdom not forsake us' — 'O <s>Aśvin</s>s' — with the <s>Saṃnati</s> [mantras] one should offer clarified butter, and with the <s>Vyāhṛti</s>s; and one should give a cow to the officiant. This is the expiation for that.

body.text: (AVParis_37,5.1) atha yasyāsamāpte karmaṇi barhir ādīpyeta tatas tan nirvāpya juhuyāt ||
body.translated_text: Now, when the sacred grass catches fire during an incomplete rite — then having extinguished it, one should offer:

body.text: (AVParis_37,5.2) yad agnir barhir adahad vedyā vāso apāṃ tataḥ | tvam eva no jātavedo duritāt pāhi tasmāt ||
body.translated_text: "When <s>Agni</s> burned the sacred grass or the garment on the altar — you alone, O <s>Jātavedas</s>, protect us from that calamity!"

body.text: (AVParis_37,5.3) nirdagdhā no amitrās tu yathedaṃ barhis tathā | amitrāṇāṃ śriyaṃ bhūtiṃ tām eṣāṃ pari nir jahi ||
body.translated_text: "Our enemies have been burned, just as this grass [has burned]; the prosperity and wealth of the enemies — destroy it utterly!"

body.text: (AVParis_37,5.4) yatkāmās te juhumas tan no astu viśāmpate | ye devā yajñam āyānti te no rakṣantu sarvataḥ ||
body.translated_text: "With whatever desire we make this offering — may that be ours, O Lord of Creatures! May the gods who come to the sacrifice protect us from all sides!"

body.text: (AVParis_37,5.5) avadagdhaṃ duḥsvapnyam avadagdhā arātayaḥ | sarvāś ca yātudhānyaḥ ||
body.translated_text: "The bad dream is burned away; the enemies are burned away; and all the she-sorcerers."

body.text: (AVParis_37,5.6) mā tvā dabhan yātudhānā mā bradhnaḥ śamyum icchata | darbho rājā samudriyaḥ pari naḥ pātu viśvataḥ ||
body.translated_text: "May the sorcerers not harm you; may the red one not seek the post! The <s>darbha</s> grass, the oceanic king — may it protect us from all sides!"

body.text: (AVParis_37,5.7) ato 'nyad barhir upakalpyodakena saṃprokṣya punaḥ stṛṇāti ||
body.translated_text: Then, having prepared other sacred grass, having sprinkled it with water, one strews [it] again.

body.text: (AVParis_37,5.8) idaṃ barhir amṛteneha siktaṃ hiraṇmayaṃ haritaṃ te stṛṇāmi | tad vai purāṇam abhinavaṃ stṛṇīṣva vāsaḥ praśastaṃ prati me gṛhāṇety anyena ca barhiṣābhiprachādaye ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_37,5.8) "This <s>barhis</s> (sacred grass), sprinkled here with nectar, golden, green, I strew for you; that ancient [grass], as new, do strew — accept from me the excellent garment" — and he covers [the fire] with another layer of <s>barhis</s>.

body.text: (AVParis_37,6.1) āhutyāṃ tu gṛhītāyāṃ hutocchiṣṭaṃ pramādataḥ | tam āhutiṃ pratiṣṭhāpya śaṃ no devīr ity ācamya brahmāparam ity ardharcenemāṃ hutvā brahmajyeṣṭheti hutvā sā tatra prāyaścittiḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_37,6.1) If, when the oblation has been taken up, the offering-residue [falls] through negligence — having re-established that oblation, having sipped water with 'Auspicious to us, O goddesses,' having offered with the half-verse 'Brahman is the other,' and having offered with 'Brahman is the eldest' — that is the expiation there.

body.text: (AVParis_37,7.1) keśakīṭāvapannā cec chaṃbhuvāya svāheti bhasmani hutvā havir utpūyānyāṃ juhuyāt sā tatra prāyaścittiḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_37,7.1) If a hair or insect falls [into the offering] — having offered into the ashes with '<s>svāhā</s> to the Auspicious One (<s>Śambhu</s>),' having purified the offering, one should offer another. That is the expiation there.

body.text: (AVParis_37,8.1) atha cec calitadantaṃ patitadantaṃ vopanayet tatra prāyaścittam āha gṛhe vā barhiḥ [vā] pitā vācāryo vā dvādaśarātraṃ dīkṣeyātāṃ kartā trirātraṃ gaurasarṣapasarpiḥpayobhiḥ snātaḥ prayataḥ śuciḥ śuklavāsāḥ paurṇamāsaṃ tantram ājyabhāgānte sāvitrīm anuyojayet tena śāntyudakenainam ācāmayati saṃprokṣati ca ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_37,8.1) Now, if one with a loose tooth or a fallen tooth should be initiated — there [is] the expiation: In the house or on the <s>barhis</s>, the father or the teacher should undergo initiation for twelve nights. The performer, for three nights, having bathed with white mustard, ghee, and milk, restrained, pure, wearing white garments — at the end of the <s>ājyabhāga</s> (ghee-portions) of the full-moon ritual procedure, he should subjoin the <s>Sāvitrī</s>. With that peace-water he causes him to sip and sprinkles him.

body.text: (AVParis_37,8.2) sāvitrī śāntir brahma jajñānaṃ ye triṣaptā agniṃ brūma āyuṣyavarcasyasvastyayanābhayāparājitaśarmavarmabhir juhuyāt taṃ saṃpātya yaḥ śramāt tapaso yo vetasaṃ yo bhūtam ūrdhvā asyedāvatsarāya yady antarikṣe punar maitv indriyam ity āplāvayati sā tatra prāyaścittiḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_37,8.2) The <s>Sāvitrī</s>, the Peace [hymn], 'Brahman was born,' 'Those who are thrice-seven,' 'We declare Agni' — with the Life-giving, Splendor-giving, Safe-journey, Fearlessness, Invincibility, and Shelter-and-Armor [groups] he should offer. Having brought the residue together, [with] 'Who from exertion,' 'Who from austerity,' 'Who from Vetasa,' 'Who from beings,' 'Upward,' 'For this one, for the year,' 'If in the atmosphere,' 'Again may the faculty come' — he bathes [him]. That is the expiation there.

body.text: (AVParis_37,9.1) naśyec cen madughamaṇiḥ śāmyed vāgnir vivāhajaḥ | atyadbhutaṃ dvayam idaṃ dampatyos tu vināśanam ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_37,9.1) If the <s>madugha</s>-gem (honey-gem) is lost, or if the marriage-fire is extinguished — these two are most extraordinary [omens] and portend the destruction of the couple.

body.text: (AVParis_37,9.2) pūtudārumaṇis tatra bandhyo mantrāś ca mādughāḥ | pūtudāru na vindyāc ced yavaṃ tatra niyojayet ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_37,9.2) In that case, a <s>pūtudāru</s>-gem (Deodar gem) and the <s>madugha</s> (honey) mantras [should be employed]. If one cannot find <s>pūtudāru</s>, one should employ barley in its place.

body.text:
(AVParis_37,9.3) āyuṣmantau suprajasau suvīrau dhātā pūṣā draviṇe nau dadhātu | vimuñcatāṃ śamalaṃ kilbiṣaṃ nau dīrgham āyuś ca savitā kṛṇotv iti śāntyudakenāṅguliṃ saṃprokṣya badhnīyāt
(AVParis_37,9.4) samidho 'bhyādadhyād upatiṣṭeta saṃnatibhir vyāhṛtibhir juhuyād gāṃ ca kartre dadyāt sā atra prāyaścittḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_37,9.3) 'Long-lived, of good offspring, rich in heroes — may <s>Dhātṛ</s> and <s>Pūṣan</s> bestow wealth upon us two; may they release our impurity and sin; may <s>Savitṛ</s> grant long life' — having sprinkled the finger with peace-water, one should tie [the amulet]. (AVParis_37,9.4) One should place fuel-sticks upon [the fire], stand up, offer with the Submission-verses and the <s>Vyāhṛtis</s> (sacred utterances), and give a cow to the performer. That is the expiation there.

body.text: (AVParis_37,10.1) om atha yasya tantre 'praṇīto 'huto 'gnir upaśāmyati || punas tvādityā ity agniṃ prāṇīya saṃnatibhir vyāhṛtibhiḥ samās tvāgne 'bhy arcateti ca sūktābhyāṃ juhuyāt parisaṃkhyāhomāṃś ca ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_37,10.1) Oṃ. Now, if in [the course of] one's ritual procedure the fire, not having been led forward and not having been offered into, is extinguished — having led the fire forward with 'Again to you, O <s>Ādityas</s>,' one should offer with the Submission-verses, the <s>Vyāhṛtis</s>, and with the two hymns 'May the years honor you, O <s>Agni</s>' — and the enumerated oblations also.

body.text: (AVParis_37,11.1) atha yatraitad vivāhagnir upaśāmyati agnipraṇayanamantraiḥ prājāpatyaṃ praṇīya prāktantraṃ praṇīya yad devā yad vidvāṃso 'pamityam apratītaṃ yad dhastābhyaṃ yad adīvyann ity etaiḥ sūktair ājyaṃ juhuyāt samidho 'bhyādadhyād upatiṣṭheta vāsaḥ kartre dadyāt ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_37,11.1) Now, wherever the marriage-fire is extinguished — having led forward the <s>Prājāpatya</s> (fire of <s>Prajāpati</s>) with the fire-leading mantras, having led forward the prior ritual procedure, one should offer ghee with these hymns: 'What [was done by] the gods,' 'What the learned ones,' 'The uncounted,' 'The unrecognized,' 'Whatever by the hands,' 'Whatever in gambling' — one should place fuel-sticks, stand up, and give a garment to the performer.

body.text: (AVParis_37,12.1) atha yatraitat kālātītāsu kriyāsv atīta uttarāyaṇe ājyabhāgānte yan me skannaṃ yad asmṛtīty anumantrayet tasmai prācyā diśo antardeśād iti paryāyān ekaviṃśatiṃ juhuyāt saṃskārātīte ca karmaṇi ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_37,12.1) Now, wherever rites have passed their proper time — in the elapsed northern course [of the sun], at the end of the <s>ājyabhāga</s> (ghee-portions), one should recite 'Whatever of mine has been spilled, whatever unremembered' and should offer twenty-one rounds of 'To him, from the eastern direction and the inner region.' [This applies] also when a <s>saṃskāra</s> (life-cycle rite) has been omitted.

body.text: (AVParis_37,13.1) atha yatraitat prāṇīto 'gnir upaśāmyati || yady antarikṣe punar maitv indriyaṃ punas tvādityā ity agniṃ praṇīya prajvālya mamāgne varca iti samidham ādhāya śeṣaṃ karma samāpayet ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_37,13.1) Now, wherever a fire that has been led forward is extinguished — with 'If in the atmosphere,' 'Again may the faculty [come],' 'Again to you, O Ādityas,' having led the fire forward and kindled it, having placed a fuel-stick with 'O Agni, my splendor,' he should complete the remaining ritual.

body.text:
(AVParis_37,14.1) atha yasyopayāmo 'vapated dhastāt sa yan me upayāma ity ādadīta,
(AVParis_37,14.2) yan me upayāmo 'patad dhastād ya āyuṣā pariṣkṛtaḥ | tam ahaṃ punar ādade ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_37,14.1) Now, if one's <s>upayāma</s> (receiving vessel) falls from the hand — he should pick it up with 'Whatever <s>upayāma</s> of mine [fell]': (AVParis_37,14.2) 'Whatever <s>upayāma</s> of mine fell from the hand, that which was adorned with life — that I take up again.'

body.text:
(AVParis_37,14.3) punar indraḥ punar bhagaḥ punar me brahmaṇaspatiḥ | brahma jīvitu dād ity [ādadīta]
(AVParis_37,14.4) yan me chidraṃ yad asmṛtīti juhuyāt ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_37,14.3) 'Again <s>Indra</s>, again <s>Bhaga</s>, again <s>Brahmaṇaspati</s> for me; may <s>Brahman</s> give life' — [thus] he should take it up. (AVParis_37,14.4) With 'Whatever gap of mine, whatever unremembered' he should offer.

body.text: (AVParis_37,15.1) yan me sruvo 'patad dhastād ity upayāmena vyākhyātam ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_37,15.1) If one's <s>sruva</s> (ladle) falls from the hand — the explanation is the same as for the <s>upayāma</s>.

body.text: (AVParis_37,16.1) mekhalādīni cet plaveran punar upanayeta || vimocanīyān homān hutvānyaṃ brāhmaṇam anūcānam upaveśyodapātraṃ cāparājitena niṣkramya vāso yajñopavītādi dattvābhyukṣyācamyāpāṃ sūktaiḥ pavitraiś ca saṃprokṣya priyaṃ mā kṛṇu deveṣv iti yajñopavītaṃ dattvā vimṛgvarīṃ mā naḥ paścād iti dvābhyāṃ prāṅmukha upaviśya mahāvyāhṛtibhiḥ sāvitrī śāntisūktaṃ brahma jajñānaṃ yad asmṛty anumatiḥ sarvam iti juhuyād abhyātānaiś ca ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_37,16.1) If the girdle and other [items] should float away — one should re-initiate [the student]. Having offered the releasing oblations, having seated another learned Brahmin, and with an <s>udapātra</s> (water-vessel), going out with [the mantra] 'Invincible,' having given a garment, sacred thread, and the rest, having sprinkled and sipped, having sprinkled with the Water-hymns and Purificatory [verses], having given the sacred thread with 'Make me dear among the gods,' [then] 'May the dissolving doe' and 'Not us from behind' — with these two, sitting facing east, he should offer with the <s>Mahāvyāhṛtis</s>, <s>Sāvitrī</s>, the Peace-hymn, 'Brahman was born,' 'Whatever unremembered,' '<s>Anumati</s>,' 'All' — and with the extended [mantras].

body.text: (AVParis_37,17.1) atha yatraitan mekhalā prapatati jīrṇā vā syāt tāṃ sāvitryoddhṛtyāntaṃ kṛtvā śāntyudakena saṃprokṣya mahāvyāhṛtibhiḥ sāvitrī śāntisūktaṃ brahma jajñānaṃ ye triṣaptā idāvatsarāya ghṛtena tvāgniṃ brhūma iti ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_37,17.1) Now, wherever the girdle falls or becomes worn — having removed it with the <s>Sāvitrī</s>, having disposed of it, having sprinkled with peace-water — [one should offer with] the <s>Mahāvyāhṛtis</s>, <s>Sāvitrī</s>, the Peace-hymn, 'Brahman was born,' 'Those thrice-seven,' 'For this one, for the year,' 'With ghee, you,' 'We declare Agni.'

body.text: (AVParis_37,18.1) caturthyām ahutāyāṃ yadi ghaṭodakaṃ naśyeta tathaiva punar ānīya śaṃ no devīr iheta devīr ity anumantryāmbayo yanty āpo hi ṣṭhā śaṃ no devīr iti saṃpātya vyāhṛtyā saṃnatyā ca juhuyāt āpo bhṛgvaṅgirorūpam apāṃ puṣpam ity udakumbham abhimantrayet || vāso dakṣiṇā ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_37,18.1) On the fourth [day], if the oblation has not been offered and the pot-water disappears — having brought [water] again in the same way, having consecrated with 'Auspicious to us, O Goddesses,' 'Here, O Goddesses,' having brought the residue together with 'The mothers go,' 'O Waters, indeed,' 'Auspicious to us, O Goddesses' — one should offer with the <s>Vyāhṛti</s> and the Submission-verse. [With] 'The waters are of the nature of <s>Bhṛgu</s> and <s>Aṅgiras</s>,' 'The flower of the waters' — one should consecrate the water-jar. A garment is the <s>dakṣiṇā</s> (ritual fee).

body.text:
(AVParis_37,19.1) atha yasyāsamāpte karmaṇy udapātraṃ pravarteta tad anumantrayate
(AVParis_37,19.2) yad udapātraṃ pravartate brahmaṇāsthāpitaṃ mahat | sthānāc cyutaṃ pravartitaṃ tan me vahatu kilbiṣam || ity āsthāpayati ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_37,19.1) Now, if one's water-vessel overturns during an incomplete rite — one recites over it: (AVParis_37,19.2) 'Whatever water-vessel overturns, that great one established by <s>Brahman</s>; fallen from its place, overturned — may it carry away my sin.' Thus one re-establishes it.

body.text:
(AVParis_37,19.3) pūraṇena pūrayitvā punaḥ pūrṇam ity etayā |
(AVParis_37,19.4) punaḥ pūrṇam idaṃ pātraṃ brahmaṇāsthāpayāmasi | viśvais [tad] devair abhiṣṭutam ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_37,19.3) Having refilled with the filling [mantra], 'Again full' — with this: (AVParis_37,19.4) 'Again full, this vessel we establish by <s>Brahman</s>; praised by all the gods —'

body.text: (AVParis_37,19.5) ūrjaṃ puṣṭaṃ dadhātu no rāyas poṣaṃ śriyam āyuḥ | mayi karma samṛdhyatām iti ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_37,19.5) 'May it bestow upon us nourishment and prosperity, increase of wealth, glory, and life. May the rite be accomplished in me.'

body.text: (AVParis_37,20.1) atha cet prabhajyeta bhūmir bhūmim agād ity anumantryānyataram āhṛtya yady antarikṣe punar maitv indriyam ity anumantrya vaiśvānaro na ūtaya ud enaṃ vaiśvānaro raśmibhir iti juhuyāt sā tatra prāyaścittiḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_37,20.1) Now, if [the altar] breaks apart — having consecrated with 'The earth has gone to the earth,' having brought another, having consecrated with 'If in the atmosphere, again may the faculty [come],' one should offer with 'May <s>Vaiśvānara</s> [be] our aid,' 'Up, him, <s>Vaiśvānara</s>, with rays.' That is the expiation there.

body.text:
(Pariśiṣṭa_38. brahmakūrcavidhiḥ)
(AVParis_38,1.1) oṃ brahmakūrcavidhiṃ puṇyaṃ saṃkṣepād vacmy asaṃśayam | pāvanānāṃ paraṃ yo hi pāvanaṃ tapasāṃ tapaḥ ||
body.translated_text: (Pariśiṣṭa 38: The Procedure of the <s>Brahmakūrca</s>) (AVParis_38,1.1) Oṃ. I declare briefly, without doubt, the meritorious procedure of the <s>Brahmakūrca</s> (Brahma-tuft [penance]) — which is the supreme purifier of purifiers, the austerity of austerities.

body.text: (AVParis_38,1.2) snātvā śuciḥ śucau deśe gomayenāvasecite | vastreṇa saṃhite cāpi sitapuṣpaiḥ prapūjite ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_38,1.2) Having bathed, pure, in a clean place smeared with cow-dung, arranged with cloth, and worshipped with white flowers —

body.text: (AVParis_38,1.3) ahorātrositaḥ kṣāntaḥ pavitrātmā prapāvanaḥ | śuklavāsāḥ sugandhiḥ prāg upaviṣṭaḥ kuśāsane ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_38,1.3) having fasted for a day and night, patient, with purified soul, one who purifies; wearing white garments, fragrant, seated facing east on a <s>kuśa</s>-grass seat —

body.text: (AVParis_38,1.4) gomūtraṃ gomayaṃ kṣīraṃ dadhi sarpiḥ kuśodakam | āharet tāmrapātre tu śakṛn mūtraṃ tv abhūgatam ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_38,1.4) one should bring cow-urine, cow-dung, milk, yogurt, ghee, and <s>kuśa</s>-grass water in a copper vessel; the dung and urine should be fresh.

body.text: (AVParis_38,1.5) gomūtraṃ nīlavarṇāyāḥ kṛṣṇāyā gomayaṃ tathā | payas tu tāmravarṇāyāḥ śvetāya āhared dadhi ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_38,1.5) The cow-urine from a blue-colored [cow], the cow-dung from a black one likewise; the milk from a copper-colored one; the yogurt from a white one one should bring.

body.text: (AVParis_38,1.6) kapilāyā ghṛtaṃ grāhyam alābhe syāt tu pañcamam ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_38,1.6) The ghee should be taken from a tawny (<s>kapilā</s>) cow; in [its] absence, the fifth [substance] may be [substituted].

body.text: (AVParis_38,2.1) gomūtraikapalaṃ dadyād aṅguṣṭhāgraṃ tu gomayam | kṣīrasya sapta dadhnas tu trīṇy ekaikaṃ ghṛtāmbhasoḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_38,2.1) One should give one <s>pala</s> (measure) of cow-urine; cow-dung the size of a thumb-tip; seven [drops] of milk, three of yogurt, and one each of ghee and water.

body.text: (AVParis_38,2.2) gāyatryāhṛtya gomūtraṃ gandhadvāreti gomayam | ā pyāyasveti ca kṣīraṃ dadhikrāvṇeti vai dadhi ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_38,2.2) Having brought the cow-urine with the <s>Gāyatrī</s>; the cow-dung with 'Door of fragrance'; the milk with 'Swell up'; the yogurt with '<s>Dadhikrāvṇa</s>';

body.text: (AVParis_38,2.3) tejo 'si śukram ity ajyaṃ devasya tvā kuśodakam | saptapattrās tu ye darbhā achinnāgrāḥ samāyutāḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_38,2.3) the ghee with 'You are radiance, you are the bright one'; the <s>kuśa</s>-water with 'Of the god, you.' The <s>darbha</s> grasses should be seven-leaved, with uncut tips, joined together.

body.text: (AVParis_38,2.4) taiḥ samuddhṛtya hotavyaṃ devatābhyo yathākarmam | agnaye svāhā somāya prajāpataya ity api ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_38,2.4) Having lifted [the mixture] with those, one should offer to the deities according to the rite: '<s>Svāhā</s> to <s>Agni</s>,' 'To <s>Soma</s>,' 'To <s>Prajāpati</s>' also.

body.text: (AVParis_38,2.5) bṛhaspate ati yad idaṃ viṣṇur itīti ca | mānastokena gāyatryā etaiś ca juhuyāt tataḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_38,2.5) 'O <s>Bṛhaspati</s>, that which,' 'This <s>Viṣṇu</s>' — and thus. 'May not our son,' with the <s>Gāyatrī</s> — and with these he should then offer.

body.text: (AVParis_38,2.6) praṇavena praṇavenaiva pibec ca praṇavena tu | hotavyaṃ praṇavenaiva pibec ca praṇavena tu ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_38,2.6) With <s>Praṇava</s> (Oṃ) alone one should offer, and with <s>Praṇava</s> one should drink; one should offer with <s>Praṇava</s>, and drink with <s>Praṇava</s>.

body.text: (AVParis_38,3.1) madhyamena palāśasya padmapattreṇa vā pibet | api vā tāmrapātreṇa hutaśeṣaṃ viśuddhaye ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_38,3.1) One should drink with the middle [leaf] of a <s>Palāśa</s> tree, or with a lotus leaf, or else with a copper vessel — the offering-residue, for purification.

body.text: (AVParis_38,3.2) yat tvagasthigataṃ pāpaṃ dehe tiṣṭhati dehinām | brahmakūrco dahet sarvaṃ pradīpto 'gnir ivendhanam ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_38,3.2) Whatever sin resides in the skin, bones, and body of embodied beings — the <s>Brahmakūrca</s> burns all of it, like a blazing fire [burns] fuel.

body.text: (AVParis_38,3.3) trayodaśyādicaturṣu triḥsnānākṣārabhojanam | pañcadaśyāṃ pañcagavyaṃ sopavāsaṃ mahāphalam ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_38,3.3) On the thirteenth and the following four [days], bathing three times and eating only alkaline food. On the fifteenth, the <s>Pañcagavya</s> (five cow-products), with fasting — [this gives] great fruit.

body.text: (AVParis_38,3.4) abhojyābhakṣyaśūdrānnabhakṣaṇe vedavikraye | pratigrahe kālamantrahīne home dyumaithune ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_38,3.4) For eating forbidden food, inedible things, or food from a <s>Śūdra</s>; for selling the <s>Vedas</s>; for accepting [gifts improperly]; for an oblation lacking proper time or mantra; for intercourse during the day —

body.text: (AVParis_38,3.5) bālatve yat kṛtaṃ caiva yuvā vṛddhavayās tathā | mātāpitṛkṛtaṃ caiva tat kṣaṇād eva nirdahet ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_38,3.5) whatever was done in childhood, or in youth, or in old age; and whatever was done by mother or father — it burns [all of] that instantly.

body.text: (AVParis_38,3.6) māsemāse prayuñjānodevalokam avāpnuyāt | ardhamāseardhamāse ca ṛṣīṇāṃ lokam uttamam ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_38,3.6) One who performs [this] month after month attains the world of the gods. Every half-month, the highest world of the sages.

body.text: (AVParis_38,3.7) ṣaḍrātre caiva ṣaḍrātre brahmalokam anāmayam | aharahaḥ prayuñjānaḥ paraṃ brahmādhigacchati ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_38,3.7) Every six days, the untainted world of <s>Brahman</s>. One who performs [this] every day attains the supreme <s>Brahman</s>.

body.text: (AVParis_38,3.8) anena vidhinaiveṣṭvā devatarpaṇapūrvakam | brahmaṇā nirmitaṃ hy etat pavitraṃ paramaṃ hitam ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_38,3.8) Having performed the rite by this procedure, preceded by the satisfaction of the deities — this was fashioned by <s>Brahman</s>; it is the supreme purifier, beneficial.

body.text:
(Pariśiṣṭa_39. taḍāgādividhiḥ)
(AVParis_39,1.1) oṃ pippalādaṃ mahāprājñam idam ūcur maharṣayaḥ | bhūmikhātasya śuddhyarthaṃ vidhiṃ prabrūhi tattvataḥ ||
body.translated_text: (Pariśiṣṭa 39: The Procedure for Reservoirs and the Like) (AVParis_39,1.1) Oṃ. The great sages spoke thus to <s>Pippalāda</s>, the greatly wise: "Declare truly the procedure for the purification of excavated ground."

body.text: (AVParis_39,1.2) kūpavāpītaḍāgeṣu puṣkariṇyāṃ ca veśmasu | ahorātroṣito bhūtvā tataḥ karma samārabhet ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_39,1.2) For wells, stepped-ponds, reservoirs, lotus-ponds, and houses — having fasted for a day and night, one should then commence the ritual.

body.text: (AVParis_39,1.3) śāntyudakena tad brahmā pūrvoktaṃ yad agastinā | pari prāgād iti dvābhyām abhimantrayate tataḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_39,1.3) With the peace-water — that Brahmin [should use] what was previously stated by <s>Agastya</s>; with the two [mantras beginning] 'Go around,' he then consecrates.

body.text: (AVParis_39,1.4) carutantreṇa vidhinā caruṃ bhaumaṃ tu nirvapet | prāktantram ājyabhāgāntaṃ satyaṃ bṛhad iti smṛtam ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_39,1.4) By the procedure of the <s>caru-tantra</s> (rice-oblation ritual), he should cook the earthen <s>caru</s> (rice-offering). The prior ritual procedure up to the <s>ājyabhāga</s> (ghee-portions) is remembered as 'Truth, great.'

body.text: (AVParis_39,1.5) havir ājyaṃ samidhaś ca upasthānaṃ yathākramam | kūpādīnāṃ samīpe tu japen mantrān samāhitaḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_39,1.5) The oblation, the ghee, and the fuel-sticks, and the invocation, in order — near the wells and the rest, he should mutter the mantras with concentration.

body.text: (AVParis_39,1.6) ambayo yanty āpo hi ṣṭhā śaṃ no devīr iti trayam | hiraṇyavarṇāḥ punantu mā sasruṣīr himavato 'psu te ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_39,1.6) 'The mothers go,' 'O Waters indeed,' 'Auspicious to us, O Goddesses' — these three; 'Golden-hued,' 'May they purify me,' 'Flowing from the Himavat,' 'In the waters, your' —

body.text: (AVParis_39,1.7) japtvā tu dhenum ānītāṃ pibantīm anumantrayet | ā gāva iti sūktena tārayet tu tathaiva gām ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_39,1.7) having muttered, he should consecrate a cow that has been brought, drinking [water], with the hymn 'Come, O Cows'; and he should likewise have the cow cross [the water].

body.text: (AVParis_39,1.8) kūpavāpītaḍāgānāṃ samīpe cābhimantrayet | upa hvaye sūyavasāt kartre dadyāt tu gāṃ śubhām ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_39,1.8) Near the wells, stepped-ponds, and reservoirs he should consecrate [with the mantra]; 'I invoke from the pasture' — one should give a fine cow to the performer.

body.text: (AVParis_39,1.9) kāmasūktena gṛhṇīyāt karma saṃsthāpayet tataḥ | hiraṇyarajatādīnāṃ matsyādīn kārayed budhaḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_39,1.9) With the Desire-hymn he should take up [the water]; then he should complete the rite. The wise one should have [images] of gold, silver, and the rest fashioned — fish and the like.

body.text: (AVParis_39,1.10) sauvarṇau kūrmamakarau rājatau matsyamudgarau | tāmrau kulīrakarkaṭāv āyasaḥ śiśumārakaḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_39,1.10) A golden tortoise and crocodile, silver fish and club-fish, copper crab and crayfish, and an iron <s>Śiśumāra</s> (porpoise/Gangetic dolphin).

body.text: (AVParis_39,1.11) śāntyudakaṃ pañcagavyaṃ tasminn eva jale kṣipet | kartṛdātārau snāyetāṃ drupadād iva śumbhanī ||
body.translated_text: He should throw <s>śāntyudaka</s> (peace-water) and <s>pañcagavya</s> (five products of the cow) into that very water; the performer and the donor should bathe — 'Like <s>Drupad</s>, the purifying one.'

body.text: (AVParis_39,1.12) brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā tu puṇyāhaṃ vācayet tataḥ | samyag vidhānam etad dhi kūpādeḥ saṃprakīrtitam | puṇyaṃ karma dvijātīnāṃ svargasyākṣayyam icchatām ||
body.translated_text: Having fed the Brahmins, he should then have the <s>puṇyāha</s> (auspicious day declaration) recited; this is indeed the correct procedure proclaimed for wells and the like — a meritorious rite for the twice-born who desire imperishable heaven.

children.text: (Pariśiṣṭa_40. pāśupatavratam)
children.translated_text: (<s>Pariśiṣṭa</s> 40. The <s>Pāśupatavrata</s>)

children.text: (AVParis_40,1.1) om atha pāśupatavratādeśo
children.translated_text: Oṃ. Now the instruction for the <s>Pāśupatavrata</s> (vow of <s>Paśupati</s>).

children.text: (AVParis_40,1.2) nāśrotriyāya nācaritavedavratāya nākṛtavapanāya dadīta ||
children.translated_text: It should not be given to one who is not a <s>Śrotriya</s> (learned in scripture), nor to one who has not completed the Vedic vows, nor to one who has not performed the tonsure.

body.text:
(AVParis_40,1.3) māsadvitricatuṣpañcasaṃvatsaradvādaśasaṃvatsaraparimitaṃ naiṣṭhikaṃ vā
(AVParis_40,1.4) athāsyāyatanāni ||
body.translated_text: It is limited to two, three, four, five months, a year, or twelve years; or it may be lifelong (<s>naiṣṭhika</s>). Now, the places for its [observance]:

body.text: (AVParis_40,1.5) mahādevāyatane 'pāṃ samīpe ||
body.translated_text: In a temple of <s>Mahādeva</s>, near water,

children.text: (AVParis_40,1.6) giriguhāyāṃ gavāṃ goṣṭhe 'gnyāgāre vā
children.translated_text: In a mountain cave, in a cattle-pen, or in a fire-house,

children.text: (AVParis_40,1.7) nadīnāṃ bahūnāṃ pratiśraye
children.translated_text: At the confluence of many rivers,

children.text: (AVParis_40,1.8) anusavanam ||
children.translated_text: At each <s>savana</s> (pressing, i.e., morning, midday, and evening).

body.text:
(AVParis_40,1.9) bhasmanā snānaṃ raudrahomasnapanaṃ ca sarpiḥkṣīragandhodakair
(AVParis_40,1.10) gandhapuṣpadhūpadīpodanapāyasayāvakalājādi pradakṣiṇāntaṃ ca ||
body.translated_text: Bathing with ashes, the <s>Raudra</s> (of <s>Rudra</s>) oblation and bathing with ghee, milk, fragrant water; fragrance, flowers, incense, lamp, cooked rice, milk-rice, barley-gruel, and the like — ending with circumambulation.

body.text: (AVParis_40,1.11) nivedya nirmālyagandhahārīhāsagītavādanādyupahārān

children.text: (AVParis_40,1.12) dakṣiṇena tṛtīyam upatiṣṭhate
children.translated_text: He performs the third [worship] from the south.

children.text: (AVParis_40,1.13) kaṭakakeyūradhāriṇe namo vṛṣāya namo vṛṣabhadhvajāya namo
children.translated_text: 'Salutation to the wearer of bracelets and armlets; salutation to the Bull; salutation to the one whose banner is the Bull.'

children.text: (AVParis_40,1.14) vānaraṃ te mukhaṃ raudram anindyaṃ śubhaṃ paśum evājananevājanakaṃ ghoraṃ jīvaṃ jātyam eva rukmaṃ dadāmīti ekavāsā vivāsā vā virāgāṇi vastrāṇi dadīta ||
children.translated_text: 'Your face is that of a monkey, terrible, blameless, auspicious; a beast indeed, generating and non-generating, terrible, living, natural indeed — a gold [ornament] I give' — wearing one garment or no garment, he should give garments of dispassion.

body.translated_text: Having offered the gifts of discarded garlands, fragrance, garlands, laughter, songs, instrumental music, and the like,

body.text: (AVParis_40,2.1) gocarmamātraṃ sthaṇḍilam upalipya gomayenollikhyābhyukṣyāgne prehīty agniṃ praṇīyopasamādhāya paristīrya brahmāṇaṃ kalpayitvā nānyadevatādiśi rudrasya dakṣiṇodapātraṃ sthāpayitvā mahāvyāhṛtibhir agnyāyatane nidhāya rudram āvāhayati ||
body.translated_text: Having smeared and plastered a ritual ground the size of a cow's hide with cow-dung, having carved, sprinkled, and led the fire forward with '<s>Agne</s>, go forth,' having consecrated, having strewn [the grass], having appointed the <s>Brahmā</s> (superintendent), not in the direction of any other deity — having placed the water-vessel of <s>Rudra</s> to the south, having deposited in the fire-seat with the great <s>Vyāhṛti</s>s, he invokes <s>Rudra</s>:

body.text: (AVParis_40,2.2) rudraṃ kruddhāśanimukhaṃ devānām īśvaraṃ param | śvetapiṅgalaṃ devānām <mahādevam> prapadye śaraṇāgataḥ ||
body.translated_text: '<s>Rudra</s>, the angry, thunderbolt-faced, supreme lord of the gods — to the white-tawny <s>Mahādeva</s> of the gods, I take refuge, having come for shelter.'

body.text: (AVParis_40,2.3) yasya yuktā rathe siṃhā vyāghrāś ca viṣamānanāḥ | tam ahaṃ pauṇḍarīkākṣaṃ devam āvāhaye śivam ity āvāhyābhyarcya ||
body.translated_text: 'He whose chariot is yoked with lions, tigers, and fierce-faced ones — to that lotus-eyed god <s>Śiva</s>, I invoke' — having invoked and worshipped,

body.text: (AVParis_40,2.4) na taṃ yakṣmaitu deva iti gugguluṃ dhūpaṃ ca dadyāt ||
body.translated_text: 'May disease not approach that god' — he should offer <s>guggulu</s> (bdellium) and incense.

body.text: (AVParis_40,2.5) tat puruṣāya vidmahe mahādevāya dhīmahi | tan no rudraḥ pracodayāt ||
body.translated_text: 'We know that <s>Puruṣa</s>; we meditate upon <s>Mahādeva</s>; may <s>Rudra</s> impel us.'

body.text: (AVParis_40,2.6) tasmai devāya vidmahe mahādevāya dhīmahi | tan no rudro 'numanyatām || iti rudrasāvitrīṃ japtvā ||
body.translated_text: 'We know that god; we meditate upon <s>Mahādeva</s>; may <s>Rudra</s> approve of us.' — Having recited thus the <s>Rudra-Sāvitrī</s>,

body.text: (AVParis_40,2.7) yo agnau rudra ity anumantrayen namo astu yāvad āvāhane devadevasyāvāhayāmy aham iti ||
body.translated_text: 'He who is <s>Rudra</s> in the fire' — he should consecrate; 'Salutation be! As far as the invocation — I invoke the god of gods.'

body.text: (AVParis_40,2.8) pramardane sarvāsuravināśāya oṃ phaṭkāraṃ karoti ||
body.translated_text: For the destruction — 'for the annihilation of all <s>Asura</s>s' — he utters the Oṃ <s>phaṭkāra</s> (phaṭ exclamation).

body.text: (AVParis_40,2.9) nivedane 'ham amukaṃ nivedayāmīti jaṭī muṇḍī pañcaśikhī vā ||
body.translated_text: For the dedication — 'I dedicate such-and-such' — whether wearing matted hair, shaven, or with five tufts.

body.text: (AVParis_40,3.1) brāhmaṇo ha vā aham amukasagotro bhagavato maheśvarasya vrataṃ cariṣyāmīti vācayitvā ||
body.translated_text: 'I, a Brahmin, of such-and-such <s>gotra</s> (lineage), shall observe the vow of the blessed <s>Maheśvara</s>' — having had [him] declare thus,

body.text: (AVParis_40,3.2) tato 'sya mauñjīṃ prayacchati || sāvitryā tu daṇḍaṃ pālāśaṃ bailvam āśvatthaṃ vā asiṃ lakuṭaṃ khaṭvāṅgaṃ paraśuṃ vā ||
body.translated_text: He then gives him the girdle of <s>muñja</s> grass; with the <s>Sāvitrī</s>, a staff of <s>palāśa</s>, <s>bilva</s>, or <s>aśvattha</s> — or a sword, a club, a skull-topped staff, or an axe.

body.text:
(AVParis_40,3.3) aghorebhyo 'tha ghorebhyo 'ghoraghoratarebhyaś ca | sarvataḥ śarvaśarvebhyo namas te rudra rūpebhya ity ādau śarvaṃ namaskṛtyopaviśyājyaṃ niratiśāyitvedhmān ādīpayaty antara iti
(AVParis_40,3.4) idhmā jātavedasaḥ samiddhasya tebhyo vardhayasva prajayā paśubhiḥ śriyā gṛhair dhaneneti ||
body.translated_text: 'To the non-terrible ones, then to the terrible ones, to the terrible and more terrible ones; to <s>Śarva</s> in every form — salutation to your <s>Rudra</s> forms' — first having saluted <s>Śarva</s>, having seated himself, he kindles the ghee and unlimited fuel-sticks with 'Within' — 'Fuel-sticks of <s>Jātavedas</s>! Of the kindled one — may you increase with progeny, cattle, prosperity, houses, and wealth.'

body.text:
(AVParis_40,3.5) yavāghārau ājyabhāgau juhuyād
(AVParis_40,3.6) vāyave svāhā || śarvāya rudrāya svāhā || paśupataye bhīmāya svāhā || śāntāyādhipataye devāya svāheti ||
body.translated_text: He should offer the barley-ghee and <s>ājyabhāga</s> (ghee-portions): '<s>Svāhā</s> to <s>Vāyu</s>!' '<s>Svāhā</s> to <s>Śarva</s>, to <s>Rudra</s>!' '<s>Svāhā</s> to <s>Paśupati</s>, the terrible!' '<s>Svāhā</s> to the peaceful lord, the god!'

body.text:
(AVParis_40,3.7) evam eva patnīnāṃ tūṣṇīm adhipasya juhuyād
(AVParis_40,3.8) evaṃ sarveṣu vratanivedaneṣu vrātapatīr juhoti ||
body.translated_text: Likewise for the wives [of <s>Rudra</s>], he should offer silently for the overlord; thus in all vow-dedications, the <s>Vrātapati</s> (lord of the vow) offers.

body.text: (AVParis_40,3.9) vratena tvam ity ubhayīruham iti pañcabhī raudrān homān hutvā homāvasānena bhasmanā snānaṃ karoti ||
body.translated_text: 'By the vow, you' — with the five [verses of] 'Ascending both ways,' having offered the <s>Raudra</s> oblations, at the conclusion of the oblation he performs the bath with ashes.

body.text: (AVParis_40,4.1) bhasmasnānam [tāvad] grahīṣyāmi sarvapāpapraṇāśanam | bhasmasnānena rudro hi snāto 'bhūt pūta ātmanā ||
body.translated_text: 'I shall take the ash-bath, the destroyer of all sins; by the ash-bath, <s>Rudra</s> himself bathed, purified in his own Self.'

body.text: (AVParis_40,4.2) bhasmanā snāyate rudro viṣṇuḥ snāyate bhasmanā | tena snānena snāmy ahaṃ yena snāto maheśvaraḥ ||
body.translated_text: '<s>Rudra</s> bathes with ashes; <s>Viṣṇu</s> bathes with ashes; by that bath I bathe — the bath by which <s>Maheśvara</s> bathed.'

body.text: (AVParis_40,4.3) yena snātā umā devī rudro bhartā maheśvaraḥ | yena snātā gaṇāḥ sarve yena snātā dvijātayaḥ ||
body.translated_text: 'By which the goddess <s>Umā</s> bathed, and <s>Rudra</s> her lord, <s>Maheśvara</s>; by which all the <s>Gaṇa</s>s (troops) bathed, by which the twice-born bathed.'

body.text: (AVParis_40,4.4) yena snātā śivaḥ śarvaḥ śaṃkaraś ca vṛṣadhvajaḥ | snātāni sarvabhūtāni gaṅgāyamunayāgame ||
body.translated_text: 'By which <s>Śiva</s>, <s>Śarva</s>, <s>Śaṅkara</s>, and <s>Vṛṣadhvaja</s> (the Bull-bannered) bathed; all beings are bathed at the confluence of the <s>Gaṅgā</s> and <s>Yamunā</s>.'

body.text: (AVParis_40,4.5) snāto 'haṃ sarvatīrtheṣu nadīprasravaṇeṣu ca | vāruṇāgneyasaumyānāṃ bhasmanā snānam uttamam | tena snānena snāmy ahaṃ yena snāto maheśvaraḥ ||
body.translated_text: 'I have bathed in all <s>tīrtha</s>s (sacred fords) and at river-springs; of the <s>Vāruṇa</s>, <s>Āgneya</s>, and <s>Saumya</s> [types], the ash-bath is supreme; by that bath I bathe — the bath by which <s>Maheśvara</s> bathed.'

body.text: (AVParis_40,5.1) bhūtis tu piṅgalo babhrur bhūtir viṣṇuḥ sanātanaḥ | bhūtir brahmā mahendraś ca bhūtir devāḥ saha rṣibhiḥ ||
body.translated_text: '<s>Bhūti</s> (sacred ash) is tawny, ruddy; <s>Bhūti</s> is <s>Viṣṇu</s>, the eternal; <s>Bhūti</s> is <s>Brahmā</s> and great <s>Indra</s>; <s>Bhūti</s> is the gods together with the <s>ṛṣi</s>s.'

body.text: (AVParis_40,5.2) bhūtir me 'lakṣmīṃ nirṇuded bhūtir me śriyam āvahet | bhūtir ma āyuṣā vittaṃ varco brahma prayacchatu ||
body.translated_text: 'May <s>Bhūti</s> dispel ill-fortune from me; may <s>Bhūti</s> bring prosperity to me; may <s>Bhūti</s> grant me long life, wealth, radiance, and <s>Brahman</s>.'

body.text: (AVParis_40,5.3) bhasmanā caranto nityaṃ dhyāyinaḥ paricintakāḥ | yānti pāśupataṃ sthānaṃ punarāvṛttidurlabham ||
body.translated_text: 'Those who always walk with ashes, meditating, contemplating — they go to the station of <s>Paśupati</s>, from which return is difficult to attain.'

body.text: (AVParis_40,5.4) vācā tu yat kṛtaṃ karma manasā ca vicintitam | alakṣmīś cāpad duḥsvapnaṃ bhasmanā tat praṇaśyatu ||
body.translated_text: 'Whatever deed was done by speech and pondered by the mind — ill-fortune, calamity, and bad dreams — may that be destroyed by the ashes.'

body.text: (AVParis_40,5.5) mokṣaṇaṃ mokṣakāle ca bhasmaśeṣaṃ visarjayet | mukto 'haṃ sarvapāpebhyo rudralokaṃ vrajāmy aham ||
body.translated_text: 'Release at the time of release — he should let go what remains as ashes: "I am freed from all sins; I go to the world of <s>Rudra</s>."'

body.text: (AVParis_40,6.1) etat snānaṃ vāruṇaṃ parvasu śarīralepena yathākāmaṃ parvasūpavaset ||
body.translated_text: This bath of <s>Varuṇa</s> [should be performed] on the <s>parvan</s> (juncture) days; by anointing the body with ashes, one should fast on the <s>parvan</s> days as one wishes.

body.text: (AVParis_40,6.2) strīśūdraṃ nābhibhāṣeta ||
body.translated_text: One should not speak to women or <s>Śūdra</s>s.

body.text: (AVParis_40,6.3) tadā sāvitrīṃ japet ||
body.translated_text: Then one should recite the <s>Sāvitrī</s>.

body.text: (AVParis_40,6.4) yadi bhāṣeta tadā rudrasāvitrīṃ japet ||
body.translated_text: If one does speak, then one should recite the <s>Rudra-Sāvitrī</s>.

body.text: (AVParis_40,6.5) kamaṇḍalukapāle bhinne bhūmir bhūmim agād ity apsu praveśayet ||
body.translated_text: When the water-vessel or skull-bowl is broken — 'Earth has gone to earth' — he should immerse [it] in water.

body.text: (AVParis_40,6.6) retaḥskande yan me retas tejasā saṃniṣadya dehāt praskandet punar na bhavāya | tad agnir vāyuḥ... ...api ceyaṃ pṛthivī kañcakhanteti ||
body.translated_text: In case of seminal discharge — 'Whatever semen of mine, having settled with vital energy, flows from the body, not for rebirth — that <s>Agni</s>, <s>Vāyu</s>... ...and this earth digs anywhere.'

body.text:
(AVParis_40,6.7) samyak kva cit karoti
(AVParis_40,6.8) vratam upādhyāyāchando vartayet ||
body.translated_text: Wherever he performs correctly — he should observe the vow according to the teacher's instruction.

body.text: (AVParis_40,6.9) tata udīkṣaṇam ||
body.translated_text: Then the looking upward [rite].

body.text: (AVParis_40,6.10) vrātapatīr juhoti ||
body.translated_text: The <s>Vrātapati</s> (lord of the vow) offers.

body.text: (AVParis_40,6.11) samāso 'haṃ vratasviṣṭakṛta iti hutvādityābhimukhas tiṣṭheta ||
body.translated_text: 'I am complete; the vow's <s>sviṣṭakṛt</s> (well-offered oblation)' — having offered thus, he should stand facing the sun.

body.text: (AVParis_40,6.12) yan me duruktaṃ durhutaṃ durdhyātaṃ durvicintitam | tan me bhagavān īśānaḥ sarvaṃ tvaṃ kṣantum arhasi ||
body.translated_text: 'Whatever ill-spoken by me, ill-offered, ill-meditated, ill-thought — all that, O blessed <s>Īśāna</s>, you are worthy to forgive.'

body.text:
(AVParis_40,6.13) navonavo bhavasi jāyamāna ity apsu pravāhayed
(AVParis_40,6.14) ye śraddhayedaṃ paśupater vrataṃ caranti | teṣāṃ madhu viśakṣe he dadate na punargamanaṃ madhurivādyehaiva ca | te rudrā viratau paśupatisāyujyaṃ gaccha<n>ti
(AVParis_40,6.14) tad eṣa ślokaḥ ||
body.translated_text: 'You become new and new, being born' — he should float [the remains] in water. Those who observe this vow of <s>Paśupati</s> with faith — to them the sweet one grants, as if sweet from the very first — they do not return here again. They, the <s>Rudra</s>s at the end, go to union with <s>Paśupati</s> (<s>sāyujya</s>). On this there is this verse:

body.text: (AVParis_40,6.16) vilīnapāśapañjarāḥ samāptatattvagocarāḥ | prayānti śaṃkaraṃ paraṃ patiṃ vibhuṃ sadāśivam ||
body.translated_text: 'With the cage of bonds dissolved, having completed the range of reality — they go to <s>Śaṅkara</s>, the supreme lord, the all-pervading, <s>Sadāśiva</s>.'

body.text:
(Pariśiṣṭa_41. saṃdhyopāsanavidhiḥ)
(AVParis_41,1.1) om athātaḥ saṃdhyopāsanavidhiṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||
body.translated_text: (<s>Pariśiṣṭa</s> 41. Procedure for <s>Sandhyopāsana</s>) Oṃ. Now we shall expound the procedure for <s>sandhyopāsana</s> (twilight worship).

body.text:
(AVParis_41,1.2) prāṅ vodaṅ vā grāmān niṣkramya śuciḥ śucau deśe guptatīrthāyataneṣu vā
(AVParis_41,1.3) suprakṣālitapāṇipādavadanaḥ prāg vīrāsanenopaviśya jīvā sthety ācamyāpo hi ṣṭhety abhyukṣya prāṇāyāmān kṛtvācamyottiṣṭhan dakṣiṇahastasthā āpo ayojālā ity apa utsṛjed bahudhā ||
body.translated_text: Going forth from the village eastward or northward, pure, in a pure place, at protected <s>tīrtha</s>s or temples — with well-washed hands, feet, and face, seated in <s>vīrāsana</s> (hero's posture) facing east, having sipped water with 'May the living ones [thrive],' having sprinkled with 'O Waters indeed,' having performed <s>prāṇāyāma</s> (breath-control), having sipped water, then rising — with the waters held in the right hand, 'The waters from iron mesh' — he should release the waters in many directions.

body.text:
(AVParis_41,1.4) hariḥ suparṇa iti prātar
(AVParis_41,1.5) ud u tyaṃ citraṃ devānām iti madhyaṃdine
(AVParis_41,1.6) atha sauramantrān yathākāmaṃ japed

children.text: (AVParis_41,1.7) ud vayaṃ tamasas parīti ca
children.translated_text: 'We have risen above the darkness' — and [this verse also].

children.text: (AVParis_41,1.8) ud ghed abhi śrutāmagham ity astamita āsīnaḥ
children.translated_text: 'Up, renowned, with unfading [splendor]' — seated when the sun has set.

children.text: (AVParis_41,1.9) sāvitryante vāñjalayo japaś ca ||
children.translated_text: At the end of the <s>Sāvitrī</s>, the offerings with cupped hands and the recitation.

body.translated_text: '<s>Hari</s>, the golden eagle' — in the morning; 'Up that wondrous one of the gods' — at midday; then he should recite the solar <s>mantra</s>s as he wishes.

body.text:
(AVParis_41,2.1) athordhvajānur āsīna iti vīrāsanī
(AVParis_41,2.2) pratyutthāyābhayaṃ paścād abhayaṃ purastād ity upatiṣṭhate
(AVParis_41,2.3) tiṣṭhan prātaḥ prāṅmukha

children.text: (AVParis_41,2.4) āyātu varadety āvāhya
children.translated_text: 'May the boon-granting one come' — having invoked,

children.text: (AVParis_41,2.5) gāyatraṃ chandaḥ savitā devatā viśvāmitra ṛṣir
children.translated_text: The meter is <s>Gāyatra</s>; the deity is <s>Savitṛ</s>; the <s>ṛṣi</s> is <s>Viśvāmitra</s>.

children.text: (AVParis_41,2.6) yathākṣaraṃ daivataṃ rūpaṃ ca manasi samādhāya mahāvyāhṛtibhiḥ saṃdhāya gāyatrīṃ japet ||
children.translated_text: Having meditated in the mind on each syllable, its deity and form, having joined with the great <s>Vyāhṛti</s>s, he should recite the <s>Gāyatrī</s>.

body.translated_text: Then, 'Seated with knees raised' — in <s>vīrāsana</s>; having risen, 'Fearlessness from behind,' 'Fearlessness from the front' — he worships; standing, in the morning, facing east.

body.text: (AVParis_41,2.7) aṣṭakṛtva ekādaśakṛtvo dvādaśakṛtvaḥ pañcadaśakṛtvaḥ śatakṛtvaḥ sahasrakṛtva iti ||
body.translated_text: Eight times, eleven times, twelve times, fifteen times, a hundred times, or a thousand times.

body.text: (AVParis_41,2.8) aṣṭakṛtvaḥ prayuktā gāyatrī gāyatreṇa chandasā saṃmitā bhūlokam abhijayati ||
body.translated_text: The <s>Gāyatrī</s> employed eight times, measured by the <s>Gāyatra</s> meter, conquers the <s>Bhūloka</s> (earthly world).

body.text: (AVParis_41,2.9) ekādaśakṛtvaḥ prayuktā traiṣṭubhena chandasā saṃmitāntarikṣalokam abhijayati ||
body.translated_text: Employed eleven times, measured by the <s>Traiṣṭubha</s> meter, it conquers the <s>Antarikṣaloka</s> (atmospheric world).

body.text: (AVParis_41,2.10) dvādaśakṛtvaḥ prayuktā jāgatena chandasā saṃmitā divaṃ lokam abhijayati ||
body.translated_text: Employed twelve times, measured by the <s>Jāgata</s> meter, it conquers the <s>Divaloka</s> (heavenly world).

body.text: (AVParis_41,2.11) pañcadaśakṛtvaḥ prayuktā pañcadaśena vajreṇa saṃmitā brahmalokam abhijayati ||
body.translated_text: Employed fifteen times, measured by the fifteen-jointed thunderbolt, it conquers the <s>Brahmaloka</s> (world of <s>Brahman</s>).

body.text: (AVParis_41,2.12) śatakṛtvaḥ prayuktā śataparvaṇā vajreṇa saṃmitā sarvāṇl lokān abhijayati ||
body.translated_text: Employed a hundred times, measured by the hundred-jointed thunderbolt, it conquers all the worlds.

body.text: (AVParis_41,2.13) sahasrakṛtvaḥ prayuktāgniṣṭomāptoryāmādīnāṃ kratūnāṃ phalam avāpnoti ||
body.translated_text: Employed a thousand times, one obtains the fruit of the <s>Agniṣṭoma</s>, <s>Aptoryāma</s>, and other sacrifices.

body.text: (AVParis_41,3.1) ato yathākāmaṃ japitvā paśyema śaradaḥ śatam indra jīvety āśiṣaḥ prārthayate ||
body.translated_text: Then, having recited as much as one wishes, 'May we see a hundred autumns,' 'O <s>Indra</s>, may we live' — he prays for blessings.

body.text: (AVParis_41,3.2) stutā mayā varadeti visṛjyodīrāṇā uta sūryasyāvṛtam asapatnaṃ purastād yasmāt kośād iti yathārtham upatiṣṭhate ||
body.translated_text: 'Praised by me, O boon-granting one' — having dismissed; 'The risen one,' 'And of the sun,' 'The unchallenged [space] to the east,' 'From which receptacle' — he worships as appropriate.

body.text: (AVParis_41,3.3) ya imāṃ na vindanti nādhīyate saṃdhyākāle nopāsate te hy aśrotriyā bhavanty anupanītāḥ kriyāhīnāś chedanabhedanabhojanamaithunāny abhicarantaḥ ||
body.translated_text: Those who do not find this, who do not study, who do not worship at the twilight time — they become non-<s>Śrotriya</s>s (unlearned), uninitiated, devoid of rites, engaging in cutting, splitting, eating, and sexual intercourse.

body.text: (AVParis_41,3.4) saṃdhyākāle hy ajapantaḥ śvasūkarasṛgālakukkuṭasarpayoniṣu varṣasahasrāṇi jāyante ||
body.translated_text: Those who do not recite at the twilight time are born in the wombs of dogs, pigs, jackals, roosters, and serpents for thousands of years.

body.text: (AVParis_41,3.5) samās tasyaivopajāyante ||
body.translated_text: Equal [years] are added to them.

body.text: (AVParis_41,3.6) tasmād yathoktāṃ sāyaṃ prātaḥ saṃdhyām upāsīta ||
body.translated_text: Therefore one should worship the <s>sandhyā</s> (twilight), evening and morning, as prescribed.

body.text: (AVParis_41,3.7) araṇyacarito guptaḥ śuklabrāhmaṇakarmasu | prāyeṇa labhate lokān yathoktāṃs tāṃ samācaran ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 41.3.7) One who dwells in the forest, hidden, engaged in the rites of the white (śukla) <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>s — by practicing those, he generally obtains the worlds as declared.

body.text: (AVParis_41,3.8) sāyaṃ saṃdhyām upāsīta kṛtavīrāsano dvijaḥ | kṛtottānas tathā prātaḥ prāñjaliḥ susamāhitaḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 41.3.8) The twice-born should worship the evening <s>sandhyā</s> (twilight) seated in the <s>vīrāsana</s> (hero's posture); and likewise the morning one, face upward, with palms joined, well-concentrated.

body.text: (AVParis_41,3.9) etad vīrāsanaṃ sthānaṃ brahmaṇā nirmitaṃ purā | dvijānaṃ bālavṛddhānāṃ puraścaraṇam uttamam ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 41.3.9) This hero's posture was created by <s>Brahmā</s> of old — the supreme preliminary practice for twice-born, both young and old.

body.text: (AVParis_41,3.10) sāyaṃ prātas tu yaḥ saṃdhyām askannām upatiṣṭhate | sa tayā pāvito devyā brāhmahaḥ pūtakilbiṣaḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 41.3.10) He who worships the <s>sandhyā</s> morning and evening without fail — purified by that goddess, even a slayer of a <s>Brāhmaṇa</s> is cleansed of sin.

body.text: (AVParis_41,3.11) na sīdet pratigṛhṇānaḥ pṛthvīm api sasāgarām | ye cāsya viṣamāḥ ke cid divi sūryādayo grahāḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 41.3.11) He would not fail even if accepting the entire earth with its oceans; and whatever adverse planets are his in heaven, beginning with the Sun,

body.text: (AVParis_41,3.12) te cāsya saumyā jāyante śivāḥ sukhakarāḥ sadā | sthānaṃ vīrāsanaṃ caeṣāṃ pṛthivī ca pradakṣiṇā | agnihotraṃ hutaṃ caiṣāṃ ye vai saṃdhyām upāsate ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 41.3.12) those become benign, auspicious, and always happiness-producing for him. The hero's posture is their station, and the earth their circumambulation; and the <s>agnihotra</s> is offered by those who worship the <s>sandhyā</s>.

body.text: (AVParis_41,4.1) ardhāstamita āditye ardhodite divākare | gāyatryās tatra sāṃnidhyaṃ saṃdhyākālaḥ sa ucyate ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 41.4.1) When the sun is half-set or half-risen — the presence of the <s>Gāyatrī</s> is there; that is called the <s>sandhyā</s>-time.

body.text: (AVParis_41,4.2) bhūmyādityāntaraṃ yas tu chādayec caturaṅgulam | tāṃ tu saṃdhyāṃ parāṃ vidyāc chāyāsaṃbhedane pare ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 41.4.2) That which covers the space between the earth and the sun by four finger-widths — that should be known as the supreme <s>sandhyā</s>, at the merging of the shadows in the other [twilight].

body.text: (AVParis_41,4.3) yāvantas tu karād bhraṣṭāḥ patanti jalabindavaḥ | bhūtvā vajrāṇi te sarve patanti hy asureṣu vai ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 41.4.3) However many water-drops fall from the hand [of one performing <s>sandhyā</s>] — all those, becoming thunderbolts, fall upon the <s>Asura</s>s indeed.

body.text: (AVParis_41,4.4) tato vibhāvasus teṣāṃ prītātmāpyāyate varam | yair ahaṃ mokṣito viprais teṣāṃ loko tathā mama ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 41.4.4) Then <s>Vibhāvasu</s> (Fire/Sun), pleased in spirit, nourishes them well: 'Those <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>s by whom I have been freed — their world is mine as well.'

body.text: (AVParis_41,4.5) gāyatryā akṣamālāyāṃ sāyaṃ prātaḥ śataṃ japet | caturṇāṃ khalu vedānāṃ samagraṃ labhate phalam ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 41.4.5) Of the <s>Gāyatrī</s>, on a prayer-bead rosary, one should recite a hundred times, morning and evening; one indeed obtains the complete fruit of the four <s>Veda</s>s.

body.text: (AVParis_41,4.6) saṃdhyāṃ ye nopatiṣṭhanti brāhmaṇyaṃ nopapadyate | upapadyeta vā bhūyo yadi syus tīrthamṛtyavaḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 41.4.6) Those who do not worship the <s>sandhyā</s> — the status of <s>Brāhmaṇa</s> does not befit them; or it might befit them again if they were to die at a holy pilgrimage site.

body.text: (AVParis_41,4.8) ṛṣayo dīrghasaṃdhyatvād dīrghāṇy āyumṣy adhārayan | tasmād dīrghām upāsīta samicchan vṛddhim āyuṣaḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 41.4.8) The <s>Ṛṣi</s>s (sages), through long <s>sandhyā</s> practice, maintained long lives; therefore one desiring increase of life should practice a long <s>sandhyā</s>.

body.text: (AVParis_41,5.1) tad yathāgnir devānāṃ brāhmaṇo manuṣyāṇāṃ vasanta ṛtūnām evaṃ gāyatrī chandasām ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 41.5.1) Just as <s>Agni</s> (Fire) is [foremost] among the gods, <s>Brāhmaṇa</s> among humans, spring among the seasons — so is the <s>Gāyatrī</s> among meters.

body.text: (AVParis_41,5.2) tad yathā gāyatrī katyakṣarā katipadā kiṃ vāsyā gotraṃ kiṃ vāsya rūpaṃ kīdṛśaṃ tasyāḥ śarīraṃ bhavati ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 41.5.2) Now, the <s>Gāyatrī</s> — how many syllables has it, how many feet, what is its lineage, what is its form, what is the nature of its body?

body.text:
(AVParis_41,5.3) yad vai bhūḥ sa ṛgvedo yad bhuva iti so 'tharvaveda iti
(AVParis_41,5.4) tad yathedam akṣaram om ity akṣaraṃ tat paramaṃ śam ity akṣaraṃ guhyaṃ tat paramaṃ pavitram ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 41.5.3-4) That which is '<s>Bhūḥ</s>' — that is the <s>Ṛgveda</s>; that which is '<s>Bhuvaḥ</s>' — that is the <s>Atharvaveda</s>. Just as this syllable 'Oṃ' is the supreme syllable; 'Śam' is the secret syllable — that is the supreme purifier.

body.text: (AVParis_41,5.5) ādityo vai sāvitry ādityena saha sāvitrī stauti suvati prātaḥ prasuvati tasmāt sāvitrīt<v>am ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 41.5.5) The Sun is indeed <s>Sāvitrī</s>; together with the Sun, <s>Sāvitrī</s> praises, impels in the morning, generates — therefore it is called <s>Sāvitrī</s>.

body.text:
(AVParis_41,5.6) akṣaradaivataṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ
(AVParis_41,5.7) prathamam āgneyaṃ dvitīyam āśvinaṃ tṛtīyaṃ saumyaṃ caturthaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ sāvitraṃ pañcamaṃ ṣaṣṭhaṃ pauṣṇaṃ saptamaṃ mārutam aṣṭamaṃ bārhaspatyaṃ navamaṃ maitraṃ daśamaṃ vāruṇam ekādaśam aindraṃ dvādaśaṃ vaiśvadevaṃ vasūnāṃ trayodaśaṃ caturdaśaṃ rudrāṇāṃ pañcadaśam ādityānām aditeḥ ṣoḍaśaṃ vāyavyaṃ saptadaśamaṃ bhaumam aṣṭādaśam ekonaviṃśam āntarikṣaṃ divyaṃ viṃśaṃ digdevatāni catvāry akṣarāṇi ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 41.5.6-7) We shall explain the deities of the syllables: the first belongs to <s>Agni</s>, the second to the <s>Aśvin</s>s, the third to <s>Soma</s>, the fourth to <s>Viṣṇu</s>, the fifth to <s>Savitṛ</s>, the sixth to <s>Pūṣan</s>, the seventh to <s>Marut</s>s, the eighth to <s>Bṛhaspati</s>, the ninth to <s>Mitra</s>, the tenth to <s>Varuṇa</s>, the eleventh to <s>Indra</s>, the twelfth to the <s>Viśvedeva</s>s, the thirteenth to the <s>Vasu</s>s, the fourteenth to the <s>Rudra</s>s, the fifteenth to the <s>Āditya</s>s, the sixteenth to <s>Aditi</s>, the seventeenth to <s>Vāyu</s>, the eighteenth to the Earth, the nineteenth to the Atmosphere, the twentieth to Heaven — and four syllables belong to the directional deities.

body.text: (AVParis_41,6.1) atha yat pūrvāṃ saṃdhyām upāste tad gāyatryāḥ śiras tena pṛthivīṃ jayati ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 41.6.1) Now, when one worships the morning <s>sandhyā</s> — that is the head of <s>Gāyatrī</s>; by that one conquers the earth.

body.text: (AVParis_41,6.2) atha yan madhyāhne tīkṣṇaṃ rudras tapati <tad> dvitīyaṃ śiras tenāntarikṣaṃ jayati ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 41.6.2) When at midday the fierce <s>Rudra</s> burns — that is the second head; by that one conquers the atmosphere.

body.text: (AVParis_41,6.3) atha yad astamiyāt tat tṛtīyaṃ śiras tena divaṃ jayati ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 41.6.3) When [the sun] sets — that is the third head; by that one conquers heaven.

body.text:
(AVParis_41,6.4) tasyā oṃkāraḥ śiraḥ saha vyāhṛtibhir darbhāḥ keśā oṣadhīvanaspatayo lomāni cakṣuṣī sūryācandramasau vidyud dhasitaṃ viṣṇuvaruṇau urasī rudro hṛdaye paurṇamāsī cāmāvāsyā ca stanau ahaś ca rātrī ca pārśve
(AVParis_41,6.5) daśa diśaḥ kukṣī sarvajñānāni vyākaraṇam udaraṃ pṛthivī śroṇī vāyuḥ sthānaṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ nakṣatrāṇi śrīsarasvatīrūpā padakramamantrabrāhmaṇakalpaśarīrā sāvitrī gotreṇa brahmadeyā bhavati brahmadeyā bhavatīti brāhmaṇam ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 41.6.4-5) Her head is the <s>Oṃkāra</s> together with the <s>Vyāhṛti</s>s; <s>darbha</s> grasses are her hair; herbs and trees are her body-hair; her two eyes are the Sun and Moon; lightning is her smile; <s>Viṣṇu</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s> are her breasts; <s>Rudra</s> is her heart; the full-moon and new-moon are her two breasts; day and night are her sides; the ten directions are her belly; all knowledge is her grammar; the earth is her hips; wind is her station; <s>nakṣatra</s>s are her ornaments; she is of the form of <s>Śrī</s> and <s>Sarasvatī</s>; her body is the word-by-word analysis, <s>mantra</s>, <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>, and ritual procedure of <s>Sāvitrī</s>; by lineage she is the gift of <s>Brahman</s> — she is the gift of <s>Brahman</s>. Thus the <s>Brāhmaṇa</s> [passage].

body.text:
(Pariśiṣṭa_42. snānavidhiḥ)
(AVParis_42,1.1) atha snānavidhiṃ puṇyaṃ vakṣyamāṇaṃ nibodhata | yena snātā divaṃ lokaṃ prāpnuvanti dvijottamāḥ ||
body.translated_text: (Pariśiṣṭa 42: Bathing Procedure) (AVParis 42.1.1) Now hear the auspicious bathing procedure that is to be described — by which twice-born, having bathed, attain the heavenly world.

body.text: (AVParis_42,1.2) saritsu vā taḍāge vā devakhāte hrade 'pi vā | gartaprasravaṇe vāpi puṇyaṃ snānaṃ samācaret ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 42.1.2) In rivers, or in a tank, or in a divinely-dug lake, or in a pool, or even in a pit with a spring — one should perform the auspicious bath.

body.text: (AVParis_42,1.3) pārakye tu tāḍāge hi snānaṃ naiva vidhīyate | taḍāgakartur duṣkṛtair lipyate snānam ācāran ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 42.1.3) In another's tank, however, bathing is not prescribed; one performing bathing becomes tainted by the evil deeds of the tank's builder.

body.text: (AVParis_42,1.4) saritāṃ sarasāṃ caiva aprāptau nirjharasya ca | uddhṛtya caturaḥ piṇḍān snāyāt tu parakhātake ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 42.1.4) When rivers, ponds, and even a waterfall are not accessible — having taken out four lumps [of earth], one may bathe in another's excavation.

body.text: (AVParis_42,1.5) anvīkṣyamāṇaḥ pārśvāni kuśahastaḥ samāhitaḥ | dvijo madhyaṃdinād arvāg arogī snānam ācaret ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 42.1.5) Examining the sides, with <s>kuśa</s> grass in hand, concentrated — a twice-born, in good health, should perform the bath before midday.

body.text: (AVParis_42,1.6) yat te bhūma iti mṛdaṃ saṃgṛhya rcā samāhitaḥ | yas te gandha iti tribhir mṛdhir ātmānam ālabhet ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 42.1.6) Having gathered earth [reciting] 'yat te bhūma' (What is your earth), concentrated with the verse — [reciting] 'yas te gandhaḥ' (What is your fragrance), he should touch himself with three [lumps of] earth.

body.text: (AVParis_42,1.7) aghadviṣṭeti sūktena dūrvāṃ śirasi vinyaset | agramagram ity etayā gomayenānulepayet ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 42.1.7) With the hymn 'aghadviṣṭa' (hater of sin), one should place <s>dūrvā</s> grass on the head; with 'agramagram' (tip by tip), one should anoint with cow-dung.

body.text: (AVParis_42,1.8) agramagraṃ carantīnām oṣadhīnāṃ vanevane | yan me rogaṃ ca śokaṃ ca tan me tvaṃ nuda gomaya ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 42.1.8) 'Tip by tip, moving among the herbs, forest by forest — whatever disease and grief is mine, that do you, O cow-dung, remove from me.'

body.text: (AVParis_42,1.9) praṇavādyā vyāhṛtīs tu gāyatrīṃ ca śiroyutām | paṭhet trir anavānaṃ hi prāṇāyāmaḥ sa ucyate ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 42.1.9) Beginning with <s>Praṇava</s> (Oṃ), the <s>Vyāhṛti</s>s, and the <s>Gāyatrī</s> together with the head — one should recite three times without a break; that is called <s>prāṇāyāma</s> (breath-control).

body.text: (AVParis_42,1.10) ambayo yantīty ādīni trīṇi sūktāni hi kramāt | hiraṇyavarṇā yad ado vāyoḥ pūtaḥ punantu mā ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 42.1.10) 'Ambayo yanti' (The mothers flow) and the other three hymns, in order; '<s>Hiraṇyavarṇāḥ</s>' (Golden-hued); 'yad ado vāyoḥ pūtaḥ punantu mā' (May those purified by the wind purify me).

body.text: (AVParis_42,2.1) vaiśvānaro raśmibhiś ca tathāpsu ta iti smṛtam | etaiḥ saṃplāvayet sūktais tato 'ghamarṣaṇam ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 42.2.1) '<s>Vaiśvānara</s>, with rays' and also 'āpsu ta' (in the waters) — thus it is remembered. With these hymns one should immerse, then [recite] the <s>Aghamarṣaṇa</s> (sin-destroying [hymn]).

body.text: (AVParis_42,2.2) apo divyāś ca saṃ māgne idam āpaḥ śivena mā | yad āpo naktam iti ca etat syād aghamarṣaṇam ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 42.2.2) 'Āpo divyāḥ' (O divine waters); 'ca saṃ mā agne' (and be favorable to me, O <s>Agni</s>); 'idam āpaḥ śivena mā' (These waters, with auspiciousness for me); 'yad āpo naktam' (Whatever at night, O waters) — this constitutes the <s>Aghamarṣaṇa</s>.

body.text: (AVParis_42,2.3) yad āpo naktaṃ mithunaṃ cakāra yad vā dudroha duritaṃ purāṇam | hiraṇyavarṇās tata ut punantu pra mā muñcantu varuṇasya pāśāt ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 42.2.3) 'Whatever coupling the waters performed at night, or whatever ancient sin was committed — may the golden-hued waters purify me from that; may they free me from <s>Varuṇa</s>'s noose.'

body.text: (AVParis_42,2.4) sarasvatīṃ gayāṃ gaṅgāṃ naimiṣaṃ puṣkarāṇi ca | smṛtvā tīrthānipuṇyātni avagāhej jalaṃ tataḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 42.2.4) Having remembered <s>Sarasvatī</s>, <s>Gayā</s>, <s>Gaṅgā</s>, <s>Naimiṣa</s>, and the <s>Puṣkara</s> lakes and other holy sites — one should then enter the water.

body.text: (AVParis_42,2.5) gacchataḥ snānakāryāya pitaraḥ saha daivataiḥ | pṛṣṭhataḥ tv anugacchanti tatsamīpaṃ jalārthinaḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 42.2.5) When one goes for the purpose of bathing, the ancestors together with the deities follow from behind, seeking water nearby.

body.text: (AVParis_42,2.6) āśāṃ tyaktvā nivartante vastraniṣpīḍanena tu | tasmān na pīḍayed vastram akṛtvā pitṛtarpaṇam ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 42.2.6) Having abandoned their hope, they return when one wrings the garment; therefore one should not wring the garment without having performed the offering to the ancestors.

body.text: (AVParis_42,2.7) utsāhaṃ varuṇaḥ snāne agnir hotuḥ śriyaṃ haret | āyuṣyaṃ bhuñjato mṛtyus triṣu maunam ataś caret ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 42.2.7) <s>Varuṇa</s> takes away the enthusiasm of one bathing; <s>Agni</s> takes away the glory of the officiant; Death [takes away] the life-span of one eating — therefore one should observe silence in these three [activities].

body.text: (AVParis_42,2.8cd) snānavastre mṛdas tisraḥ pradadyāc chuddhihetunā | 8ab | snātvā paryukṣya vāso 'nyac chodhye jaṅghe mṛdā punaḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 42.2.8) One should apply three [lumps of] earth to the bathing-garment for the purpose of purification. Having bathed and sprinkled, one should [put on] another garment; and [wash] the legs again with earth at the pure [place].

body.text: (AVParis_42,2.9) vastraniṣpīḍatoyena apavitrīkṛte hi te | uttirya vastraṃ niṣpīḍya japed ādhyātmikāni tu ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 42.2.9) For they are made impure by the water from wringing the garment. Having come out and wrung the garment, one should recite the spiritual (<s>ādhyātmika</s>) [hymns].

body.text: (AVParis_42,2.10) adhyātmam asyavāmīyaṃ kautsaṃ kauṣmāṇḍikaṃ tathā | japtvātharvaśiraś caiva bhavāśarvīyam eva ca ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 42.2.10) The spiritual [hymns are]: <s>Asyavāmīya</s>, <s>Kautsa</s>, <s>Kauṣmāṇḍika</s>, and likewise, having recited the <s>Atharvaśiras</s> and the <s>Bhavāśarvīya</s>,

body.text: (AVParis_42,2.11) prāṇāś ca bhagavān kālaḥ puruṣo manyur eva ca | ucchiṣṭo rohito vrātya etāny ādhyātmikāni tu ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 42.2.11) '<s>Prāṇāḥ</s>' (Vital breaths) and the blessed <s>Kāla</s> (Time), <s>Puruṣa</s> (Cosmic Person), <s>Manyu</s> (Wrath), <s>Ucchiṣṭa</s> (Remnant), <s>Rohita</s> (Red One), <s>Vrātya</s> (Wanderer) — these are the spiritual [hymns].

body.text: (AVParis_42,2.12) saṃvatsareṇa yat pāpaṃ kṛtaṃ ghoram avistaram | japtvaitāni tataḥ pāpān mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 42.2.12) Whatever terrible sin has been committed in a year, broadly — having recited these, one is freed from sins; there is no doubt in this.

body.text: (AVParis_42,2.13) viṣāsahiṃ manasā hi japtvā gāyatrīṃ ca tathā tridivaṃ prāyāti | paribhraṣṭas tridivāt tapaḥkṣaye jātismaratvaṃ punar eva vindate ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 42.2.13) Having recited in the mind 'viṣāsahim' (the conqueror of poison) and the <s>Gāyatrī</s>, one goes to the third heaven; fallen from the third heaven when merit is exhausted, one obtains the memory of past births once again.

body.text:
(Pariśiṣṭa_43. tarpaṇavidhiḥ)
(AVParis_43,1.1) om atha tarpaṇavidhim anukramiṣyāmaḥ ||
body.translated_text: (Pariśiṣṭa 43: <s>Tarpaṇa</s> Procedure [Water-Libation]) (AVParis 43.1.1) Oṃ. Now we shall describe the <s>tarpaṇa</s> (water-libation) procedure.

body.text: (AVParis_43,1.2) snātopasparśanakāle 'vagāhya devatās tarpayati ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 43.1.2) At the time of touching [the water] after bathing, having immersed, one satisfies the deities:

body.text:
(AVParis_43,1.3) vasūnāṃ namo
(AVParis_43,1.4) brahmaṇe namo
(AVParis_43,1.5) vaiśravaṇāya namo
(AVParis_43,1.6) dharmāya namaḥ
(AVParis_43,1.7) kāmāya namo
(AVParis_43,1.8) lokāya amo
(AVParis_43,1.9) devāya namo
(AVParis_43,1.10) vedāya nama
(AVParis_43,1.11) ṛṣibhyo nama
(AVParis_43,1.12) ārṣeyebhyo namo
(AVParis_43,1.13) aṅgirobhyo nama
(AVParis_43,1.14) āṅgirasebhyo namo
(AVParis_43,1.15) atharvebhyo nama
(AVParis_43,1.16) ātharvaṇebhyo namo
(AVParis_43,1.17) marudbhyo namo
(AVParis_43,1.18) mārutebhyo amo
(AVParis_43,1.19) vasubhyo namo
(AVParis_43,1.20) rudrebhyo nama
(AVParis_43,1.21) ādityebhyo namaḥ
(AVParis_43,1.22) siddhebhyo namaḥ
(AVParis_43,1.23) sādhyebhyo nama
(AVParis_43,1.24) āpyebhyo namo
(AVParis_43,1.25) aśvibhyāṃ namo
(AVParis_43,1.26) gurubhyo namo

children.text: (AVParis_43,1.27) gurupatnībhyo namaḥ
children.translated_text: (AVParis 43.1.27) 'Homage to the wives of the <s>Guru</s>s!'

children.text: (AVParis_43,1.28) pitṛbhyo namo
children.translated_text: (AVParis 43.1.28) 'Homage to the fathers!'

children.text: (AVParis_43,1.29) mātṛbhyo namaḥ ||
children.translated_text: (AVParis 43.1.29) 'Homage to the mothers!'

body.translated_text: (AVParis 43.1.3-26) 'Homage to the <s>Vasu</s>s! Homage to <s>Brahman</s>! Homage to <s>Vaiśravaṇa</s> (<s>Kubera</s>)! Homage to <s>Dharma</s>! Homage to <s>Kāma</s> (Desire)! Homage to the World! Homage to the God! Homage to the <s>Veda</s>! Homage to the <s>Ṛṣi</s>s! Homage to the descendants of the <s>Ṛṣi</s>s! Homage to the <s>Aṅgiras</s>es! Homage to the descendants of the <s>Aṅgiras</s>es! Homage to the <s>Atharvan</s>s! Homage to the descendants of the <s>Atharvan</s>s! Homage to the <s>Marut</s>s! Homage to the descendants of the <s>Marut</s>s! Homage to the <s>Vasu</s>s! Homage to the <s>Rudra</s>s! Homage to the <s>Āditya</s>s! Homage to the <s>Siddha</s>s (Perfected Ones)! Homage to the <s>Sādhya</s>s (Celestial Beings)! Homage to the <s>Āpya</s>s (Water Deities)! Homage to the two <s>Aśvin</s>s! Homage to the <s>Guru</s>s (Teachers)!'

body.text: (AVParis_43,2.1) agnis tṛpyatu ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 43.2.1) 'May <s>Agni</s> be satisfied!'

body.text: (AVParis_43,2.2) vāyus tṛpyatu ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 43.2.2) 'May <s>Vāyu</s> be satisfied!'

body.text: (AVParis_43,2.3) sūryas tṛpyatu ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 43.2.3) 'May <s>Sūrya</s> (the Sun) be satisfied!'

body.text: (AVParis_43,2.4) viṣṇus tṛpyatu ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 43.2.4) 'May <s>Viṣṇu</s> be satisfied!'

body.text: (AVParis_43,2.5) prajāpatis tṛpyatu ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 43.2.5) 'May <s>Prajāpati</s> be satisfied!'

body.text: (AVParis_43,2.6) virūpākṣas tṛpyatu ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 43.2.6) 'May <s>Virūpākṣa</s> (the Odd-Eyed One) be satisfied!'

body.text: (AVParis_43,2.7) sahasrākṣas tṛpyatu ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 43.2.7) 'May <s>Sahasrākṣa</s> (the Thousand-Eyed One) be satisfied!'

body.text: (AVParis_43,2.8) somas tṛpyatu ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 43.2.8) 'May <s>Soma</s> be satisfied!'

body.text: (AVParis_43,2.9) brahmā tṛpyatu ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 43.2.9) 'May <s>Brahmā</s> be satisfied!'

body.text: (AVParis_43,2.10) devās tṛpyantu ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 43.2.10) 'May the gods be satisfied!'

body.text: (AVParis_43,2.11) vedās tṛpyantu ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 43.2.11) 'May the <s>Veda</s>s be satisfied!'

body.text: (AVParis_43,2.12) ṛṣayas tṛpyantu ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 43.2.12) 'May the <s>Ṛṣi</s>s (sages) be satisfied!'

body.text: (AVParis_43,2.13) ārṣeyās tṛpyantu ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 43.2.13) 'May the descendants of the <s>Ṛṣi</s>s be satisfied!'

body.text: (AVParis_43,2.14) sarvāṇi chandāṃsi tṛpyantu ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 43.2.14) 'May all the meters be satisfied!'

body.text: (AVParis_43,2.15) omkāravaṣaṭkārau tṛpyatām ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 43.2.15) 'May the <s>Oṃkāra</s> and the <s>Vaṣaṭkāra</s> be satisfied!'

body.text: (AVParis_43,2.16) mahāvyāhṛtayas tṛpyantu ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 43.2.16) 'May the <s>Mahāvyāhṛti</s>s (Great Ritual Exclamations) be satisfied!'

body.text: (AVParis_43,2.17) sāvitrī tṛpyantu ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 43.2.17) 'May <s>Sāvitrī</s> be satisfied!'

body.text: (AVParis_43,2.18) gāyatrī tṛpyatu ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 43.2.18) 'May <s>Gāyatrī</s> be satisfied!'

body.text: (AVParis_43,2.19) dyāvāpṛthivyau tṛpyatām ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 43.2.19) 'May Heaven and Earth be satisfied!'

body.text: (AVParis_43,2.20) yajñās tṛpyantu ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 43.2.20) 'May the sacrifices be satisfied!'

body.text: (AVParis_43,2.21) grahās tṛpyantu ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 43.2.21) 'May the planets be satisfied!'

body.text: (AVParis_43,2.22) nakṣatrāṇi tṛpyantu ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 43.2.22) 'May the <s>nakṣatra</s>s (lunar mansions) be satisfied!'

body.text: (AVParis_43,2.23) antarikṣaṃ tṛpyatu ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 43.2.23) 'May the atmosphere be satisfied!'

body.text: (AVParis_43,2.24) ahorātrāṇi tṛpyantu ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 43.2.24) 'May the days and nights be satisfied!'

body.text: (AVParis_43,2.25) saṃkhyās tṛpyantu ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 43.2.25) 'May the numbers be satisfied!'

body.text: (AVParis_43,2.26) saṃdhyās tṛpyantu ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 43.2.26) 'May the <s>sandhyā</s>s (twilight junctions) be satisfied!'

body.text: (AVParis_43,2.27) samudrās tṛpyantu ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 43.2.27) 'May the oceans be satisfied!'

body.text: (AVParis_43,2.28) nadyas tṛpyantu ||
body.translated_text: May the rivers be satisfied!

body.text: (AVParis_43,2.29) girayas tṛpyantu ||
body.translated_text: May the mountains be satisfied!

body.text: (AVParis_43,2.30) keṣetrauṣadhivanaspatayas tṛpyantu ||
body.translated_text: May the fields, herbs, and forest-trees be satisfied!

body.text: (AVParis_43,2.31) gandharvāpsarasas tṛpyantu ||
body.translated_text: May the <s>Gandharva</s>s and <s>Apsaras</s>es be satisfied!

body.text: (AVParis_43,2.32) nāgās tṛpyantu ||
body.translated_text: May the <s>Nāga</s>s (serpents) be satisfied!

body.text: (AVParis_43,2.33) vayāṃsi tṛpyantu ||
body.translated_text: May the birds be satisfied!

body.text: (AVParis_43,2.34) siddhās tṛpyantu ||
body.translated_text: May the <s>Siddha</s>s (perfected ones) be satisfied!

body.text: (AVParis_43,2.35) sādhyās tṛpyantu ||
body.translated_text: May the <s>Sādhya</s>s (fulfilled ones) be satisfied!

body.text: (AVParis_43,2.36) viprās tṛpyantu ||
body.translated_text: May the <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>s be satisfied!

body.text: (AVParis_43,2.37) yakṣās tṛpyantu ||
body.translated_text: May the <s>Yakṣa</s>s be satisfied!

body.text: (AVParis_43,2.38) rakṣāṃsi tṛpyantu ||
body.translated_text: May the <s>Rākṣasa</s>s be satisfied!

body.text: (AVParis_43,2.39) mantrās tṛpyantu ||
body.translated_text: May the mantras be satisfied!

body.text: (AVParis_43,2.40) bhūtāny evamādīni tṛpyantu ||
body.translated_text: May the beings and all such [entities] be satisfied!

body.text: (AVParis_43,2.41) śrutiṃ tarpayāmi ||
body.translated_text: I satisfy <s>Śruti</s> (Sacred Revelation).

body.text: (AVParis_43,2.42) smṛtiṃ tarpayāmi ||
body.translated_text: I satisfy <s>Smṛti</s> (Sacred Tradition).

body.text: (AVParis_43,2.43) dhṛtiṃ tarpayāmi ||
body.translated_text: I satisfy <s>Dhṛti</s> (Steadfastness).

body.text: (AVParis_43,2.44) ratiṃ tarpayāmi ||
body.translated_text: I satisfy <s>Rati</s> (Delight).

body.text: (AVParis_43,2.45) gatiṃ tarpayāmi ||
body.translated_text: I satisfy <s>Gati</s> (Movement).

body.text: (AVParis_43,2.46) matiṃ tarpayāmi ||
body.translated_text: I satisfy <s>Mati</s> (Intellect).

body.text: (AVParis_43,2.47) diśaṃ tarpayāmi ||
body.translated_text: I satisfy the Direction.

body.text: (AVParis_43,2.48) vidiśaṃ tarpayāmi ||
body.translated_text: I satisfy the Intermediate Direction.

body.text: (AVParis_43,2.49) śraddhāmedhe tarpayāmi ||
body.translated_text: I satisfy <s>Śraddhā</s> (Faith) and <s>Medhā</s> (Wisdom).

body.text: (AVParis_43,2.50) dhāraṇāṃ tarpayāmi ||
body.translated_text: I satisfy <s>Dhāraṇā</s> (Retention).

body.text: (AVParis_43,2.51) gobrāhmaṇāṃs tarpayāmi ||
body.translated_text: I satisfy cows and <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>s.

body.text: (AVParis_43,2.52) sthāvarajaṅgamāni tarpayāmi ||
body.translated_text: I satisfy the stationary and the moving [beings].

body.text: (AVParis_43,2.53) sarvān devāṃs tarpayāmi ||
body.translated_text: I satisfy all the gods.

body.text: (AVParis_43,2.54) sarvabhūtāni tarpayāmi ||
body.translated_text: I satisfy all beings.

body.text:
(AVParis_43,3.1) yajñopavītaṃ grīvāyām avalambya sanakādimanuṣyāṃs tarpayati || sanakas tṛpyatu
(AVParis_43,3.2) sanandanas tṛpyatu ||
body.translated_text: Then, hanging the sacred thread on the neck, he satisfies the sages beginning with <s>Sanaka</s>: May <s>Sanaka</s> be satisfied! May <s>Sanandana</s> be satisfied!

body.text: (AVParis_43,3.3) sanātanas tṛpyatu ||
body.translated_text: May <s>Sanātana</s> be satisfied!

body.text: (AVParis_43,3.4) kapilas tṛpyatu ||
body.translated_text: May <s>Kapila</s> be satisfied!

body.text: (AVParis_43,3.5) voḍhas tṛpyatu ||
body.translated_text: May <s>Voḍha</s> be satisfied!

body.text: (AVParis_43,3.6) āsuris tṛpyatu ||
body.translated_text: May <s>Āsuri</s> be satisfied!

body.text: (AVParis_43,3.7) pañcaśikhas tṛpyatu ||
body.translated_text: May <s>Pañcaśikha</s> be satisfied!

body.text: (AVParis_43,3.8) sanandanaṃ tarpayāmi ||
body.translated_text: I satisfy <s>Sanandana</s>.

body.text: (AVParis_43,3.9) sasanakaṃ tarpayāmi ||
body.translated_text: I satisfy [him] together with <s>Sanaka</s>.

body.text: (AVParis_43,3.10) vidvāṃsaṃ sanātanaṃ tarpayāmi ||
body.translated_text: I satisfy the wise <s>Sanātana</s>.

body.text: (AVParis_43,3.11) sanatkumāraṃ tarpayāmi ||
body.translated_text: I satisfy <s>Sanatkumāra</s>.

body.text: (AVParis_43,3.12) sanakaṃ tarpayāmi ||
body.translated_text: I satisfy <s>Sanaka</s>.

body.text: (AVParis_43,3.13) sahadevaṃ sanātanaṃ tarpayāmi ||
body.translated_text: I satisfy <s>Sahadeva</s> and <s>Sanātana</s>.

body.text: (AVParis_43,3.14) plutiṃ tarpayāmi ||
body.translated_text: I satisfy <s>Pluti</s>.

body.text: (AVParis_43,3.15) pulastyaṃ tarpayāmi ||
body.translated_text: I satisfy <s>Pulastya</s>.

body.text: (AVParis_43,3.16) pulahaṃ tarpayāmi ||
body.translated_text: I satisfy <s>Pulaha</s>.

body.text: (AVParis_43,3.17) bhṛguṃ tarpayāmi ||
body.translated_text: I satisfy <s>Bhṛgu</s>.

body.text: (AVParis_43,3.18) aṅgirasaṃ tarpayāmi ||
body.translated_text: I satisfy <s>Aṅgiras</s>.

body.text: (AVParis_43,3.19) marīciṃ tarpayāmi ||
body.translated_text: I satisfy <s>Marīci</s>.

body.text: (AVParis_43,3.20) kratuṃ tarpayāmi ||
body.translated_text: I satisfy <s>Kratu</s>.

body.text: (AVParis_43,3.21) dakṣaṃ tarpayāmi ||
body.translated_text: I satisfy <s>Dakṣa</s>.

body.text: (AVParis_43,3.22) atriṃ tarpayāmi ||
body.translated_text: I satisfy <s>Atri</s>.

body.text: (AVParis_43,3.23) vasiṣṭhaṃ tarpayāmi ||
body.translated_text: I satisfy <s>Vasiṣṭha</s>.

body.text: (AVParis_43,3.24) mānasāṃs tarpayāmi ||
body.translated_text: I satisfy the mind-born [sons of <s>Brahmā</s>].

body.text: (AVParis_43,3.25) añjalī dvirdviḥ ||
body.translated_text: Two handfuls each, twice.

body.text: (AVParis_43,4.1) athāpasavyaṃ kṛtvā pitryāṃ diśam īkṣamāṇaḥ śatarcinādyṛṣīṃs tarpayati || śatarcinas tṛpyantu ||
body.translated_text: Then, having made [the sacred thread] reversed (left-shouldered), looking toward the direction of the ancestors (south), he satisfies the <s>Ṛṣi</s>s beginning with <s>Śatarcin</s>: May the <s>Śatarcin</s>s (composers of hundred-versed hymns) be satisfied!

body.text: (AVParis_43,4.2) mādhyamikās tṛpyantu ||
body.translated_text: May the <s>Mādhyamika</s>s (middle [section composers]) be satisfied!

body.text: (AVParis_43,4.3) gṛtsamadas tṛpyatu ||
body.translated_text: May <s>Gṛtsamada</s> be satisfied!

body.text: (AVParis_43,4.4) viśvāmitras tṛpyatu ||
body.translated_text: May <s>Viśvāmitra</s> be satisfied!

body.text: (AVParis_43,4.5) aghamarṣaṇas tṛpyatu ||
body.translated_text: May <s>Aghamarṣaṇa</s> be satisfied!

body.text: (AVParis_43,4.6) vāmadevas tṛpyatu ||
body.translated_text: May <s>Vāmadeva</s> be satisfied!

body.text: (AVParis_43,4.7) atris tṛpyatu ||
body.translated_text: May <s>Atri</s> be satisfied!

body.text: (AVParis_43,4.8) bharadvājas tṛpyatu ||
body.translated_text: May <s>Bharadvāja</s> be satisfied!

body.text: (AVParis_43,4.9) vasiṣṭhas tṛpyatu ||
body.translated_text: May <s>Vasiṣṭha</s> be satisfied!

body.text: (AVParis_43,4.10) pragāthās tṛpyantu ||
body.translated_text: May the <s>Pragātha</s>s be satisfied!

body.text: (AVParis_43,4.11) pāvamānyas tṛpyantu ||
body.translated_text: May the <s>Pāvamānī</s>s (purificatory hymns) be satisfied!

body.text: (AVParis_43,4.12) kṣudrasūktamahāsuktau tṛpyatām ||
body.translated_text: May the <s>Kṣudrasūkta</s> and <s>Mahāsūkta</s> (minor and major hymns) be satisfied!

body.text: (AVParis_43,4.13) śunas tṛpyatu ||
body.translated_text: May <s>Śuna</s> be satisfied!

body.text: (AVParis_43,4.14) jaiminis tṛpyatu ||
body.translated_text: May <s>Jaimini</s> be satisfied!

body.text: (AVParis_43,4.15) vaiśampāyanas tṛpyatu ||
body.translated_text: May <s>Vaiśampāyana</s> be satisfied!

body.text: (AVParis_43,4.16) pāṇinis tṛpyatu ||
