body.translated_text: May <s>Pāṇini</s> be satisfied!

body.text: (AVParis_43,4.17) pailas tṛpyatu ||
body.translated_text: May <s>Paila</s> be satisfied!

body.text: (AVParis_43,4.18) sumantus tṛpyatu ||
body.translated_text: May <s>Sumantu</s> be satisfied!

body.text: (AVParis_43,4.19) bhāṣyagārgyau tṛpyatām ||
body.translated_text: May <s>Bhāṣya</s> and <s>Gārgya</s> be satisfied!

body.text: (AVParis_43,4.20) babhrubābhravyau tṛpyatām ||
body.translated_text: May <s>Babhru</s> and <s>Bābhravya</s> be satisfied!

body.text: (AVParis_43,4.21) maṇḍumāṇḍavyau tṛpyatām ||
body.translated_text: May <s>Maṇḍu</s> and <s>Māṇḍavya</s> be satisfied!

body.text: (AVParis_43,4.22) gārgī tṛpyatu ||
body.translated_text: May <s>Gārgī</s> be satisfied!

body.text: (AVParis_43,4.23) vācaknavī tṛpyatu ||
body.translated_text: May <s>Vācaknavī</s> be satisfied!

body.text: (AVParis_43,4.24) vaḍavā tṛpyatu ||
body.translated_text: May <s>Vaḍavā</s> be satisfied!

body.text: (AVParis_43,4.25) prātitheyī tṛpyatu ||
body.translated_text: May <s>Prātitheyī</s> be satisfied!

body.text: (AVParis_43,4.26) sulabhā tṛpyatu ||
body.translated_text: May <s>Sulabhā</s> be satisfied!

body.text: (AVParis_43,4.27) maitreyī tṛpyatu ||
body.translated_text: May <s>Maitreyī</s> be satisfied!

body.text: (AVParis_43,4.28) kaholaṃ tarpayāmi ||
body.translated_text: I satisfy <s>Kahola</s>.

body.text:
(AVParis_43,4.29) kauṣītakiṃ tarpayāmi
(AVParis_43,4.30) mahākauṣītakiṃ tarpayāmi ||
body.translated_text: I satisfy <s>Kauṣītaki</s>. I satisfy <s>Mahākauṣītaki</s>.

body.text: (AVParis_43,4.31) suyajñaṃ tarpayāmi ||
body.translated_text: I satisfy <s>Suyajña</s>.

body.text: (AVParis_43,4.32) śāṅkhāyanaṃ tarpayāmi ||
body.translated_text: I satisfy <s>Śāṅkhāyana</s>.

body.text: (AVParis_43,4.33) mahāśāṅkhāyanaṃ tarpayāmi ||
body.translated_text: I satisfy <s>Mahāśāṅkhāyana</s>.

body.text: (AVParis_43,4.34) āśvalāyanaṃ tarpayāmi ||
body.translated_text: I satisfy <s>Āśvalāyana</s>.

body.text: (AVParis_43,4.35) aitareyaṃ tarpayāmi ||
body.translated_text: I satisfy <s>Aitareya</s>.

body.text: (AVParis_43,4.36) mahaitareyaṃ tarpayāmi ||
body.translated_text: I satisfy <s>Mahaitareya</s>.

body.text: (AVParis_43,4.37) paiṭhīnasiṃ tarpayāmi ||
body.translated_text: I satisfy <s>Paiṭhīnasi</s>.

body.text: (AVParis_43,4.38) madhuchandāṃsi tṛpyantu ||
body.translated_text: May the <s>Madhucchandas</s>es be satisfied!

body.text: (AVParis_43,4.39) bhāradvājaṃ tarpayāmi ||
body.translated_text: I satisfy <s>Bhāradvāja</s>.

body.text: (AVParis_43,4.40) jātūkarṇyaṃ tarpayāmi ||
body.translated_text: I satisfy <s>Jātūkarṇya</s>.

body.text: (AVParis_43,4.41) paiṅgyaṃ tarpayāmi ||
body.translated_text: I satisfy <s>Paiṅgya</s>.

body.text: (AVParis_43,4.42) mahāpaiṅgyaṃ tarpayāmi ||
body.translated_text: I satisfy <s>Mahāpaiṅgya</s>.

body.text: (AVParis_43,4.43) śākalaṃ tarpayāmi ||
body.translated_text: I satisfy <s>Śākala</s>.

body.text: (AVParis_43,4.44) bāṣkalaṃ tarpayāmi ||
body.translated_text: I satisfy <s>Bāṣkala</s>.

body.text: (AVParis_43,4.45) gārgyaṃ tarpayāmi ||
body.translated_text: I satisfy <s>Gārgya</s>.

body.text: (AVParis_43,4.46) māṇḍukeyaṃ tarpayāmi ||
body.translated_text: I satisfy <s>Māṇḍukeya</s>.

body.text: (AVParis_43,4.47) paiṅgyas tṛpyatu ||
body.translated_text: May <s>Paiṅgya</s> be satisfied!

body.text: (AVParis_43,4.48) mahāpaiṅgyas tṛpyatu ||
body.translated_text: May <s>Mahāpaiṅgya</s> be satisfied!

body.text: (AVParis_43,4.49) madamitraṃ tarpayāmi ||
body.translated_text: I satisfy <s>Madamitra</s>.

body.text: (AVParis_43,4.50) mahāmadamitraṃ tarpayāmi ||
body.translated_text: I satisfy <s>Mahāmadamitra</s>.

body.text: (AVParis_43,4.51) audavāhaṃ tarpayāmi ||
body.translated_text: I satisfy <s>Audavāha</s>.

body.text: (AVParis_43,4.52) sauyāmiṃ tarpayāmi ||
body.translated_text: I satisfy <s>Sauyāmin</s>.

body.text: (AVParis_43,4.53) śaunakiṃ tarpayāmi ||
body.translated_text: I satisfy <s>Śaunaki</s>.

body.text: (AVParis_43,4.54) paiṭhīnasiṃ tarpayāmi ||
body.translated_text: I satisfy <s>Paiṭhīnasi</s>.

body.text: (AVParis_43,4.55) mahāpaiṭhīnasiṃ tarpayāmi ||
body.translated_text: I satisfy <s>Mahāpaiṭhīnasi</s>.

body.text: (AVParis_43,4.56) śākapūṇiṃ tarpayāmi ||
body.translated_text: I satisfy <s>Śākapūṇi</s>.

body.text: (AVParis_43,4.57) ye cānya ācāryās tān sarvāṃs tarpayāmi ||
body.translated_text: And whatever other teachers there are — I satisfy all of them.

body.text: (AVParis_43,4.58) pratipuruṣaṃ pitaraḥ ||
body.translated_text: For each individual, the ancestors.

body.text: (AVParis_43,4.59) pitṛvaṃśas tṛpyatu ||
body.translated_text: May the paternal lineage be satisfied!

body.text: (AVParis_43,4.60) mātṛvaṃśas tṛpyatu ||
body.translated_text: May the maternal lineage be satisfied!

body.text: (AVParis_43,4.61) añjalīṃ trīṃstrīn ||
body.translated_text: Three handfuls each, three times.

body.text: (AVParis_43,5.1) dharas tṛpyatu ||
body.translated_text: May <s>Dhara</s> (the Supporter) be satisfied!

body.text: (AVParis_43,5.2) dhruvas tṛpyatu ||
body.translated_text: May <s>Dhruva</s> (the Steadfast) be satisfied!

body.text: (AVParis_43,5.3) somas tṛpyatu ||
body.translated_text: May <s>Soma</s> be satisfied!

body.text: (AVParis_43,5.4) āpas tṛpyatu ||
body.translated_text: May <s>Āpa</s> (Waters) be satisfied!

body.text: (AVParis_43,5.5) analas tṛpyatu ||
body.translated_text: May <s>Anala</s> (Fire) be satisfied!

body.text: (AVParis_43,5.6) anilas tṛpyatu ||
body.translated_text: May <s>Anila</s> (Wind) be satisfied!

body.text: (AVParis_43,5.7) pratyūṣas tṛpyatu ||
body.translated_text: May <s>Pratyūṣa</s> (Dawn) be satisfied!

body.text: (AVParis_43,5.8) prabhāsas tṛpyatu || iti vasavaḥ ||
body.translated_text: May <s>Prabhāsa</s> (Radiance) be satisfied! — Thus the <s>Vasu</s>s.

body.text: (AVParis_43,5.9) mṛgavyādhas tṛpyatu ||
body.translated_text: May <s>Mṛgavyādha</s> (the Hunter) be satisfied!

body.text: (AVParis_43,5.10) sarpas tṛpyatu ||
body.translated_text: May <s>Sarpa</s> (the Serpent) be satisfied!

body.text: (AVParis_43,5.11) nirṛtir mahāśayas tṛpyatu ||
body.translated_text: May <s>Nirṛti</s>, the great-minded one, be satisfied!

body.text: (AVParis_43,5.12) aja ekapāt tṛpyatu ||
body.translated_text: May <s>Aja Ekapāt</s> (the One-Footed Unborn) be satisfied!

body.text: (AVParis_43,5.13) ahir budhnyas tṛpyatu ||
body.translated_text: May <s>Ahir Budhnya</s> (the Serpent of the Deep) be satisfied!

body.text: (AVParis_43,5.14) pinākī paraṃtapas tṛpyatu ||
body.translated_text: May <s>Pinākī</s> (the Trident-Bearer), the scorcher of foes, be satisfied!

body.text: (AVParis_43,5.15) bhuvanas tṛpyatu ||
body.translated_text: May <s>Bhuvana</s> (the World) be satisfied!

body.text: (AVParis_43,5.16) īśvaras tṛpyatu ||
body.translated_text: May <s>Īśvara</s> (the Lord) be satisfied!

body.text: (AVParis_43,5.17) kapālī mahādyutis tṛpyatu ||
body.translated_text: May <s>Kapālī</s> (the Skull-Bearer), of great radiance, be satisfied!

body.text: (AVParis_43,5.18) sthāṇus tṛpyatu ||
body.translated_text: May <s>Sthāṇu</s> (the Pillar) be satisfied!

body.text:
(AVParis_43,5.19) bhavo bhagavāṃs tṛpyatu || iti rudrāḥ
(AVParis_43,5.20) bhagas tṛpyatu ||
body.translated_text: May <s>Bhava</s>, the Blessed One, be satisfied! — Thus the <s>Rudra</s>s. May <s>Bhaga</s> be satisfied!

body.text: (AVParis_43,5.21) aṃśas tṛpyatu ||
body.translated_text: May <s>Aṃśa</s> (the Share) be satisfied!

body.text: (AVParis_43,5.22) aryamā tṛpyatu ||
body.translated_text: May <s>Aryaman</s> be satisfied!

body.text: (AVParis_43,5.23) mitras tṛpyatu ||
body.translated_text: May <s>Mitra</s> be satisfied!

body.text: (AVParis_43,5.24) varuṇas tṛpyatu ||
body.translated_text: May <s>Varuṇa</s> be satisfied!

body.text: (AVParis_43,5.25) savitā tṛpyatu ||
body.translated_text: May <s>Savitṛ</s> be satisfied!

body.text: (AVParis_43,5.26) dhātā tṛpyatu ||
body.translated_text: May <s>Dhātṛ</s> (the Establisher) be satisfied!

body.text: (AVParis_43,5.27) tvaṣṭā tṛpyatu ||
body.translated_text: May <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s> (the Fashioner) be satisfied!

body.text: (AVParis_43,5.28) pūṣā tṛpyatu ||
body.translated_text: May <s>Pūṣan</s> be satisfied!

body.text: (AVParis_43,5.29) vivasvān mahābalas tṛpyatu ||
body.translated_text: May <s>Vivasvān</s>, of great strength, be satisfied!

body.text: (AVParis_43,5.30) indras tṛpyatu ||
body.translated_text: May <s>Indra</s> be satisfied!

body.text: (AVParis_43,5.31) viṣṇus tṛpyatu ||
body.translated_text: May <s>Viṣṇu</s> be satisfied!

body.text: (AVParis_43,5.32) kavyavālaṃ tarpayāmi ||
body.translated_text: I satisfy <s>Kavyavāla</s>.

body.text: (AVParis_43,5.33) analaṃ tarpayāmi ||
body.translated_text: I satisfy <s>Anala</s> (Fire).

body.text: (AVParis_43,5.34) anilaṃ tarpayāmi ||
body.translated_text: I satisfy <s>Anila</s> (Wind).

body.text: (AVParis_43,5.35) somaṃ tarpayāmi ||
body.translated_text: I satisfy <s>Soma</s>.

body.text: (AVParis_43,5.36) yamaṃ tarpayāmi ||
body.translated_text: I satisfy <s>Yama</s>.

body.text: (AVParis_43,5.37) aryamaṇaṃ tarpayāmi ||
body.translated_text: I satisfy <s>Aryaman</s>.

body.text: (AVParis_43,5.38) agniṣvāttāṃs tarpayāmi ||
body.translated_text: I satisfy the <s>Agniṣvātta</s> (fire-eaten) [ancestors].

body.text: (AVParis_43,5.39) somapāṃs tarpayāmi ||
body.translated_text: I satisfy the <s>Somapa</s> (<s>Soma</s>-drinking) [ancestors].

body.text: (AVParis_43,5.40) barhiṣadas tarpayāmi || iti devapitaraḥ ||
body.translated_text: I satisfy the <s>Barhiṣad</s> (seated-on-sacred-grass) [ancestors]. — Thus the divine ancestors.

body.text:
(AVParis_43,5.41) yamāya namo
(AVParis_43,5.42) dharmarājāya namo
(AVParis_43,5.43) mṛtyave namo
(AVParis_43,5.44) antakāya namo
(AVParis_43,5.45) vaivasvatāya namaḥ
(AVParis_43,5.46) kālāya namaś
(AVParis_43,5.47) citrāya namaś
(AVParis_43,5.48) citraguptāya namaḥ
(AVParis_43,5.49) sarvabhūtakṣayāya namaḥ
(AVParis_43,5.50) kṛtāya namaḥ
(AVParis_43,5.51) kṛtāntāya namo
(AVParis_43,5.52) mahodarāya namo
(AVParis_43,5.53) dhātre namo

children.text: (AVParis_43,5.54) vidhātre namo
children.translated_text: Salutation to <s>Vidhātṛ</s> (the Ordainer)!

children.text: (AVParis_43,5.55) yamebhyo namo
children.translated_text: Salutation to the <s>Yama</s>s!

children.text: (AVParis_43,5.56) yamadūtebhyo namaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Salutation to the messengers of <s>Yama</s>!

body.translated_text: Salutation to <s>Yama</s>! Salutation to <s>Dharmarāja</s> (King of Righteousness)! Salutation to <s>Mṛtyu</s> (Death)! Salutation to <s>Antaka</s> (the Ender)! Salutation to <s>Vaivasvata</s> (Son of <s>Vivasvān</s>)! Salutation to <s>Kāla</s> (Time)! Salutation to <s>Citra</s> (the Wonderful)! Salutation to <s>Citragupta</s> (the Hidden Recorder)! Salutation to <s>Sarvabhūtakṣaya</s> (Destroyer of All Beings)! Salutation to <s>Kṛta</s>! Salutation to <s>Kṛtānta</s> (the Finisher)! Salutation to <s>Mahodara</s> (the Great-Bellied)! Salutation to <s>Dhātṛ</s>!

body.text: (AVParis_43,5.57) viśveśās tṛpyantu ||
body.translated_text: May the <s>Viśveśa</s>s (Lords of All) be satisfied!

body.text: (AVParis_43,5.58) sikatās tṛpyantu ||
body.translated_text: May the <s>Sikatā</s>s (Sandy Ones) be satisfied!

body.text: (AVParis_43,5.59) pṛśnijās tṛpyantu ||
body.translated_text: May the <s>Pṛśnija</s>s (Born of the Spotted One) be satisfied!

body.text: (AVParis_43,5.60) nīlās tṛpyantu ||
body.translated_text: May the <s>Nīla</s>s (Blue Ones) be satisfied!

body.text: (AVParis_43,5.61) śṛṅgiṇas tṛpyantu ||
body.translated_text: May the <s>Śṛṅgin</s>s (Horned Ones) be satisfied!

body.text: (AVParis_43,5.62) śvetās tṛpyantu ||
body.translated_text: May the <s>Śveta</s>s (White Ones) be satisfied!

body.text: (AVParis_43,5.63) kṛṣṇās tṛpyantu ||
body.translated_text: May the <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>s (Black Ones) be satisfied!

body.text: (AVParis_43,5.64) ajās tṛpyantu || iti yamadūtāḥ ||
body.translated_text: May the <s>Aja</s>s (Unborn Ones) be satisfied! — Thus the messengers of <s>Yama</s>.

body.text: (AVParis_43,6.1) yāṃ kāṃ cit saritaṃ gatvā kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśīm | ekaikasya tilair miśrān dadyāt trīn udakāñjalīn ||
body.translated_text: Having gone to any river, on the fourteenth of the dark fortnight, one should give three handfuls of water mixed with sesame for each individual [ancestor].

body.text: (AVParis_43,6.2) ā yāteti hi tisṛbhiḥ pitṝn āvāhayet tataḥ | ud īratām iti tisṛbhiḥ pitṛbhyo dadyāt tilodakam ||
body.translated_text: With the three [verses beginning] 'Come hither,' one should then invoke the ancestors; with the three [verses beginning] 'May they rise up,' one should give sesame-water to the ancestors.

body.text: (AVParis_43,6.3) nābhimātre jale sthitvā cintayen manasā pitṝn | tathā mātāmahebhyaś ca śucau deśe 'tha barhiṣi ||
body.translated_text: Standing in water up to the navel, one should think of the ancestors in the mind; likewise for the maternal grandfathers, on sacred grass in a pure place.

body.text: (AVParis_43,6.4) parā yātety etayā pitṝṃs tṛptān visarjayet | mano nv ā hvāmahīty evaṃ pañcabhir mana upāhvayeta ||
body.translated_text: With [the verse] 'Depart hence,' one should dismiss the satisfied ancestors; with the five [verses] 'We call the mind,' one should summon the mind back.

body.text: (AVParis_43,6.5) etadd hi tarpaṇaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ svayam uktaṃ svayaṃbhuvā | śraddhadhānaḥ samācaṣṭe brahmalokaṃ sa gacchati ||
body.translated_text: This indeed is the most excellent <s>tarpaṇa</s> (libation), declared by <s>Svayambhū</s> (<s>Brahmā</s>) himself; he who performs it with faith goes to the world of <s>Brahman</s>.

body.text:
(Pariśiṣṭa_44. śrāddhavidhiḥ)
(AVParis_44,1.1) om athātaḥ śrāddhavidhiṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||
body.translated_text: (Supplement 44: Procedure for <s>Śrāddha</s> [Ancestral Rites]) Oṃ. Now we shall expound the procedure for the <s>śrāddha</s> (ancestral rite).

body.text: (AVParis_44,1.2) catuṣprakāraṃ śrāddhaṃ bhavati ||
body.translated_text: The <s>śrāddha</s> is of four kinds.

body.text: (AVParis_44,1.3) nityam ābhyudayikaṃ kāmyam ekoddiṣṭaṃ ceti ||
body.translated_text: The regular (<s>nitya</s>), the auspicious-occasion (<s>ābhyudayika</s>), the desire-fulfilling (<s>kāmya</s>), and the individual (<s>ekoddiṣṭa</s>).

body.text: (AVParis_44,1.4) tatra nityam amāvāsyāyām ||
body.translated_text: Among these, the regular one is on the new-moon day.

body.text: (AVParis_44,1.5) ābhyudayikaṃ mātṛpūrvakaṃ puṃsavanādiṣu saṃskāreṣu ||
body.translated_text: The auspicious-occasion one, preceded by [offerings to] the mother, is at <s>saṃskāra</s>s (life-cycle rites) such as the <s>Puṃsavana</s> (rite for a male child) and the rest.

body.text: (AVParis_44,1.6) kāmyaṃ tithidravyabrāhmaṇasaṃyoge ||
body.translated_text: The desire-fulfilling one is at the conjunction of [an appropriate] <s>tithi</s> (lunar day), substance, and <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>.

body.text: (AVParis_44,1.7) ekoddiṣṭaṃ saṃcayanaprabhṛty ā sapiṇḍīkaraṇāt ||
body.translated_text: The <s>ekoddiṣṭa</s> (rite directed to one [ancestor]) [is performed] from the gathering [of bones] up to the <s>sapiṇḍīkaraṇa</s> (incorporation into the ancestral group).

body.text: (AVParis_44,1.8) tatra nitye yugmān daive brāhmaṇān upāmantrayet ||
body.translated_text: For the regular [<s>śrāddha</s>], in the <s>daiva</s> (divine) [portion], he should invite an even number of Brahmins.

body.text: (AVParis_44,1.9) ābhyudayike ubhayatra yugmān ||
body.translated_text: For the <s>ābhyudayika</s> (joyful occasion), an even number in both [the divine and ancestral portions].

body.text: (AVParis_44,1.10) yavais tilārthā ṛjavo darbhāḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ kuryāt ||
body.translated_text: With barley for the purpose of sesame, straight <s>darbha</s> grasses — one should perform the circumambulation.

body.text: (AVParis_44,1.11) kāmyaṃ tu nityavat ||
body.translated_text: The <s>kāmya</s> (desire-motivated) [<s>śrāddha</s>] is like the regular one.

body.text: (AVParis_44,1.12) athaikoddiṣṭaṃ tūṣṇīṃ yāvad uktam ||
body.translated_text: Now, the <s>ekoddiṣṭa</s> [is performed] silently as far as stated.

body.text: (AVParis_44,1.13) nāgnevaṃ na daivam ayugmānbrāhmaṇān ||
body.translated_text: Not the <s>Āgneya</s> (fiery), not the <s>daiva</s> (divine) — [invite] an odd number of Brahmins.

body.text: (AVParis_44,1.14) dakṣiṇāmukha upaviśya pitryeṇopacaryaikaṃ pavitram ekam udapātram apratyāvṛttim āsanaṃ nāmagotreṇaikaṃ piṇḍam etat te annam iti ||
body.translated_text: Seated facing south, performing with the ancestral rite — one purificatory [grass], one water-vessel, a seat from which one does not return, [and] addressing by name and <s>gotra</s> (lineage): 'This is your food' — one rice-ball.

body.text: (AVParis_44,2.1) śve 'dyeti vā śrāddhaṃ kariṣyāmīti brāhmaṇān upāmantrayet ||
body.translated_text: 'Tomorrow' or 'today' — 'I shall perform the <s>śrāddha</s>' — thus he should invite the Brahmins.

body.text: (AVParis_44,2.2) trīn pañca sapta vā na prasajyeta vistara iti vacanāt ||
body.translated_text: Three, five, or seven — one should not overextend, according to the saying about elaboration.

body.text: (AVParis_44,2.3) prāṅmukhān viśvedevān udaṅmukhān pitṝn ||
body.translated_text: The <s>Viśvedeva</s>s (All-Gods) facing east; the ancestors (<s>Pitṛ</s>s) facing north.

body.text: (AVParis_44,2.4) vedavedāṅgavidaḥ pañcāgnir anūcāno 'vyavahārī śrotriyas triṇāciketas trimadhus trisuparṇī chandogo jyeṣṭhasāmago 'tharvaśiraso 'dhyetā saṃdhyāsnāyī devapitṛsadāhniko mātṛpitṛśuśrūṣur bhṛgvaṅgirovid dharmaśāstravid iti ||
body.translated_text: One who knows the <s>Veda</s> and <s>Vedāṅga</s>s, a maintainer of the five fires, an <s>anūcāna</s> (adept in recitation), one not engaged in [worldly] transactions, a <s>Śrotriya</s> (learned in scripture), a <s>Triṇāciketa</s> (three-fire knower), a <s>Trimadhu</s> (knower of the three sweet [verses]), a <s>Trisuparṇī</s> (knower of the three golden-winged [verses]), a <s>Chandoga</s> (Sāmavedic reciter), a singer of the <s>Jyeṣṭhasāman</s>, a student of the <s>Atharvaśiras</s> (Upaniṣad), one who performs the twilight bathing, one who daily [worships] gods and ancestors, one who serves mother and father, one versed in the <s>Bhṛgu</s> and <s>Aṅgiras</s> [traditions], one learned in <s>Dharmaśāstra</s> — [these are qualified Brahmins].

body.text: (AVParis_44,2.5) prayato 'parāhṇe śuciḥ śuklavāsāḥ ||
body.translated_text: Ritually pure, in the afternoon, clean, wearing white garments.

body.text: (AVParis_44,2.6) svāgatenābhyarcyācamanīyaṃ kṛtvā dattvā brāhmaṇān upasaṃgṛhyopaveśayed

children.text: (AVParis_44,2.7) daive pitrye ca sadarbheṣv āsaneṣu
children.translated_text: In both the <s>daiva</s> and <s>pitrya</s> (ancestral) [portions], on seats with <s>darbha</s> grass.

children.text: (AVParis_44,2.8) tato 'nujñāpayed devān pitṝṃś cāvāhayiṣyāmīti
children.translated_text: Then he should seek permission: 'I shall invoke the gods and the ancestors.'

children.text: (AVParis_44,2.9) āvāhaya saumyās te santv ity anujñātaḥ pūrvaṃ devān āvāhayed viśve devāsa ā gateti ||
children.translated_text: 'Invoke! May they be gracious to you' — thus permitted, he should first invoke the gods: 'Come, O <s>Viśve Devāḥ</s> (All-Gods)!'

body.translated_text: Having honored with welcome, having performed the water-sipping rite, having given, having clasped the Brahmins, he should seat them.

body.text: (AVParis_44,2.10) viśve devāsa ā gata śṛṇutā ma imaṃ havam | edaṃ barhir ni ṣīdata iti ||
body.translated_text: 'Come, O <s>Viśve Devāḥ</s>, hear this call of mine; sit upon this <s>barhis</s> (sacred grass)!'

body.text: (AVParis_44,2.11) ā yāteti pitṝn āvāhayed ācyā jānv ity upaveśayet saṃ viśaṃtv iti saṃveśayed iti ||
body.translated_text: 'Come!' — thus he should invoke the ancestors; 'Bend the knee' — thus he should seat [them]; 'Enter together' — thus he should make them recline.

body.text:
(AVParis_44,3.1) yajñopavītī sāvitryodapātram abhimantrya
(AVParis_44,3.2) viśvebhyo devebhyaḥ pādayam arghyam ācamanīyam iti brāhmaṇahasteṣu ninayet ||
body.translated_text: Wearing the sacred thread, having consecrated the water-vessel with the <s>Sāvitrī</s> — 'For the <s>Viśve Devāḥ</s>: foot-water, <s>arghya</s> (honor-water), and sipping-water' — he should pour into the hands of the Brahmins.

body.text:
(AVParis_44,3.3) trīṇy udapātrāṇi kalpayed gandhamālyatilair miśrāṇi kṛtvā'
(AVParis_44,3.4) 'ud īratām iti tisṛbhir udapātrāṇy anvṛcaṃ sapavitreṣu brāhmaṇahasteṣu ninayet ||
body.translated_text: He should prepare three water-vessels, mixed with fragrance, garlands, and sesame; with the three [verses beginning] 'May they rise up,' he should pour the water-vessels, verse by verse, with purificatory [grass], into the hands of the Brahmins.

body.text:
(AVParis_44,3.5) prapitāmahebhyaḥ pitāmahebhyaḥ pitṛbhyaś ceti dattvā
(AVParis_44,3.6) gandhamālyadhūpāñjanādarśapradīpasyopaharanam
(AVParis_44,3.7) sarvānnaprakāram ādāyāgnau kariṣyāmīty anujñāpya kuruṣvety anujñāto darbhair dakṣiṇāgrair agniṃ paristīrya juhuyād agnaye kavyavāhanāyeti tisṛbhir

children.text: (AVParis_44,3.8) hutaśeṣaṃ brāhmaṇebhyo dadyād
children.translated_text: The remainder of the oblation he should give to the Brahmins.

children.text: (AVParis_44,3.9) aṅguṣṭham upayamya pradakṣiṇaṃ daive prasavyaṃ pitrya idaṃ viṣṇur iti japej jānuṃ niṣadya bhūmāv
children.translated_text: Pressing with the thumb, clockwise in the <s>daiva</s> (divine) portion, counter-clockwise in the <s>pitrya</s> (ancestral), reciting 'This is <s>Viṣṇu</s>' — having knelt on the ground,

children.text: (AVParis_44,3.10) atas tilair māṃsaiḥ śākair yuṣaiḥ kṛsarāpāyasāpūpair lājair bhakṣair ikṣuvikāraiḥ pānair madhunā ghṛtena dadhnā payasā caiva prabhūtamṛṣṭato 'nnaṃ dadyād anasūyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then with sesame, meats, vegetables, broths, rice-porridge, milk-rice, cakes, parched grain, sweets, sugarcane preparations, drinks, honey, ghee, curds, and milk — he should give food abundantly and finely prepared, without envy.

body.translated_text: Having given for the great-grandfathers, grandfathers, and fathers — the offering of fragrance, garlands, incense, collyrium, mirror, and lamp. Having taken all types of food, having sought permission 'I shall offer into the fire,' being told 'Do so' — having strewn around the fire with <s>darbha</s> grasses with tips pointing south, he should offer with the three [verses] 'To <s>Agni</s>, the carrier of oblations to the dead.'

children.text: (AVParis_44,4.1) pavitrapāṇir dharbheṣv āsīno madhu vātā iti japet
children.translated_text: With purificatory [grass] in hand, seated on <s>darbha</s> grasses, he should recite 'The winds blow sweet.'

children.text: (AVParis_44,4.2) pavitraṃ dharmaśāstram apratirathaṃ prāṇasūktaṃ puruṣasūktam upaniṣadam anyad vādhyātmikaṃ kiṃ cit
children.translated_text: The purificatory [texts are]: <s>Dharmaśāstra</s>, the invincible [hymn], the <s>Prāṇasūkta</s> (life-breath hymn), the <s>Puruṣasūkta</s> (Cosmic Man hymn), the <s>Upaniṣad</s>, or any other metaphysical [text].

children.text: (AVParis_44,4.3) tṛptāñ jñātvānnaṃ prakīrya dattvā cāpaḥ sakṛtsakṛd annaṃ ye 'gnidagdhā iti vikiram ||
children.translated_text: Having ascertained that they are satisfied, scattering the food, having given water, once for each — 'Those who were burned by fire' — thus the scattering.

body.text:
(AVParis_44,4.4) darbhir āstīrya dyuaur darvir akṣiteti tisṛbhiḥ sarvānnaprakāram uddhṛtyājyena saṃnīya trīn piṇḍān saṃhatān nidadhāty
(AVParis_44,4.5) etat te pratatāmaheti dakṣiṇataḥ patnībhya idaṃ vaḥ patnyā itīdam āśaṃsūnām idam āśaṃsamānānām ity annena prasavyaṃ parikiranam || ye dasyava ity ulmukenābhipariharaṇam

children.text: (AVParis_44,4.6) ekoddiṣṭe tv ekaṃ piṇḍam ekam udapātram ācamyopotthāya etaṃ bhāgam etaṃ sadhasthāḥ śyeno nṛcakṣā iti ca śrāddhaṃ dattvābhimantrayec cheṣam
children.translated_text: In the <s>ekoddiṣṭa</s>, however — one rice-ball, one water-vessel; having sipped and risen — 'This portion,' 'This station,' 'The eagle, the watcher of men' — having given the <s>śrāddha</s>, he should consecrate the remainder.

children.text: (AVParis_44,4.7) anujñāpyācamanīyaṃ dattvā puṇyāhaṃ vācayed dakṣiṇāṃ ca dattvā yathāśakty udapātraśeṣaṃ sapavitreṣu brāhmaṇahasteṣu ninayet
children.translated_text: Having sought permission, having given sipping-water, he should have the <s>puṇyāha</s> (auspicious day declaration) recited; having given the <s>dakṣiṇā</s> (ritual fee) according to ability, he should pour the remainder of the water-vessels, with purificatory [grass], into the hands of the Brahmins.

children.text: (AVParis_44,4.8) putraṃ pautram ity ekam āpo agnim iti dvitīyaṃ yuktābhyāṃ tṛtīyaṃ putraṃ pautram ity ekayodapātram iti kauśikaḥ ||
children.translated_text: 'Son and grandson' — the first; 'Waters, fire' — the second; with the joined ones, the third; 'Son and grandson' — with one [verse], the water-vessel — thus [says] <s>Kauśika</s>.

body.translated_text: Having strewn with <s>darbha</s> grasses, 'O heaven, the ladle, the imperishable' — with these three [verses], having extracted all types of food, having mixed with ghee, he deposits three rice-balls joined together. 'This is for your great-grandfather' — on the south; 'For the wives, this is yours' — 'This for the hopeful ones, this for the hoping ones' — scattering food counter-clockwise. 'Those who are hostile' — carrying around with a firebrand.

body.text: (AVParis_44,4.9) prapitāmahebhyaḥ pitāmahebhyaḥ pitṛbhyo mātulamātāmahebhyo nirdiṣṭaṃ tebhyaḥ sarvebhyaḥ sapatnīkebhyaḥ svadhāvad akṣayyam astv akṣayyam astv iti vrāhmaṇavacanam ||
body.translated_text: 'For the great-grandfathers, grandfathers, fathers, maternal uncles, maternal grandfathers — to all of them, designated, with their wives — may it be <s>svadhā</s> (ancestral offering), imperishable, imperishable!' — thus the Brahmin's declaration.

body.text:
(AVParis_44,4.10) dātāro no 'bhivardhantāṃ vedāḥ saṃtatir eva ca | śraddhā ca no mā vyagamad bahudeyaṃ ca no 'stv ity
(AVParis_44,4.11) evaṃ varān vācayitvā namo vaḥ pitara ity evamādi mano nv ā hvāmahīty evamantaṃ samānaṃ piṇḍapitṛyajñena madhyamapiṇḍapradānaṃ ceti ||
body.translated_text: 'May the givers among us increase, and the <s>Veda</s>s, and progeny also; may faith not depart from us; and may we have much to give!' — Having thus had the blessings recited, 'Salutation to you, O ancestors' — thus beginning, 'We invite the mind' — thus ending, the same [procedure as in] the <s>piṇḍa-pitṛyajña</s> (rice-ball ancestral sacrifice), with the giving of the middle rice-ball.

body.text: (AVParis_44,4.12) vājevāje 'vata vājino no dhaneṣu viprā amṛtā ṛtajñāḥ | asya madhvaḥ pibata mādayadhvaṃ tṛptā yāta pathibhir devayānaiḥ ||
body.translated_text: 'In contest after contest, help the contestants, O wise, immortal, truth-knowing champions! Drink of this sweet [offering], delight yourselves; satisfied, go by the paths trod by the gods!'

body.text:
(AVParis_44,4.13) iti brāhmaṇān hasteṣu gṛhītvotthāpya pradakṣiṇaṃ kuryād
(AVParis_44,4.14) eṣa śrāddhavidhir anena vidhinā putrān paśūn dhānyaṃ hiraṇyam āyuś ca labhate ya evaṃ vedeti ca brāhmaṇam ||
body.translated_text: Having grasped the Brahmins by the hands, having raised them, he should circumambulate. 'This is the procedure for the <s>śrāddha</s>; by this procedure one obtains sons, cattle, grain, gold, and long life — he who knows thus' — thus the <s>Brāhmaṇa</s> (scriptural commentary).

body.text: (AVParis_44,4.15) māhakiḥ kauśikāc ca māhakiḥ kauśikāc ceti ||
body.translated_text: [This is] from <s>Māhaki</s> and <s>Kauśika</s> — from <s>Māhaki</s> and <s>Kauśika</s>.

body.text:
(Pariśiṣṭa_45. agnihotrahomavidhiḥ)
(AVParis_45,1.1) om agnihotram ||
body.translated_text: (<s>Pariśiṣṭa</s> 45. Procedure for the <s>Agnihotra</s> Oblation) Oṃ. The <s>Agnihotra</s> (fire-oblation).

body.text: (AVParis_45,1.2) sāyam ārambhaḥ prātar apavargaḥ ||
body.translated_text: The commencement is in the evening; the conclusion is in the morning.

body.text: (AVParis_45,1.3) nāntareṇānyat kuryāt ||
body.translated_text: One should not do anything else in between.

body.text: (AVParis_45,1.4) prātar ārambhamity eke ||
body.translated_text: Some [say] the commencement is in the morning.

body.text: (AVParis_45,1.5) yajñapātrāṇi prakṣālyāgnihotraṃ śrapayet ||
body.translated_text: Having washed the sacrificial vessels, he should cook the <s>Agnihotra</s> [milk].

children.text: (AVParis_45,1.6) śrapyamāṇaṃ ced viṣyandet tad adbhir upaninayet
children.translated_text: If, while being cooked, it boils over, he should bring it back with water.

children.text: (AVParis_45,1.7) tad anumantrayate pṛthivīṃ turīyam ity etābhiḥ
children.translated_text: He consecrates that with 'The earth, a quarter' — with these [verses].

children.text: (AVParis_45,1.8) pratyānīyodag udvāsya barhir udapātram undayati paryukṣya ||
children.translated_text: Having brought [it] back, having set [it] aside to the north, he pours water on the <s>barhis</s> (sacred grass) and water-vessel, having sprinkled around.

body.text: (AVParis_45,1.9) ṛtaṃ tvā satyena pariṣiñcāmīti hoṣyan ||
body.translated_text: 'With truth I sprinkle you with order' — [saying this] when about to offer.

body.text: (AVParis_45,1.10) satyaṃ tva rteneti hute ||
body.translated_text: 'With order, you with truth' — [saying this] when the offering is made.

body.text: (AVParis_45,1.11) gārhapatyād āhavanīyam udakadhārāṃ ninayati || amṛtam asy amṛtam amṛtena saṃdhehīti ||
body.translated_text: He leads a stream of water from the <s>Gārhapatya</s> (household fire) to the <s>Āhavanīya</s> (oblation fire): 'You are the immortal; join the immortal with the immortal.'

body.text: (AVParis_45,1.12) āhavanīyaṃ paryukṣya gārhapatyaṃ prāpyāṅgārān avaloḍya carusthālyā saṃsparśayati ||
body.translated_text: Having sprinkled around the <s>Āhavanīya</s>, having reached the <s>Gārhapatya</s>, having stirred the coals, he touches [them] with the <s>caru</s> pot.

body.text: (AVParis_45,1.13) nirūḍhaṃ japaty ubhayam iti pratyūḍham iti pratininayati

children.text: (AVParis_45,1.14) sruvaṃ srucaṃ ca pratitapati niṣṭaptaṃ rakṣo niṣṭaptā arātayaḥ pratyuṣṭaṃ rakṣaḥ pratyuṣṭā arātaya ity
children.translated_text: He heats the <s>sruva</s> (small ladle) and the <s>sruc</s> (large ladle): 'Burnt is the demon; burnt are the hostilities; scorched is the demon; scorched are the hostilities.'

children.text: (AVParis_45,1.15) adbhir abhyukṣya carusthālyāṃ sruveṇa sruci gṛhītam iti samānam
children.translated_text: Having sprinkled with water, having taken [the offering] from the <s>caru</s> pot with the <s>sruva</s> into the <s>sruc</s> — the [procedure] is the same.

children.text: (AVParis_45,1.16) srucam ādāya <mukhasaṃmitām ud> gṛhyāhavanīyam abhikrāmatīdam ahaṃ yajamānaṃ svargaṃ lokam unnayāmīti ||
children.translated_text: Taking up the <s>sruc</s>, raising it to mouth-level, he approaches the <s>Āhavanīya</s>: 'I lead this sacrificer upward to the heavenly world.'

body.translated_text: When [the milk] has risen, he recites 'Both' — when it has subsided, he leads it back.

body.text: (AVParis_45,1.17) barhiṣi srucaṃ nidhāya samidham ādadhāti ||
body.translated_text: Having placed the <s>sruc</s> on the <s>barhis</s> (sacred grass), he places a fuel-stick.

body.text: (AVParis_45,1.18) agnijyotiṣaṃ tvā vāyumatīṃ prāṇavatīṃ svargyāṃ svargāyopadadhāmi bhāsvatīṃ svāheti <sāyam || sūryajyotiṣam iti prātaḥ> ||
body.translated_text: 'You who have fire as your light, who are full of wind, endowed with breath, heavenly — for the sake of heaven I place you, the shining one — <s>svāhā</s>!' — in the evening. 'You who have the sun as your light' — in the morning.

body.text: (AVParis_45,1.19) samidhaṃ pradīptām abhijuhoti ||
body.translated_text: He pours the oblation on the blazing fuel-stick.

body.text: (AVParis_45,1.20) sajūr devena savitrā sajū rātryendravatyā juṣāṇo agnir vetu svāheti sāyam ||
body.translated_text: 'In accord with the god <s>Savitṛ</s>, in accord with the night attended by <s>Indra</s> — may <s>Agni</s>, delighting, accept — <s>svāhā</s>!' — in the evening.

children.text: (AVParis_45,1.21) sajūr devena savitrā sajūr uṣasendravatyā juṣāṇaḥ sūryo vetu svāheti prātar
children.translated_text: 'In accord with the god <s>Savitṛ</s>, in accord with the dawn attended by <s>Indra</s> — may <s>Sūrya</s> (the Sun), delighting, accept — <s>svāhā</s>!' — in the morning.

children.text: (AVParis_45,1.22) āhutir udayahome 'gner eva
children.translated_text: The oblation at the rising-oblation is for <s>Agni</s> alone.

children.text: (AVParis_45,1.23) jyotiṣmān udety āyaṃtanatām iti ||
children.translated_text: 'The luminous one rises — may it extend!' — thus.

body.text: (AVParis_45,1.24) prajāpate na tvad etāny anya iti manasaivobhayatra prājāpatyottarābhutīr hutvā

children.text: (AVParis_45,1.25) sruvaṃ trir udañcam unnayati rudrān prīṇāmīti
children.translated_text: He raises the <s>sruva</s> upward three times: 'I gratify the <s>Rudra</s>s.'

children.text: (AVParis_45,1.26) barhiṣi sruvaṃ nidhāyonmṛjya
children.translated_text: Having placed the <s>sruva</s> on the <s>barhis</s> and wiped [it],

children.text: (AVParis_45,1.27) pitryupavītaṃ kṛtvā dakṣiṇataḥ pitṛbhyaḥ svadhāṃ karomīti ||
children.translated_text: Having put on the ancestral sacred thread (<s>pitryupavīta</s>), from the south: 'I make the <s>svadhā</s> (ancestral offering) for the ancestors.'

body.translated_text: 'O <s>Prajāpati</s>, none other than you [encompasses] these' — mentally in both [evening and morning], having offered the <s>Prājāpatya</s> (of <s>Prajāpati</s>) subsequent oblations,

body.text: (AVParis_45,2.1) hutam agnihotraṃ sarveṣv ity eke ||
body.translated_text: The <s>Agnihotra</s> is offered in all [fires] — some [say].

body.text: (AVParis_45,2.2) carusthālyāḥ sruveṇa ||
body.translated_text: With the <s>sruva</s> from the <s>caru</s> pot.

body.text: (AVParis_45,2.3) iha puṣṭiṃ puṣṭipatir dadhātv iha prajāṃ janayatu prajāpatiḥ | agnaye gṛhapataye rayimate paśupataye puṣṭipataye svāheti gārhapatye ||
body.translated_text: 'May the lord of increase bestow increase here; may <s>Prajāpati</s> generate progeny here; to <s>Agni</s> the householder, the wealth-giving, to <s>Paśupati</s>, to the lord of increase — <s>svāhā</s>!' — in the <s>Gārhapatya</s>.

body.text: (AVParis_45,2.4) agnaye 'nnādāyānnapataye svāheti dakṣiṇāgnau hutvā ||
body.translated_text: 'To <s>Agni</s> the food-eater, the lord of food — <s>svāhā</s>!' — having offered in the <s>Dakṣiṇāgni</s> (southern fire).

body.text:
(AVParis_45,2.5) manasaivobhayatra prajāpateś carusthālī
(AVParis_45,2.6) srucaṃ sruvaṃ barhiṣy ādhāyottarato 'gner upaviśya prāśnāti ||
body.translated_text: Mentally in both [fires], for <s>Prajāpati</s> — the <s>caru</s> pot. Having placed the <s>sruc</s> and <s>sruva</s> on the <s>barhis</s>, he sits to the north of the fire and eats.

children.text: (AVParis_45,2.7) prāṇān prīṇāmīty upaspṛśya garbhān prīṇāmīti dvitīyaṃ viśvān devān prīṇāmīty antataḥ sarvam
children.translated_text: 'I gratify the vital breaths' — having touched [water]; 'I gratify the embryos' — the second; 'I gratify all the gods' — at the end, everything.

children.text: (AVParis_45,2.8) aprakṣālitayodakaṃ srucā ninayati sarpetarajanān prīṇāmīti
children.translated_text: The unwashed water he leads with the <s>sruc</s>: 'I gratify the serpents and other beings.'

children.text: (AVParis_45,2.9) barhiṣā prakṣālya sarpapuṇyajanān prīṇāmīti dvitīyam ||
children.translated_text: Having washed with the <s>barhis</s> — 'I gratify the serpents and meritorious beings' — the second.

body.text: (AVParis_45,2.10) gandharvāpsarasaḥ prīṇāmīti apareṇāhavanīyam udakaṃ tṛtīyam ||
body.translated_text: 'I gratify the <s>Gandharva</s>s and <s>Apsaras</s>es' — to the west of the <s>Āhavanīya</s>, water the third.

body.text:
(AVParis_45,2.11) sapta rṣīn prīṇāmīti srucaṃ sruvaṃ ca pratitapati
(AVParis_45,2.12) dakṣiṇān nayāmīti rātrau srugdaṇḍam avamārṣṭi ||
body.translated_text: 'I gratify the seven <s>ṛṣi</s>s' — he heats the <s>sruc</s> and <s>sruva</s>; 'I lead the southern [fires]' — at night he wipes down the handle of the <s>sruc</s>.

body.text: (AVParis_45,2.13) prātar unmārṣṭi ||
body.translated_text: In the morning he wipes upward.

body.text:
(AVParis_45,2.14) ity uktaṃ samidādhānam
(AVParis_45,2.15) agnyupasthānam || rātriṃ rātrim aprayātaṃ bharanta iti ||
body.translated_text: Thus has been declared the fuel-placing; the fire-worship: 'Night after night, bringing without ceasing' — thus.

body.text:
(AVParis_45,2.16) yathākālaṃ sāyamsāyaṃ gṛhapatir ayaṃ no agnir iti dve
(AVParis_45,2.17) gārhapatyapaścād dugdhānnasyāgnihotraśrapaṇī vidhīyate ||
body.translated_text: At the proper time, evening after evening — 'Householder, this <s>Agni</s> of ours' — two [verses]; the cooking of the <s>Agnihotra</s> with milked food is prescribed after the <s>Gārhapatya</s>.

body.text: (AVParis_45,2.18) yajña te veda pṛṣṭham ity etayālabhyābhimantrayate ||
body.translated_text: 'O sacrifice, I know your back' — with this [verse] having touched, he consecrates.

body.text: (AVParis_45,2.19) ukhāyaṃ sravantyāṃ sa mardakarmabhyo 'nyasyāṃ dṛḍhatarāyāṃ pratyāsicya sutā deveṣv ity anumantrayate ||
body.translated_text: In the pot, in the flowing [milk] — from the rubbing operations, having poured back into another, more solid [vessel] — 'O pressed <s>Soma</s>, among the gods' — thus he consecrates.

body.text:
(AVParis_45,2.20) evaṃ sarvāsūkhāsu somakalaśamahāvīre vā
(AVParis_45,2.21) atha yasyāgnihotradhenvādi vyāpadyeta | tatra yathādevataṃ juhuyād apratibhāve vyāhṛtibhiḥ ||
body.translated_text: Thus in all pots, or in the <s>Soma</s>-vessel or <s>mahāvīra</s> (great hero pot). Now, if his <s>Agnihotra</s> cow or the like should die — there he should offer according to the respective deity; if unable, with the <s>Vyāhṛti</s>s.

body.text:
(Pariśiṣṭa_46. uttamapaṭalam)
(AVParis_46,1.1) atha vedavratasyādeśanavidhiṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||
body.translated_text: (Pariśiṣṭa 46: The Supreme Chapter) (AVParis_46,1.1) Now we shall expound the procedure for the instruction of the <s>Vedavrata</s> (Veda-vow).

body.text: (AVParis_46,1.2) sāṃvatsarikaṃ vedavratam ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_46,1.2) The <s>Vedavrata</s> is of one year's duration.

body.text: (AVParis_46,1.3) kalpānāṃ ṣāṇmāsikam ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_46,1.3) For the <s>Kalpas</s> (ritual texts), it is of six months.

body.text: (AVParis_46,1.4) romanakhāni dhārayet triṣavaṇaṃ tu snāyād dhaviṣyam aśnīyān na tu naktam aṇūn māśān masūrāṃs tu ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_46,1.4) One should keep the body-hair and nails [uncut]; one should bathe at the three pressings; one should eat <s>haviṣya</s> (sacrificial food), but not at night — neither beans (<s>aṇu</s>), black beans (<s>māśa</s>), nor lentils (<s>masūra</s>).

body.text: (AVParis_46,1.5) daṇḍamathitam uddhṛtasnehaṃ nāśīyāt ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_46,1.5) One should not eat [food] churned with a stick or with the oil removed.

body.text:
(AVParis_46,1.6) daṇḍakamaṇḍaludhāraṇaṃ vāsaś cāthorṇam
(AVParis_46,1.7) śirasvrataṃ ca sāṃvatsarikaṃ vedavratenaiva vyākhyātam ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_46,1.6) Carrying a staff and water-vessel, wearing a woolen garment — (AVParis_46,1.7) the head-vow, of one year's duration, is explained by the <s>Vedavrata</s> itself.

body.text: (AVParis_46,1.8) atha pramāṇāni vakṣyāmo

children.text: (AVParis_46,1.9) yamānāṃ mitrasya mṛgārthasyākṣīrākṣārabhojanam ayugmam āchādanam anantarhitā śayyā
children.translated_text: (AVParis_46,1.9) Of the restraints (<s>yama</s>s): for the <s>Mitra</s> [section] and the <s>Mṛgārtha</s> (animal-purpose [section]) — eating without milk, without alkaline [food], uneven covering, an uncovered bed.

children.text: (AVParis_46,1.10) mṛgārtheṣv aviśeṣeṇa yameṣu sarvam eva śamīdhānyaṃ na bhuñjītā
children.translated_text: (AVParis_46,1.10) In the <s>Mṛgārtha</s> sections without distinction, and in the restraints — one should not eat any <s>śamī</s>-grain.

children.text: (AVParis_46,1.11) athopasamādadhāti ||
children.translated_text: (AVParis_46,1.11) Then he performs the placing of fuel (<s>upasamādhāna</s>).

body.translated_text: (AVParis_46,1.8) Now we shall state the measurements.

body.text: (AVParis_46,2.1) samās tvāsmai kṣatrāṇy etam idhmam agnir bhūmyām iti tisṛbhir mamāgne varca iti sarvasūktenāyuṣyair varcasyaiḥ svastyayanair abhayair aparājitaiḥ śarmavarmabhiś copasamādadhāti ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_46,2.1) With the three [mantras] 'May the years for this one, the rulers,' 'This fuel,' '<s>Agni</s> on the earth'; with the entire hymn 'O <s>Agni</s>, my splendor'; with the Life-giving, Splendor-giving, Safe-journey, Fearlessness, Invincibility, and Shelter-and-Armor [groups] — he performs the placing of fuel.

body.text: (AVParis_46,2.2) vrataṃ nivedya vrātapatībhiḥ samidho 'bhyādadhyād

children.text: (AVParis_46,2.3) āṅgirasān samāsān hutvā bhārgavair viparyastām āṅgirasīm
children.translated_text: (AVParis_46,2.3) Having offered the <s>Āṅgirasa Samāsa</s> (condensed Āṅgirasa hymns), [he offers] the reversed <s>Āṅgirasī</s> with the <s>Bhārgava</s> [mantras].

children.text: (AVParis_46,2.4) vedādibhir vedottamaiḥ vargādibhir vargottamaiḥ padādibhiḥ padottamaiḥ kāṇḍādibhiḥ kāṇḍottamair anuvākādibhir anuvākottamair mahatkāṇḍair viśeṣeṇa sūktādibhiḥ sūktottamair
children.translated_text: (AVParis_46,2.4) With the beginnings and ends of the <s>Vedas</s>, with the beginnings and ends of the sections (<s>varga</s>), with the beginnings and ends of the verses (<s>pada</s>), with the beginnings and ends of the divisions (<s>kāṇḍa</s>), with the beginnings and ends of the chapters (<s>anuvāka</s>), especially with the great divisions; with the beginnings and ends of the hymns (<s>sūkta</s>) —

children.text: (AVParis_46,2.5) atraitāny aṣṭarcaprabhṛtīni vyākhyātāni ||
children.translated_text: (AVParis_46,2.5) here, those beginning with the eight-verse [hymns] and so forth are explained.

body.translated_text: (AVParis_46,2.2) Having declared the vow, he should place fuel-sticks with the <s>Vrātapati</s> (lord-of-vow) [mantras].

body.text:
(AVParis_46,2.6) brahmajyeṣṭheti ekā kāmojajñe kāmas tad iti hutvā
(AVParis_46,2.7) kalpavrate viśeṣo vacanakarmasu brāhmaṇaṃ śrāvayet ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_46,2.6) Having offered with '<s>Brahman</s> is the eldest' — one [mantra]; and 'Desire was born; desire, that' — (AVParis_46,2.7) in the <s>Kalpa</s>-vow, the distinction in the verbal rituals: he should cause a Brahmin to hear [the <s>Brāhmaṇa</s> text].

body.text:
(AVParis_46,2.8) keśībrāhmaṇaṃ ca
(AVParis_46,2.9) yeṣu vrataviśeṣaḥ syān na tān mantrān udāharet samāsavat sa hotavyaḥ purāṇārthaṃ vijānatā ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_46,2.8) And the <s>Keśī-Brāhmaṇa</s>. (AVParis_46,2.9) For those [mantras] in which there is a vow-distinction, one should not cite those mantras; like the condensed [version], it should be offered by one who knows the ancient meaning.

body.text: (AVParis_46,3.1) agnim īLe purohitaṃ yajñasya devam ṛtvijam | hotāraṃ ratnadhātamam ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_46,3.1) 'I praise <s>Agni</s>, the <s>purohita</s> (household priest) of the sacrifice, the divine officiant, the <s>hotṛ</s> (invoker), the greatest bestower of treasures.'

body.text: (AVParis_46,3.2) tac chaṃ yor āvṛṇīmahe gātuṃ yajñāya gātuṃ yajñapataye | daivī svastir astu naḥ svastir mānuṣebhyaḥ | ūrdhvaṃ jigātu bheṣajaṃ śaṃ no astu dvipade śaṃ catuṣpade ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_46,3.2) 'We choose that blissful one, the path for the sacrifice, the path for the lord of sacrifice. May divine blessing be ours; blessing for humans. May healing rise upward; may there be peace for our bipeds, peace for our quadrupeds.'

body.text: (AVParis_46,3.3) iṣe tvorje tvā vāyava sthopāyava stha devo vaḥ savitā prārpayatu śreṣṭhatamāya karmaṇa āpyāyadhvam aghnyā indrāya bhāgam [ūrjasvatīḥ payasvatīḥ] prajāvatīr anamīvā ayakṣmā mā va stena īśata māghaśaṃso rudrasya hetiḥ pari vo vṛṇaktu dhruvā asmin gopatau syāta bahvīr yajamānasya paśūn pāhi ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_46,3.3) 'For food, for vigor, for you; you are of <s>Vāyu</s>, you are subsidiary [deities]; may god <s>Savitṛ</s> impel you to the best ritual action. Swell up, O inviolable ones; a share for <s>Indra</s>. [Rich in vigor, rich in milk,] possessed of offspring, free from disease, free from sickness — may no thief rule over you, nor malicious ones; may <s>Rudra</s>'s missile pass around you; be steadfast in this cattle-lord; protect the many cattle of the sacrificer.'

body.text: (AVParis_46,3.4) dadhikrāvṇo akāriṣaṃ jiṣṇor aśvasya vājinaḥ | surabhi no mukhā karat pra ṇa āyumṣi tāriṣat ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_46,3.4) 'I have praised <s>Dadhikrāvan</s>, the victorious and vigorous horse. May he make our mouths fragrant; may he extend our lives.'

body.text: (AVParis_46,3.5) agna ā yāhi vītaye gṛṇāno gavyadātaye | ni hotā satsi barhiṣi ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_46,3.5) 'O <s>Agni</s>, come for the enjoyment, being praised, for the giving of cattle. Sit down as the <s>hotṛ</s> (invoker) on the <s>barhis</s> (sacred grass).'

body.text: (AVParis_46,3.6) eṣa sya te dhārayā suto 'vyo vārebhir yavane maditavyam | krīḍan raśmir apārthivaḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_46,3.6) 'This juice of yours, pressed, [passes] through the sheep-wool strainers, to be exhilarating. The sporting ray, not earthly.'

body.text: (AVParis_46,4.1) ye triṣaptā vasyobhūyāya ye triṣaptā marmāṇi te vasyobhūyāya ye triṣaptā ye diśāṃ marmāṇi te yāṃ devā vasyobhūyāya ye triṣaptāḥ samānāṃ māsām ā te nayatv ā arjanyasya ye diśāṃ kṛtyākṛtaṃ valaginam akṣitās te marmāṇi te viṣam evendraṃ mitraṃ vaśāṃ devā yāṃ deyāḥ sūrya enam annādyena yaśasā pra budhyasvāhnā pratyag vasyobhūyāya ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_46,4.1) [The <s>Samāsa</s> hymn-incipits:] 'Those thrice-seven — for greater prosperity;' 'Those thrice-seven — your vital points — for greater prosperity;' 'Those thrice-seven — those of the directions — vital points of those — the gods — for greater prosperity;' 'Those thrice-seven of the months — may he lead you — of the rain-cloud — who of the directions — sorcery-made — unkilled — vital points of those — poison indeed — <s>Indra</s>, <s>Mitra</s>, [a] cow — the gods — to be given — the sun — him — with food, with glory — awake — by day — back — for greater prosperity.'

body.text:
(AVParis_46,5.1) ye triṣaptāḥ śaṃ na āpo yathā vāto yadi no gāṃ haṃsy apendra dviṣataḥ putram attu samānāṃ vṛṣāyamāṇaḥ sūryam ṛtaṃ paripāṇam asy ā harāmiye krimaya
(AVParis_46,5.2) ā te nayatu parṇo 'sīndraputre viśvāhā te gosaniṃ vy asmai mitrāvaruṇāv ā parjānyasya svapna svapnābhikaraena devānām asthi mahāntaṃ kośaṃ yo antarikṣeṇopa śreṣṭhā aham eva vāta ivāva bādhe ye diśām

children.text: (AVParis_46,5.3) ardham ardhenaivā mahān arvāñcam indraṃ śīrṣāmayam upahatyām aśvasyāśna indrasya varūthaṃ hiraṇyavarṇā subhagā atrainān indrod āyur ud bṛhatā mano
children.translated_text: (AVParis_46,5.3) [Continued:] 'half with half indeed — great — hither-facing <s>Indra</s> — head-disease — upon the hoof — of a horse — <s>Indra</s>'s protection — golden-hued — fortunate — here these — <s>Indra</s>, up — life — up — with the great, the mind'

children.text: (AVParis_46,5.4) devo devāya sadyo jātas tastuvann agnir ivaitu śataṃ ca me yady ekādaśo 'si nāsya dhenur iṣur iva digdhā na varṣam acyutacyud etā devasenā
children.translated_text: (AVParis_46,5.4) [Continued:] 'god to the god — immediately born — they praised — like <s>Agni</s>, let it go — a hundred and for me — if you are the eleventh — not his cow — an arrow as if smeared — not the rain — the unshaken-shaker — these divine armies'

children.text: (AVParis_46,5.5) gandhāribhyaḥ sarveṣāṃ ca krimīṇāṃ tatas tatāmahāḥ prajāpate śreṣṭhenāśvinā brahmaṇāgne svāhā ghṛtād ulluptaṃ tārṣṭāghīr ayaṃ lokaḥ kṛtyākrtaṃ valaginam ||
children.translated_text: (AVParis_46,5.5) [Continued:] 'to the <s>Gandhāri</s>s — and of all worms — then from great-grandfathers — <s>Prajāpati</s> — by the best — O <s>Aśvins</s> — by <s>Brahman</s> — O <s>Agni</s>, <s>svāhā</s> — torn from the ghee — the <s>Tārṣṭāghī</s>s — this world — sorcery-made — unkilled'

body.translated_text: (AVParis_46,5.1) [Continued <s>Samāsa</s> incipits:] 'Those thrice-seven — auspicious to us, the waters — as the wind — if our cow — you slay, O <s>Indra</s> — of enemies — let the son eat — of equals — roaring like a bull — the sun — truth — protection — bring here — O worms; (AVParis_46,5.2) 'may he lead you — leaf, you are — <s>Indraputra</s> — always, your — cow-winner — for him — <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s> — of <s>Parjanya</s> — dream — dream-incantation — of the gods — bone — great treasure — who in the atmosphere — toward the best — I myself — like the wind — I repel — who of the directions'

body.text:
(AVParis_46,6.1) dive cakṣuṣe ayaṃ nas triṃśad dhāma mā no hāsiṣur yat kiṃ cedam ahaṃ jajāna yāvadaṅgīnaṃ yas te 'ṅkuśas tānūṣ ṭe vājinn āñjanasya dvādaśadhā
(AVParis_46,6.2) abhyañjanam akṣitās te yāvanto mā bradhnaḥ samīcīr yadi vāsi bṛhaspatir no yo naḥ śapāt sūyavasād yaṃ devā yathā śepo namaskṛtya marmāṇi te agneḥ śarīram

children.text: (AVParis_46,6.3) prati cakṣvāprajāstvam ito jaya [yat pratyāhanti] viṣam eva yās te śivā etaṃ vo yuvānaṃ jyotiṣmato lokān saṃ te śīrṣṇa indraṃ mitraṃ prabhrājamānām āre abhūd
children.translated_text: (AVParis_46,6.3) [Continued:] 'behold back — childlessness — hence conquer — [what strikes back] — poison indeed — your auspicious ones — this young man of yours — the luminous worlds — union for your head — <s>Indra</s>, <s>Mitra</s> — the radiant one — was far away'

children.text: (AVParis_46,6.4) etam idhmam akāmo dhīro vaśāṃ devā namas te ghoṣiṇībhyaḥ prāṇa mā mad yan mātalī apsu stīmāsu yāṃ devā bhūme mātaḥ pratyañcam arkam ūrdhvāyai tvā yadi hutām
children.translated_text: (AVParis_46,6.4) [Continued:] 'this fuel — the desireless wise one — a cow, the gods — salutation to the loud-sounding ones — O breath, not from me — which <s>Mātali</s> — in the waters, in the marshes — which gods — O Earth, Mother — back-facing, the hymn of praise — upward, for you — if offered'

children.text: (AVParis_46,6.5) sūrya enaṃ yo yajñasyābodhy agniḥ kṛṣṇāyāḥ putro annādyena yaśasā brahmāparaṃ pra budhyasvainaṃ śraddhā ahnā pratyaṃ śakvarī stha vasyobhūyāya ||
children.translated_text: (AVParis_46,6.5) [Continued:] 'the sun, him — who, of the sacrifice — <s>Agni</s> has awakened — of the black one, the son — with food, with glory — <s>Brahman</s> the other — awake — him — faith — by day — back — <s>Śakvarī</s>s you are — for greater prosperity.'

body.translated_text: (AVParis_46,6.1) [Continued:] 'for heaven, the eye — this [one], for us — thirty abodes — may they not abandon us — whatever this — I have born — as far as <s>Aṅgīna</s> — your goad — bodies for you, O Steed — of the ointment, twelve-fold; (AVParis_46,6.2) the anointing — unkilled those — as many — may not the tawny one — together — if you are — <s>Bṛhaspati</s> — our — who curses us — from the pasture — which gods — as the penis — having saluted — your vital points — <s>Agni</s>'s body'

body.text: (AVParis_46,7.1) vratair bhṛgvaṅgiraḥproktair ānupūrvyād vidhānataḥ | upasanne guruḥ kuryād vratavid brahmacāriṇi ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_46,7.1) With the vows proclaimed by <s>Bhṛgu</s> and <s>Aṅgiras</s>, in proper sequence according to procedure — the teacher should perform [the initiation] for the <s>brahmacārin</s> (student) who has approached, [the teacher] being a knower of vows.

body.text: (AVParis_46,7.2) grāmād yathoktaṃ bāhyena sthaṇḍile 'gniṃ praṇīya tu | nityenopasamādhāya saṃskṛtya juhuyādd haviḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_46,7.2) Having led the fire forward outside the village as prescribed, on a leveled ground, having established [it] with the regular [procedure], having consecrated [it], he should offer the oblation.

body.text: (AVParis_46,7.3) aupagavyā vyāhṛtayaḥ sāvitrī śāntir eva ca | vrātapatyaḥ samāsau ca tanmantrāṃhomucaiḥ saha ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_46,7.3) The <s>Aupagavya</s> <s>Vyāhṛtis</s> (sacred exclamations), the <s>Sāvitrī</s>, and the Peace [hymn] also; the <s>Vrātapati</s> (lord-of-vow) [mantras] and the <s>Samāsa</s> (condensed hymns), together with the sin-releasing [mantras].

body.text: (AVParis_46,7.4) kūṣmāṇḍyaḥ kāmasūktaṃ ca brahmavatyo 'tha devatāḥ | vratādeśe tathotsarge homaḥ kṣīrodanaḥ smṛtaḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_46,7.4) The <s>Kūṣmāṇḍī</s> [hymns], the Desire-hymn, the <s>Brahmavatī</s> [verses], and then the deities. At the instruction of the vow and its release, the oblation is prescribed to be rice cooked in milk.

body.text: (AVParis_46,7.5) utsarge kāmasūktaṃ ca pūrvāṃ cāhutim uddharet | nivedya vrātapatyo 'nte idāvatsara eva ca ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_46,7.5) At the release, the Desire-hymn; and one should raise the first oblation. Having declared [the vow] with the <s>Vrātapati</s> [mantras] at the end, and also 'For this year' —

body.text: (AVParis_46,8.1) āvartanāntaṃ sāmānyaṃ vyāhṛtyādy ubhayor api | etat sāmāsikaṃ proktam ādeśoddīkṣaṇaṃ budhaiḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_46,8.1) Up to the conclusion of the <s>Āvartana</s> (repetition), the common [procedure] with <s>Vyāhṛtis</s> and the rest [applies] to both. This is declared by the wise as the condensed instruction and initiation.

body.text: (AVParis_46,8.2) vrateṣu dakṣiṇā dhenuḥ kalyāṇī taruṇī ca yā | anaḍvān vā dhuraṃdharas tatsamaṃ vāpi kāñcanam ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_46,8.2) In vows, the <s>dakṣiṇā</s> (ritual fee) is a cow — beautiful and young; or a burden-bearing bull; or gold of equal [value].

body.text: (AVParis_46,8.3) sāvitryā atha vedasya kalpānāṃ tadanantaram | mailaṃ mailottaraṃ caiva ṣaṣṭhaṃ saṃmitam ucyate ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_46,8.3) Of the <s>Sāvitrī</s>, then of the <s>Veda</s>, of the <s>Kalpas</s>, and following that — the <s>Maila</s>, the <s>Mailottara</s>, and the sixth is called the <s>Saṃmita</s>.

body.text: (AVParis_46,8.4) ṣaḍvrataṃ brāhmaṇaṃ vidyāt trivrataṃ kṣatriyaṃ viduḥ | dvivratas tu bhaved vaiśya etad ācāryaśāsanam ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_46,8.4) A <s>Brāhmaṇa</s> should be known [to observe] six vows; a <s>Kṣatriya</s>, they know, [observes] three vows; a <s>Vaiśya</s> should observe two vows — this is the teacher's instruction.

body.text: (AVParis_46,8.5) viṣāsahiṃ sahamānam agnir mā goptā o cit sakhāyam ita eta udāruhan dhanur hastād etad ā roha candramā apsv iti ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_46,8.5) 'The vanquisher, conquering,' '<s>Agni</s>, my protector,' 'O indeed, companion,' 'From here, from there,' 'They ascended above,' 'Bow from the hand,' 'This,' 'Mount, O Moon,' 'In the waters' — thus.

body.text: (AVParis_46,9.1) om āṅgirasānām ādyaiḥ pañcānuvākaiḥ svāhā ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_46,9.1) Oṃ. <s>Svāhā</s> to the first five <s>anuvākas</s> of the <s>Āṅgirasas</s>!

body.text: (AVParis_46,9.2) ṣaṣṭhāya svāhā ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_46,9.2) <s>Svāhā</s> to the sixth!

body.text: (AVParis_46,9.3) saptamāṣṭamābhyāṃ svāhā ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_46,9.3) <s>Svāhā</s> to the seventh and eighth!

body.text: (AVParis_46,9.4) nīlanakhebhyaḥ svāhā ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_46,9.4) <s>Svāhā</s> to the Blue-nailed ones!

body.text: (AVParis_46,9.5) haritebhyaḥ svāhā ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_46,9.5) <s>Svāhā</s> to the Green ones!

body.text: (AVParis_46,9.6) kṣudrebhyaḥ svāhā ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_46,9.6) <s>Svāhā</s> to the Minor ones!

body.text: (AVParis_46,9.7) paryāyikebhyaḥ svāhā ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_46,9.7) <s>Svāhā</s> to the Cyclic ones!

body.text: (AVParis_46,9.8) prathamebhyaḥ śaṅkhebhyaḥ svāhā ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_46,9.8) <s>Svāhā</s> to the first Conch-[hymns]!

body.text: (AVParis_46,9.9) dvitīyebhyaḥ śaṅkhebhyaḥ svāhā ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_46,9.9) <s>Svāhā</s> to the second Conch-[hymns]!

body.text: (AVParis_46,9.10) tṛtīyebhyaḥ śaṅkhebhyaḥ svāhā ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_46,9.10) <s>Svāhā</s> to the third Conch-[hymns]!

body.text: (AVParis_46,9.11) upottamebhyaḥ svāhā ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_46,9.11) <s>Svāhā</s> to the Penultimate ones!

body.text: (AVParis_46,9.12) uttamebhyaḥ svāhā ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_46,9.12) <s>Svāhā</s> to the Ultimate ones!

body.text: (AVParis_46,9.13) uttarebhyaḥ svāhā ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_46,9.13) <s>Svāhā</s> to the Further ones!

body.text: (AVParis_46,9.14) ṛṣibhyaḥ svāhā ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_46,9.14) <s>Svāhā</s> to the <s>Ṛṣis</s>!

body.text: (AVParis_46,9.15) śikhibhyaḥ svāhā ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_46,9.15) <s>Svāhā</s> to the Crested ones!

body.text: (AVParis_46,9.16) gaṇebhyaḥ svāhā ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_46,9.16) <s>Svāhā</s> to the Groups!

body.text: (AVParis_46,9.17) mahāgaṇebhyaḥ svāhā ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_46,9.17) <s>Svāhā</s> to the Great Groups!

body.text: (AVParis_46,9.18) sarvebhyo 'ṅgirobhyo vidagaṇebhyaḥ svāhā ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_46,9.18) <s>Svāhā</s> to all the <s>Aṅgiras</s>es, to the Knowledge-groups!

body.text: (AVParis_46,9.19) pṛthak sahasrābhyāṃ svāhā ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_46,9.19) <s>Svāhā</s> to the two Thousands separately!

body.text: (AVParis_46,9.20) brahmaṇe svāhā ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_46,9.20) <s>Svāhā</s> to <s>Brahman</s>!

body.text: (AVParis_46,9.21) brahmajyeṣṭhā saṃbhṛtā vīryāṇi brahmāgre jyeṣṭhaṃ divam ā tatāna | bhūtānāṃ brahmā prathamo 'tha jajñe tenārhati brahmaṇā spardhituṃ kaḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_46,9.21) '<s>Brahman</s> is the eldest; powers were gathered together. <s>Brahman</s> first stretched out the sky on high. Of beings, <s>Brahman</s> was first born — who then is worthy to compete with <s>Brahman</s>?'

body.text: (AVParis_46,10.1) ātharvaṇānāṃ caturṛcebhyaḥ svāhā ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_46,10.1) <s>Svāhā</s> to the four-verse [hymns] of the <s>Ātharvaṇas</s>!

body.text: (AVParis_46,10.2) pañcarcebhyaḥ svāhā ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_46,10.2) <s>Svāhā</s> to the five-verse [hymns]!

body.text: (AVParis_46,10.3) ṣaḍarcebhyaḥ svāhā ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_46,10.3) <s>Svāhā</s> to the six-verse [hymns]!

body.text: (AVParis_46,10.4) saptarcebhyaḥ svāhā ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_46,10.4) <s>Svāhā</s> to the seven-verse [hymns]!

body.text: (AVParis_46,10.5) aṣṭarcebhyaḥ svāhā ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_46,10.5) <s>Svāhā</s> to the eight-verse [hymns]!

body.text: (AVParis_46,10.6) navarcebhyaḥ svāhā ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_46,10.6) <s>Svāhā</s> to the nine-verse [hymns]!

body.text: (AVParis_46,10.7) daśarcebhyaḥ svāhā ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_46,10.7) <s>Svāhā</s> to the ten-verse [hymns]!

body.text: (AVParis_46,10.8) ekādaśarcebhyaḥ svāhā ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_46,10.8) <s>Svāhā</s> to the eleven-verse [hymns]!

body.text: (AVParis_46,10.9) dvādaśarcebhyaḥ svāhā ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_46,10.9) <s>Svāhā</s> to the twelve-verse [hymns]!

body.text: (AVParis_46,10.10) trayodaśarcebhyaḥ svāhā ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_46,10.10) <s>Svāhā</s> to the thirteen-verse [hymns]!

body.text: (AVParis_46,10.11) caturdaśarcebhyaḥ svāhā ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_46,10.11) <s>Svāhā</s> to the fourteen-verse [hymns]!

body.text: (AVParis_46,10.12) pañcadaśarcebhyaḥ svāhā ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_46,10.12) <s>Svāhā</s> to the fifteen-verse [hymns]!

body.text: (AVParis_46,10.13) ṣoḍaśarcebhyaḥ svāhā ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_46,10.13) <s>Svāhā</s> to the sixteen-verse [hymns]!

body.text: (AVParis_46,10.14) saptadaśarcebhyaḥ svāhā ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_46,10.14) <s>Svāhā</s> to the seventeen-verse [hymns]!

body.text: (AVParis_46,10.15) aṣṭādaśarcebhyaḥ svāhā ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_46,10.15) <s>Svāhā</s> to the eighteen-verse [hymns]!

body.text: (AVParis_46,10.16) ekanaviṃśarcebhyaḥ svāhā ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_46,10.16) <s>Svāhā</s> to the nineteen-verse [hymns]!

body.text: (AVParis_46,10.17) viṃśatiḥ svāhā ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_46,10.17) <s>Svāhā</s> to the twenty[-verse hymns]!

body.text: (AVParis_46,10.18) mahatkāṇḍāya svāhā ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_46,10.18) <s>Svāhā</s> to the Great Division!

body.text: (AVParis_46,10.19) tṛcebhyaḥ svāhā ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_46,10.19) <s>Svāhā</s> to the three-verse [hymns]!

body.text: (AVParis_46,10.20) ekarcebhyaḥ svāhā ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_46,10.20) <s>Svāhā</s> to the single-verse [hymns]!

body.text: (AVParis_46,10.21) kṣudrebhyaḥ svāhā ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_46,10.21) <s>Svāhā</s> to the Minor ones!

body.text: (AVParis_46,10.22) ekānṛcebhyaḥ svāhā ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_46,10.22) <s>Svāhā</s> to the Non-verse [prose sections]!

body.text: (AVParis_46,10.23) rohitebhyaḥ svāhā ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_46,10.23) <s>Svāhā</s> to the <s>Rohita</s> [hymns]!

body.text: (AVParis_46,10.24) sūryābhyāṃ svāhā ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_46,10.24) <s>Svāhā</s> to the two Solar [hymns]!

body.text: (AVParis_46,10.25) vrātyābhyāṃ svāhā ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_46,10.25) <s>Svāhā</s> to the two <s>Vrātya</s> [hymns]!

body.text: (AVParis_46,10.26) prājāpatyābhyāṃ svāhā ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_46,10.26) <s>Svāhā</s> to the two <s>Prājāpatya</s> [hymns]!

body.text: (AVParis_46,10.27) viṣāsahyai svāhā ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_46,10.27) <s>Svāhā</s> to the <s>Viṣāsahī</s> [hymn]!

body.text: (AVParis_46,10.28) maṅgalikebhyaḥ svāhā ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_46,10.28) <s>Svāhā</s> to the Auspicious ones!

body.text: (AVParis_46,10.29) brahmaṇe svāhā ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis_46,10.29) <s>Svāhā</s> to <s>Brahman</s>!

body.text: (AVParis_46,10.30) brahmajyeṣṭhā saṃbhṛtā vīryāṇi brahmāgre jyeṣṭhaṃ divam ā tatāna | bhūtānāṃ brahmā prathamo 'tha jajñe tenārhati brahmanā spardhituṃ ka iti ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 46.10.30) The powers assembled are eldest in <s>Brahman</s>; <s>Brahman</s> first stretched forth the highest heaven. <s>Brahman</s> was born as the first of beings — who then is worthy to compete with that <s>Brahman</s>?

body.text:
(Pariśiṣṭa_47. varṇapaṭalam)
(AVParis_47,1.1) oṃ varṇān pūrvaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ prākṛtā ye ca vaikṛtāḥ | śrutinirvacanāt sarve vivadante vivṛttiṣu ||
body.translated_text: (Pariśiṣṭa 47: The Chapter on Phonemes) (AVParis 47.1.1) Oṃ. We shall first expound the phonemes (<s>varṇa</s>s), both primary and modified; due to differences in phonetic description (<s>śruti</s>), all dispute about their articulations.

body.text: (AVParis_47,1.2) vṛttiḥ karaṇaṃ varṇānāṃ karṇayos tu śrutir yathā | śrutipradeśād vimatas tad yathā varṇa ucyate ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 47.1.2) Articulation is the instrument of phonemes, while <s>śruti</s> (perception) is [the instrument] of the ears; from the domain of perception a disagreement arises — thus a phoneme is defined.

body.text: (AVParis_47,1.3) samānasaṃdhyakṣarāṇi sparśā antaḥsthā ūṣmāṇaḥ | etair anye na dṛśyante etāvān varṇasaṃcayaḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 47.1.3) The letters of equal juncture are the stops (<s>sparśa</s>s), semivowels (<s>antaḥsthā</s>s), and sibilants (<s>ūṣman</s>s); by these [alone] others are not perceived — such is the total collection of phonemes.

body.text: (AVParis_47,1.4) [yeṣāṃ ca śrutisaṃhitāyāṃ vibhāge asadṛśī syāt || tān eva varnān virudrādaye ca pradise kṛtaḥ] ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 47.1.4) [Those whose classification in the phonetic tradition (<s>śrutisaṃhitā</s>) would be dissimilar in division — those very phonemes and the <s>virudra</s> and others are treated in this section.]

body.text: (AVParis_47,1.5) ye varṇābhyāṃ śrūyante ca yeṣāṃ nāsti vibhāgataḥ | mānasāṃś cāpi saṃgrāhyān upadeśena vartayet ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 47.1.5) Those phonemes that are heard by both [ears] and for which there is no differentiation — one should teach these, including the mental ones, by instruction.

body.text: (AVParis_47,1.6) krāntān bahir nidhānasya yamāṃś cānanunāsikān | savyākṣepaṃ tato varṇān upadeśena vartayet ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 47.1.6) Those that have gone beyond the repository, the <s>yama</s>s (twin sounds) that are non-nasal — one should teach those phonemes, together with their modifications, by instruction.

body.text: (AVParis_47,1.7) iti varṇāḥ svarāḥ proktās teṣām ādyāś caturdaśa | samānākṣarāṇy ucyante śeṣaḥ saṃdhyakṣarāṇi tu ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 47.1.7) Thus the phonemes and vowels (<s>svara</s>s) are declared; of these, the first fourteen are called 'equal letters' (<s>samānākṣara</s>s), and the rest are 'juncture letters' (<s>saṃdhyakṣara</s>s).

body.text: (AVParis_47,1.8) anavarṇasvaro nāmi kādayo vyañjanaṃ smṛtam | pañcaviṃśatir ādyaiṣāṃ sparśā vargāś ca pañcakāḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 47.1.8) The vowel which is not a-sound is called by name [a specific vowel]; those beginning with 'ka' are regarded as consonants (<s>vyañjana</s>); of these, the first twenty-five are stops (<s>sparśa</s>s), and the classes (<s>varga</s>s) are five groups.

body.text: (AVParis_47,1.9) catvāro yādayo 'ntaḥsthāḥ śādir ūṣmāṣṭako gaṇaḥ | ayogavāhā vartante teṣām ādyāḥ pṛthagvidhāḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 47.1.9) The four beginning with 'ya' are semivowels (<s>antaḥsthā</s>s); the group of eight beginning with 'śa' are sibilants (<s>ūṣman</s>s); the auxiliary sounds (<s>ayogavāha</s>s) function [independently] — of these, the primary ones are of various kinds.

body.text: (AVParis_47,1.10) visarjanīyo 'nusvāro jigvāmūlīya [ity adhaḥ] | upadhmānīya ity ete catvāro 'tha pare yamāḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 47.1.10) <s>Visarjanīya</s> (aspiration), <s>anusvāra</s> (nasal resonance), <s>jihvāmūlīya</s> (tongue-root sound) [placed] below; <s>upadhmānīya</s> (lip-breath) — these are four; and the others are <s>yama</s>s (twin sounds).

body.text: (AVParis_47,1.11) nāsikyābhinidhānau ca vidyate yena pūraṇam | pañcaṣaṣṭir iyān vāco rāśir yo vedalokayoḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 47.1.11) The nasal closure by which filling [of sound] occurs — this collection of sixty-five [phonemes] constitutes the totality of speech in the Vedic and worldly domains.

body.text: (AVParis_47,1.12) mukhanāsike ye varṇā ucyante te 'nunāsikāḥ | samānāsyaprayatnā ye te savarṇā iti smṛtāḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 47.1.12) Those phonemes produced through the mouth and nose are called nasalized (<s>anunāsika</s>); those having the same oral effort are regarded as homogeneous (<s>savarṇa</s>).

body.text: (AVParis_47,1.13) hrasvo 'varṇaparas tasya savarṇasya ca vācakaḥ | hrasvottaras tu dīrgho 'pi tasmāt tasmāt tasyaiva vācakaḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 47.1.13) The short a-sound designates its homogeneous class; and the long [vowel], being preceded by the short, therefore designates that same [class].

body.text: (AVParis_47,1.14) vargāntaras tu vargādir vargasya grāhako mataḥ | vargāṇāṃ ca yathāsaṃkhyaṃ prathamāditvam iṣyate ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 47.1.14) The first member of a class is considered to denote the [entire] class; and the ordering of the classes is held to be sequential from the first onward.

body.text: (AVParis_47,1.15) akāreṇocyate 'tas tu kāro yasmāt paro bhavet | tasya tad grahaṇaṃ bodhyaṃ kakāro 'tra nidarśanam ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 47.1.15) By the letter 'a' is denoted 'atas' (from that); the syllable '<s>kāra</s>' that follows after — one should understand its designation [accordingly]; the 'ka-kāra' serves as the illustration here.

body.text: (AVParis_47,1.16) vyañjanaṃ ghoṣavatsaṃjñam antaḥsthā haḥ parau yamau | trayastrayaś ca vargāntyā agoṣaḥ śeṣa ucyate ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 47.1.16) A consonant with voicing (<s>ghoṣa</s>) is so designated; semivowels, 'ha,' the subsequent <s>yama</s>s, and the last three of each class [are voiced]; the rest are called voiceless (<s>aghoṣa</s>).

body.text: (AVParis_47,1.17) śaṣasāś ca yamau dvau ca dvitīyāḥ prathamāś ca ye | aghoṣā vyañjanaśeṣaṃ ghoṣavad dṛśyate budhaiḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 47.1.17) 'Śa,' 'ṣa,' 'sa,' and two <s>yama</s>s, and those that are the second and first [of each class] — these are voiceless; the remaining consonants are seen by the learned as voiced.

body.text: (AVParis_47,1.18) ataḥ sthānāni varṇānāṃ kaṇṭho 'varṇahakārayoḥ | vosarjanīya ai au ca svādyayor mātrayoḥ smṛtaḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 47.1.18) Now the places of articulation (<s>sthāna</s>) of the phonemes: the throat (<s>kaṇṭha</s>) is [the place] for the a-vowel and 'ha'; <s>visarjanīya</s>, 'ai,' 'au,' and the two half-measures of the preceding [vowels] are also remembered [as guttural].

body.text: (AVParis_47,1.19) śeṣas tālvoṣṭhayor bodhyaḥ sa yathāsaṃkhyam iṣyate | dvisthānaṃ yamayoś cāpi vargāntyānāṃ ca śiṣyate ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 47.1.19) The rest should be known [as produced] from the palate and the lips — that is held in sequential order; and for the <s>yama</s>s and the class-final [nasals], dual articulation points are taught.

body.text: (AVParis_47,1.20) jihvāmūlām ṛvarṇasya kavargasya ca bhāṣyate | yaś caiva jihvāmūlīya Lvarṇaś ceti ca smṛtaḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 47.1.20) The root of the tongue is stated as [the place of articulation] for the ṛ-vowel and the ka-class; and also for the <s>jihvāmūlīya</s>; the Ḷ-vowel is likewise so regarded.

body.text: (AVParis_47,2.1) tālv eyaśacavargāṇām ivarṇasya ca bhāṣyate | mūrdhā sthānaṃ ṣakārasya ṭavargasya tathā mataḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 47.2.1) The palate is [the place] for the ya-śa-ca classes and the i-vowel, it is stated; the crown of the head (<s>mūrdhan</s>) is held as the place for 'ṣa' and the ṭa-class.

body.text: (AVParis_47,2.2) dantā lasatavargāṇām uvarṇas tv oṣṭhya ucyate | upadhmānīya okāro vaḥ pavargaś ca tathā matāḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 47.2.2) The teeth are [the place] for la-sa-ta classes; the u-vowel is called labial; <s>upadhmānīya</s>, 'o,' 'va,' and the pa-class are likewise held [as labial].

body.text: (AVParis_47,2.3) nāsikye nāsikā sthānaṃ tathānusvāra iṣyate | yamā vargottamāś cāpi yathoktaṃ caiva te matāḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 47.2.3) For nasalized sounds, the nose is the place of articulation; so too for <s>anusvāra</s>; the <s>yama</s>s and class-final [nasals] — as stated — are also so regarded.

body.text: (AVParis_47,2.4) rephasya dantamūlāni pratyag vā tebhya iṣyate | iti sthānāni varṇānāṃ kīrtitāni yathākramam ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 47.2.4) For <s>repha</s> (the 'r' sound), the roots of the teeth or the area behind them is held [as the place]; thus the places of articulation of the phonemes have been enumerated in order.

body.text: (AVParis_47,2.5) apara āha | hanumūle tu rephaḥ syād dantamūleṣu vā punaḥ | pratyag vā dantamūlebhyo mūrdhanya iti cāpare ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 47.2.5) Another [authority] says: <s>repha</s> should be at the root of the jaw, or at the roots of the teeth, or behind the roots of the teeth — and others [say it is] cerebral.

body.text: (AVParis_47,2.6) uraḥstho ghoṣo visṛṣṭaḥ kaṇṭhadeśe nihanyate | tato nādo vitiṣṭhate tasya vikṛtir akṣaram ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 47.2.6) Voice (<s>ghoṣa</s>), stationed in the chest, when released, strikes at the region of the throat; from that arises <s>nāda</s> (resonance), and its modification is the syllable.

body.text: (AVParis_47,2.7) pūrvābhir aṇumātrābhiḥ kaṇṭhyaṃ saṃsevyate 'kṣaram | uttarābhis tu mātrābhir mukhavikṛtir ucyate ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 47.2.7) By the preceding minute measures, the guttural syllable is articulated; by the subsequent measures, what is called oral modification [is produced].

body.text: (AVParis_47,2.8) api prayogasya hetoḥ saṃyogaḥ saha dhāryate | avyavahito 'kṣareṇa nānāvarṇaḥ svarodayaḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 47.2.8) And for the purpose of usage, conjunction (<s>saṃyoga</s>) is held together; [it is] uninterrupted by a syllable — a multi-phoneme [cluster] with vowel arising.

body.text: (AVParis_47,2.9) dvitīyeṣu tathoṣmaṇāṃ tṛtīyeṣu ca ghoṣāṇām | caturtheṣu ghoṣoṣmaṇām upadeśena vartayet ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 47.2.9) In the second [stops], breath (<s>ūṣman</s>) [is present]; in the third, voicing (<s>ghoṣa</s>); in the fourth, both voicing and breath — one should teach [these] by instruction.

body.text: (AVParis_47,2.10) uttameṣu tu nāsikyam antaḥstheṣu ghoṣaṃ smṛtam | hakārasya ghoṣoṣmāṇāv upadeśena vartayet ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 47.2.10) In the last [of each class], nasality; in the semivowels, voicing is remembered; for 'ha,' both voicing and breath — one should teach by instruction.

body.text: (AVParis_47,3.1) ṛkārākṣarayo repham aṇumātra sarva... | svaritasya dvaidhībhāve upadeśena vartayet ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 47.3.1) Between the ṛ-sound and the syllable, <s>repha</s> [has] a minute measure throughout...; in the bifurcation of <s>svarita</s> (circumflex), one should teach by instruction.

body.text: (AVParis_47,3.2) ṛvarṇadeśasaṃdeho 'svaraḥ syāt syād anantaram | paro vā yadi vā pūrvo repham eva tu viddhi tam ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 47.3.2) When there is doubt about the position of the ṛ-sound — whether it is without vowel, whether it comes after or before — know it to be <s>repha</s> itself.

body.text: (AVParis_47,3.3) akāraś ca ikāraś ca ukāra ṛkāra eva ca | hrasvadīrghaplutāḥ sarve Lvarṇe nāsti dīrghatā ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 47.3.3) The a-sound, i-sound, u-sound, and ṛ-sound indeed — all [have] short, long, and protracted [forms]; in the Ḷ-sound there is no long [form].

body.text: (AVParis_47,3.4) ekāraś ca tathāikāra okāra aukāra eva ca | dīrghamātraplutās teṣāṃ saṃjjā saṃdhyakṣarāṇi ca ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 47.3.4) The e-sound and ai-sound, the o-sound and au-sound — they have long and protracted measures; their designation is '<s>saṃdhyakṣara</s>' (juncture-letters).

body.text: (AVParis_47,3.5) udāttaś cānudāttāś ca svaritāḥ kampitāś ca ye | anunāsikās tathā śuddhā dṛśyate hrasvatā budhaiḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 47.3.5) <s>Udātta</s> (raised), <s>anudātta</s> (unraised), <s>svarita</s> (circumflex), and <s>kampita</s> (tremulous), nasalized and pure — shortness [in all these] is perceived by the learned.

body.text: (AVParis_47,3.6) varṇāḥ pañcaṣaṣṭiḥ svarā dvāviṃśatiḥ samānākṣarāṇi caturdaśa aṣṭau saṃdhyakṣarāṇy ekonaviṃśatir nāminas tricatvāriṃśad vyañjanānisparśāḥ pañcaviṃśatiś catvāras tv antaḥsthāḥ catvāro yamāś cāṣṭāv ūṣmāṇo 'yogavāhā daśāyogavāhā daśa ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 47.3.6) The phonemes are sixty-five: vowels twenty-two; equal letters fourteen, juncture-letters eight — [totaling] nineteen vowels; forty-three consonants — stops twenty-five, four semivowels, four <s>yama</s>s, eight sibilants; auxiliary sounds (<s>ayogavāha</s>s) ten — ten auxiliary sounds.

body.text:
(Pariśiṣṭa_48. kautsavyaniruktanighaṇṭuḥ)
(AVParis_48,1) om atharvaṇe namaḥ ||
body.translated_text: (Pariśiṣṭa 48: The <s>Kautsavya</s> <s>Nirukta</s>-<s>Nighaṇṭu</s> [Etymological Glossary]) (AVParis 48.1) Oṃ. Homage to <s>Atharvan</s>!

body.text:
(AVParis_48,2) [pacati | pacate | aśanaśi | sisrate | gameḥ | vāyi | cāyi ||1 || vyāpi | cakri | devā caṣṭe | ava cākaśat | vyānaśe | triṣi niṣāmayatyoḥ | yoṣṭiḥ sapte ca ||2 || riñjati] |
(AVParis_48,3) vaśmi | vaśmi | uśmasi | ava veti | vāñchati | veṣṭi | vanoti | juṣate | haryati | ācake | uśik | manyate | achāntsuḥ ||3 || chantsat | cākanat | cakamānaḥ | kanati | kāniṣat | kāme ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 48.2-3) [He cooks | he cooks (middle) | he eats | he streams | (root) of going | blowing | perceiving ||1|| pervading | making | the gods behold | he looked down | he perishes | in the two roots meaning 'to observe' and 'to grasp' | grasping | and in 'sapta' (seven) ||2|| he goes] | I desire | I desire | we desire | he goes away | he blows | he desires | he wishes | he obtains | he delights in | he loves | he takes | he yearns | the devoted one | he thinks | they sought ||3|| he sought | he shone | the desiring one | he sounds | he desired | in desire —

body.text: (AVParis_48,4) mimeti ||4 || nardati | dhvanati ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 48.4) He bellows ||4|| he roars | he resounds —

body.text:
(AVParis_48,5) dhvaṃsate | [kṛṇati | kiṃśakte ||]
(AVParis_48,6) vanati | bhanati | [starṣati |] sphūrjati ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 48.5-6) He falls | [he makes | he is able ||] he strikes | he speaks | [he hastens |] he thunders —

body.text: (AVParis_48,7) hlādate | [nirṛte |] hlādayati ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 48.7) He delights | [he destroys |] he gladdens —

body.text: (AVParis_48,8) śabdayati ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 48.8) He makes sound —

body.text: (AVParis_48,9) arcati | arcati | rebhati | gāyati | jalpati | stobhati | stauti | yauti | rauti | nauti | gadati | nadati | bhanati | bhanate | [tatrate |] paṇate | paṇasyati | paṇāyate | bhandate | [yatrasyate. kṛkṛmdhampāt] kṛpaṇyati | dhamati | sapati | papṛkṣāḥ | gūrdhayati | vedayati | vādayati ||5 || valgūyati | mahayati | mantrayate | sevate | pṛcchati ||6 || chandati | śaśamānaḥ | jarate | [charati |] venati | vandate ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 48.9) He praises | he praises | he sings | he chants | he babbles | he utters praise-syllables | he lauds | he yokes | he cries | he praises | he speaks | he sounds | he speaks | he speaks (middle) | [he extends |] he trades | he deals | he barters | he proclaims | [he grasps in exchange |] he is wretched | he blows | he serves | he who would nourish | he makes heavy | he makes known | he makes sound ||5|| he speaks sweetly | he magnifies | he takes counsel | he serves | he asks ||6|| he desires | the reciting one | he ages | [he wanders |] he seeks | he honors —

body.text: (AVParis_48,10) irajati | irajyati ||7 ||vidhema | duvasyati | namasyati | vivāsati | ṛdhnoti | ṛṇaddhi | ṛcchati ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 48.10) He goes toward | he moves toward ||7|| we worship | he serves | he pays homage | he seeks | he succeeds | he fills | he attains —

body.text: (AVParis_48,11) pari srava | parisrava ||8 || pavasva | abhy arṣa | āśiṣaḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 48.11) Pour around | pour around ||8|| purify yourself | flow hither | blessings —

body.text: (AVParis_48,12) īmahe | īmahe | yāmi | manmahe | daddhi | pūrdhi | śagdhi | mimīhi | rirīhi | ririḍhḍhi | mimiḍhḍhi | pīparat | yantāraḥ | iṣudhyati | vanemahi | manāmahe | yācate ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 48.12) We implore | we implore | I go | we think | give | fill | be able | measure out | bestow | bestow | bestow | may he protect | the drivers | he is eager for arrows | may we win | we think | he begs —

body.text: (AVParis_48,13) <dāsati |> dāsati ||9 || dāśati | śikṣati | mahate | pṛṇāti | rāti | rāsati | prāti | tuñjati | [matsyati |] dadāti ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 48.13) <He gives |> He gives ||9|| he gives | he offers | he is great | he fills | he bestows | he bestows | he gives | he impels | [he competes |] he gives —

body.text: (AVParis_48,14) yryṣyati | uruṣyati ||10 || piparti | pārayati | pāti | pāsati | prāti | tuñjati | pṛṇāti | rakṣe ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 48.14) He rescues | he rescues ||10|| he protects | he conveys across | he guards | he guards | he gives | he impels | he fills | I protect —

body.text:
(AVParis_48,15) <ā vayati |> ā vayati | bharvati | babhasti | venati | veti | veveṣṭi | aviṣyan | [praga] psāti | bapsati | bhasathaḥ | babdhām |
(AVParis_48,16) [vadati | ādeti | tirati | tviṣyati | hinoti | vṛddheḥ ||]
