(AVParis_48,17) [utpapīti | utpapīti ||11 || tapati | pippahu | sahoti | yugbhidī bhedayojanayoś ca ||]
(AVParis_48,18) heḍate | heḍate ||12 || bhāmate | hṛṇīyate | bhrīṇāti | bhreṣate | dodhati | heḍaḥ | haraḥ | hṛṇiḥ | tyajaḥ | bhāmaḥ | manyuḥ | krodhe nāmāni ca krodhasya ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 48.15-18) <He weaves toward |> He weaves toward | he devours | he chews | he seeks | he blows | he blows mightily | they were blowing | [he would] seize | he falls | you two devour | let him bind | [he speaks | he goes forward | he crosses | he shines | he impels | of increase ||] [He drank up | he drank up ||11|| he heats | drink | he conquers | the yoker-splitter, in both splitting and joining ||] He is angry | he is angry ||12|| he rages | he is enraged | he injures | he detests | he shakes | anger | wrath | fury | abandonment | rage | passion | — these are the names of anger and [the synonyms] of anger.

body.text: (AVParis_48,19) śnathati | śnathati ||13 || [dovati | kurvati |] tūrvati | [manuṣyati | dhanuṣyati |] śṛṇāti | mṛṇāti | bhṛjjati | amati | tṛṇeḍhi | dabhnoti | [śūṣati |] dhvarati | dhūrvati | kṛntati | śvasati | snehayati | mṛdnāti | [sradhnāti |] dāsati | stṛṇute | starate | [kṛṇāti |] ni tojati | ni vapati | [amati | riti |] yātayate | ākhaṇḍala | taḍit | hiṃsāyām ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 48.19) He strikes | he strikes ||13|| [he cuts | he cuts |] he overcomes | [he acts like a man | he acts like a bow |] he breaks | he crushes | he roasts | he goes | you crush | he subdues | [he blows |] he injures | he injures | he cuts | he breathes forcibly | he anoints | he grinds | [he weakens |] he enslaves | he spreads | he spreads | [he makes |] he pushes down | he fells | [he goes | he goes |] he punishes | the thunderbolt-wielder (<s>Ākhaṇḍala</s>) | lightning | — in the sense of injuring.

body.text: (AVParis_48,20) inaddhi | inaddhi ||14 || svarati | hṛṣyati | pathati | sṛjati | jyotate | dyotate | [dyopyate |] bhrājate | bhrāśate | dīdayati | sādhate | dyumat | jamat | kalmalīkinam | malmalābhavan | jañjaṇābhavan | arciḥ | śociḥ | tapaḥ | tejaḥ | haraḥ | sṛṅgāṇi | jvalejvalataś ca nāmāni ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 48.20) He binds | he binds ||14|| he sounds | he rejoices | he recites | he releases | he shines | he shines | [he gleams |] he shines | he glitters | he blazes | he succeeds | radiant | born | stained | they blazed | they clashed | flame | radiance | heat | splendor | brilliance | horns | — these are the names of blazing and of the blazing one.

body.text: (AVParis_48,21) <irajyati |> irajyati ||15 || patyate | kṣayti | rājati | īśvare ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 48.21) <He rules |> He rules ||15|| he governs | he rules | he reigns | — in the sense of being lord.

body.text:
(AVParis_48,22) [svastyayalepī | svape ||]
(AVParis_48,23) siṣakti | secati | secate ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 48.22-23) [A benedictory salve | sleep ||] He accompanies | he sprinkles | he sprinkles —

body.text: (AVParis_48,24) [abibhaste |] abhi dāsate | abhi manyate ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 48.24-25) [He threatens |] he overpowers | he despises —

body.text: (AVParis_48,25) bibharti | dadhati | dhārayate ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 48.25) He bears | he places | he holds —

body.text: (AVParis_48,26) hṛṇīyate | bhṛṇīyate ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 48.26) He is angry | he is angry —

body.text: (AVParis_48,27) vādayate | punāti | paṇāyati | pūjayati | vadati | [kusī | hūrchi | sāsudyati |] ślāghāyām ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 48.27) He makes speak | he purifies | he barters | he worships | he speaks | [various roots |] — in the sense of praising.

body.text:
(AVParis_48,28) sūrkṣati | [rādale | cvyucchati | ra prasāde | śarulipsāyām | mukṣati |] sādare | [vyucchati | apramāde | śarulipsāyām | vyākhadi | pṛthagbhāve oṣadhikicchrajīvane | daśasyati | drohe | pīyati | spardhāyām | vakṣati | nivāse | iṣṭāti | svādane ||]
(AVParis_48,29) pibati | pāne ||
body.translated_text:
(AVParis 48.28) <s>sūrkṣati</s> | [<s>rādale</s> | <s>cvyucchati</s> | in the sense of grace | <s>śaru</s>, in the sense of desire | <s>mukṣati</s> |] in the sense of respect | [<s>vyucchati</s> | in the sense of heedfulness | <s>śaru</s>, in the sense of desire | <s>vyākhadi</s> | in the sense of separation, of healing with herbs and livelihood | <s>daśasyati</s> | in the sense of malice | <s>pīyati</s> | in the sense of rivalry | <s>vakṣati</s> | in the sense of dwelling | <s>iṣṭāti</s> | in the sense of tasting ||]
(AVParis 48.29) <s>pibati</s> | in the sense of drinking ||

body.text: (AVParis_48,30) dhinoti | prītau ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 48.30) <s>dhinoti</s> | in the sense of pleasing ||

body.text: (AVParis_48,31) jinvati | ubhayatra ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 48.31) <s>jinvati</s> | in both senses ||

body.text: (AVParis_48,32) jigharti | secane ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 48.32) <s>jigharti</s> | in the sense of sprinkling ||

body.text:
(AVParis_48,33) [visvati | visyāpye ||]
(AVParis_48,34) gopayati | gopane ||
body.translated_text:
(AVParis 48.33) [<s>visvati</s> | in the sense of pervasion ||]
(AVParis 48.34) <s>gopayati</s> | in the sense of guarding ||

body.text: (AVParis_48,35) śumbhati | śobhane ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 48.35) <s>śumbhati</s> | in the sense of adorning ||

body.text: (AVParis_48,36) muñcati | śuddhau ca ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 48.36) <s>muñcati</s> | also in the sense of purification ||

body.text: (AVParis_48,37) śardhati | dhvaṃsane ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 48.37) <s>śardhati</s> | in the sense of demolishing ||

body.text: (AVParis_48,38) mṛdati | sukhane ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 48.38) <s>mṛdati</s> | in the sense of happiness ||

body.text: (AVParis_48,39) cakṣurbhir māhate | dṛśihāne ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 48.39) 'He sees with eyes' — <s>māhate</s> | in the sense of seeing and abandoning ||

body.text: (AVParis_48,40) vindati | lābhe ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 48.40) <s>vindati</s> | in the sense of gaining ||

body.text: (AVParis_48,41) puṣyati | vṛddhau ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 48.41) <s>puṣyati</s> | in the sense of increase ||

body.text: (AVParis_48,42) [kobhati] | kṣaye | dasyati ca ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 48.42) [<s>kobhati</s>] | in the sense of diminution | also <s>dasyati</s> ||

body.text:
(AVParis_48,43) [srośita ca | litagutau ||]
(AVParis_48,44) ṛñjati | [pārjanyaḥ |] ṛjugamane ||
body.translated_text:
(AVParis 48.43) [also <s>srośita</s> | in the sense of being bound ||]
(AVParis 48.44) <s>ṛñjati</s> | [<s>Parjanya</s> |] in the sense of going straight ||

body.text:
(AVParis_48,45) [vācauṣṭayati | vilāse ||]
(AVParis_48,46) radati | khanane ||
body.translated_text:
(AVParis 48.45) [<s>vācauṣṭayati</s> | in the sense of playfulness ||]
(AVParis 48.46) <s>radati</s> | in the sense of digging ||

body.text: (AVParis_48,47) [sevati | ā krośati | sparśe ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 48.47) [<s>sevati</s> | cries out | in the sense of touching ||

body.text: (AVParis_48,48) nasati | rnacate ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 48.48) <s>nasati</s> | <s>ṛnacate</s> ||

body.text:
(AVParis_48,49) jigharti | grahaṇe | giraṇe ca ||]
(AVParis_48,50) mandati | tṛptau ||
body.translated_text:
(AVParis 48.49) <s>jigharti</s> | in the sense of seizing | and in the sense of swallowing ||]
(AVParis 48.50) <s>mandati</s> | in the sense of satisfaction ||

body.text:
(AVParis_48,51) [amani | bhāvane ||]
(AVParis_48,52) cakrati | prativedane ||
body.translated_text:
(AVParis 48.51) [<s>amani</s> | in the sense of becoming ||]
(AVParis 48.52) <s>cakrati</s> | in the sense of making known ||

body.text: (AVParis_48,53) jakṣati | kṣutsahane ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 48.53) <s>jakṣati</s> | in the sense of enduring hunger ||

body.text: (AVParis_48,54) śliṣyati | āśleṣe ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 48.54) <s>śliṣyati</s> | in the sense of embracing ||

body.text: (AVParis_48,55) bhajati | prepsāyām ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 48.55) <s>bhajati</s> | in the sense of desiring to obtain ||

body.text: (AVParis_48,56) sevati | sevāyām ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 48.56) <s>sevati</s> | in the sense of serving ||

body.text: (AVParis_48,57) hlādayati | śītībhāvane ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 48.57) <s>hlādayati</s> | in the sense of making cool ||

body.text: (AVParis_48,58) kāśati | prakāśane ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 48.58) <s>kāśati</s> | in the sense of shining ||

body.text: (AVParis_48,65) nirṛtiḥ | nirṛtiḥ ||22 ||kṛcchram | tṛpram | duḥkhasya ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 48.65) Synonyms of <s>nirṛti</s> (destruction) ||22||: <s>kṛcchram</s> | <s>tṛpram</s> | — these are synonyms of suffering ||

body.text: (AVParis_48,66) <tuvi> tuvi | puru | bhūri | śaśvat | viśvam | vyānaśiḥ | vyomanī | śatam | sahasram | ayutam | niyutam | prayutam | arbudam | atyarbudam | asaṃkhyeyam | sariram | bahoḥ ||

body.text: (AVParis_48,69) navam | navam ||23 || nūtanam | nūtanam | navyam | adhunā | idānīm | navasya ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 48.69) Synonyms of <s>navam</s> (new) ||23||: <s>nūtanam</s> | <s>nūtanam</s> | <s>navyam</s> | <s>adhunā</s> | <s>idānīm</s> | — these are synonyms of the new ||

body.translated_text: (AVParis 48.70) Synonyms of <s>pratnam</s> (ancient) ||24||: <s>pradivaḥ</s> | <s>pravayāḥ</s> | <s>sanemi</s> | [<s>moktaḥ</s> | <s>māhuḥ</s> | <s>yataḥ</s> |] — these are synonyms of the ancient ||

body.translated_text: (AVParis 48.71) [<s>adhāhyaḥ</s>] ||25||: <s>satrā</s> | <s>baṭ</s> | <s>ṛtam</s> | <s>addhā</s> | — these are synonyms of truth ||

body.translated_text: (AVParis 48.110) Resplendent (<s>vibhāvarī</s>) | <s>vibhāvarī</s> | beautiful (<s>sūnarī</s>) | [<s>bhāvatī</s> | <s>sunarī</s>] radiant (<s>bhāsvarī</s>) | luminous (<s>ahanā</s>) | illuminating (<s>dyotanā</s>) | white (<s>śvetyā</s>) | ruddy (<s>aruṣī</s>) | gracious-speech (<s>sūnṛtāvarī</s>) — these are synonyms of dawn (<s>uṣasas</s>) ||59||

body.text: (AVParis_48,111) vastoḥ | vastoḥ | bhānuḥ | vāsaram | svasarāṇi | ghraṃsaḥ | gharmaḥ | ghṛṇiḥ | divā | dinam | dive<dive> | dyavidyavi | ahnaḥ ||60 ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 48.111) <s>Vastos</s> (at dawning) | <s>vastos</s> | ray (<s>bhānu</s>) | the day-time (<s>vāsaram</s>) | portions of the day (<s>svasarāṇi</s>) | heat (<s>ghraṃsa</s>) | warmth (<s>gharma</s>) | glow (<s>ghṛṇi</s>) | by day (<s>divā</s>) | day (<s>dinam</s>) | day by day (<s>divedive</s>) | daily (<s>dyavidyavi</s>) — these are synonyms of day (<s>ahnas</s>) ||60||

body.text: (AVParis_48,112) dīdhitayaḥ | gabhastayaḥ | vanam | usrāḥ | vasavaḥ | marīcayaḥ | sapta ṛṣayaḥ | sādhyāsaḥ | suparṇāsaḥ | mayūkhāḥ | raśmīnām ||61 ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 48.112) Rays (<s>dīdhitayas</s>) | beams (<s>gabhyastayas</s>) | <s>vanam</s> | <s>usrā</s>s (bright ones) | <s>vasava</s>s (good ones) | light-particles (<s>marīcayas</s>) | the Seven <s>Ṛṣi</s>s | the <s>Sādhya</s>s | fair-winged (<s>suparṇāsa</s>s) | ray-beams (<s>mayūkhā</s>s) — these are synonyms of rays (<s>raśmīnām</s>) ||61||

body.text: (AVParis_48,113) khedayaḥ | khedayaḥ | kiraṇāḥ | gāvaḥ | abhīśavaḥ | [raśmīn |] raśmīnāṃ ca ||62 ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 48.113) <s>Khedaya</s>s (piercers) | <s>khedaya</s>s | <s>kiraṇā</s>s (beams) | cows (<s>gāva</s>s) | reins (<s>abhīśavas</s>) | [<s>raśmīn</s> |] — and also of rays (<s>raśmīnām</s>) ||62||

body.text: (AVParis_48,114) āryaḥ | āryaḥ | rāṣṭrī | niyutvān | inaḥ | īśvarasya ||63 ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 48.114) Noble (<s>ārya</s>) | <s>ārya</s> | ruler (<s>rāṣṭrī</s>) | team-possessor (<s>niyutvān</s>) | lord (<s>ina</s>) — these are synonyms of the sovereign (<s>īśvarasya</s>) ||63||

body.text: (AVParis_48,115) saṃyogaḥ | saṃyogaḥ | āśuśukṣaṇiḥ | jahā | śitāma | mehanā | mūṣaḥ | mandū | īrmāntāsaḥ | [vājarāndhyam |] kāyamānaḥ | vidradhe | tugvani | [nodhāt | nadaḥ |] cyavanaḥ | kaśyapaḥ | nū cit | akūpārasya | aprāyuvaḥ | rajaḥ | juhure | krāṇā | viṣuṇaḥ | jāmiḥ | jasuriḥ | cayase | andhaḥ | dugdham | āhanaḥ | nadaḥ | arkaḥ | sacā | cit | pavitram | pṛthujrayāḥ | kāṇukā | adhriguḥ | āṅgūṣaḥ | āpāntamanyuḥ | śmaśā | vājagandhyam | [jarādhya |] pākasthāmā kaurayāṇaḥ | vrandī | niṣṣapī | kṣumpam | nicumpuṇaḥ | [majāyema | dhṛruḥ |] joṣavākam | kuṭasya | kepayaḥ | salalūkam | askṛdhoyuḥ | niśṛmbhāḥ | [dhruvadrakṣam |] upalaprakṣiṇī | upasi | savīmani | vidathāni | śrāyanta iva | amūraḥ | vijāmātuḥ | amavān | amīvā | amatiḥ | riśādasaḥ | ānuṣak | girvaṇāḥ | amyak | yādṛśmin | śurudhaḥ | apratiṣkutaḥ | dvibarhāḥ | urāṇaḥ | javāru | tatanuṣṭim | ilībiśaḥ | [irāviṇaḥ |] kiyedhāḥ | turīpam | pratadvasū | diviṣṭiṣu | dūtaḥ | ṛcīṣamaḥ | anarśarātim ||64 || anarvā | [anarvā | cāṇḍā | vālhā] jaḍhavaḥ | bakuraḥ | [vaktāraḥ] bekanāṭān | abhi dhetana | sadānve | parāśaraḥ | karūḍatī | danaḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 48.115) Conjunction (<s>saṃyoga</s>) | <s>saṃyoga</s> | <s>āśuśukṣaṇi</s> (quickly kindling) | <s>jahā</s> | <s>śitāma</s> | <s>mehanā</s> | <s>mūṣa</s> | <s>mandū</s> | <s>īrmāntāsa</s>s | [<s>vājarāndhya</s> |] <s>kāyamāna</s> | abscess (<s>vidradhe</s>) | <s>tugvani</s> | [<s>nodhāt</s> | <s>nada</s> |] <s>Cyavana</s> | <s>Kaśyapa</s> | <s>nū cit</s> | sea (<s>akūpāra</s>) | the undying (<s>aprāyuva</s>s) | dust (<s>rajas</s>) | they offered (<s>juhure</s>) | <s>krāṇā</s> | <s>viṣuṇa</s> (divergent) | kindred (<s>jāmi</s>) | exhausted (<s>jasuri</s>) | you gather (<s>cayase</s>) | dark (<s>andha</s>) | milk (<s>dugdham</s>) | <s>āhana</s> | <s>nada</s> | <s>arka</s> | together (<s>sacā</s>) | indeed (<s>cit</s>) | purifier (<s>pavitra</s>) | wide-moving (<s>pṛthujrayā</s>s) | <s>kāṇukā</s> | <s>adhrigu</s> | <s>āṅgūṣa</s> | <s>Āpāntamanyu</s> | <s>śmaśā</s> | <s>vājagandhya</s> | [<s>jarādhya</s> |] <s>Pākasthāman Kaurayāṇa</s> | <s>vrandī</s> | <s>niṣṣapī</s> | <s>kṣumpa</s> | <s>nicumpuṇa</s> | [<s>majāyema</s> | <s>dhṛru</s> |] <s>joṣavāka</s> | <s>kuṭa</s> | <s>kepaya</s>s | <s>salalūka</s> | <s>askṛdhoyu</s> (untiring) | <s>niśṛmbhā</s>s | [<s>dhruvadrakṣa</s> |] <s>upalaprakṣiṇī</s> | <s>upasi</s> | <s>savīmani</s> | assemblies (<s>vidathāni</s>) | as if streaming | wise (<s>amūra</s>) | <s>vijāmātṛ</s> | strong (<s>amavān</s>) | affliction (<s>amīvā</s>) | folly (<s>amati</s>) | devourers (<s>riśādasa</s>s) | in succession (<s>ānuṣak</s>) | beloved of prayers (<s>girvaṇā</s>s) | closely (<s>amyak</s>) | of whatever kind (<s>yādṛśmin</s>) | bountiful (<s>śurudha</s>s) | irresistible (<s>apratiṣkuta</s>) | double-layered (<s>dvibarhā</s>s) | <s>urāṇa</s> | <s>javāru</s> | <s>tatanuṣṭi</s> | <s>ilībiśa</s> | [<s>irāviṇa</s> |] <s>kiyedhā</s>s | <s>turīpa</s> | <s>pratadvasū</s> | in divine battles (<s>diviṣṭiṣu</s>) | messenger (<s>dūta</s>) | <s>ṛcīṣama</s> | <s>anarśarāti</s> ||64|| Unassailable (<s>anarvā</s>) | [<s>anarvā</s> | <s>cāṇḍā</s> | <s>vālhā</s>] <s>jaḍhava</s>s | <s>bakura</s> | [speakers (<s>vaktāras</s>)] <s>bekanāṭā</s>n | overwhelm (<s>abhi dhetana</s>) | <s>sadānve</s> | <s>Parāśara</s> | <s>karūḍatī</s> | <s>dana</s>

body.text: (AVParis_48,116) ikṣuṇā | kīlālam | vijāmni | doṣā | [aṣṭamartyaḥ] ||65 || jyeṣṭham | [jyeṣṭham | asipakva |] viśvāhā | vivasavān | vāte | [tanyantaḥ | vrālma | kāmpīvakaṃsam | jasyatyam | jalālī |] andhaḥ | vipaśyan | ayā ciṣṭhā | [āṃsā | rantu | tamāyīvayaḥ |] śamopyāt | gulphaḥ | biṣkale khargalā | pratodaḥ | vedaḥ | [yatrāsmannataḥ | radhraḥ | cikriḥ | nuluḥ |] pucchadhau | [suniḥ |] apāṣṭhaḥ | medī | [jyenā |] maryaḥ | [saptaghnetaḥ |] vālini | yātāram | [ruṣaṃkiḥ | siktaḥ |] sagaṇāḥ | [muḍimnānā | liṅgakāḥ | nādinā |] malvaḥ | amnaḥ | [juguḥ |] nīlāgalasālā | ailabaḥ | [daridraḥ |] nīlalohitaḥ | śvāpadaḥ | kunakhī | kurīram | [upasaḥ |] tāduri | [kamatha | rumathā | sarvartebhyaḥ | idam | adhvaryuḥ | dyumnī | kuvitaḥ | damnanā |] duroṇe | [parektauti] | titau | [utpavādhata |] kimīdī | vāmasya | ekacakram | amatiḥ | sumatiḥ | [dayate | dayanti | vrīhi | vṛtte] ||66 || īḍe | īḍe | kṣayati | tapati | rajati | anekārthāḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 48.116) With sugarcane (<s>ikṣuṇā</s>) | sweet drink (<s>kīlāla</s>) | <s>vijāmni</s> | night (<s>doṣā</s>) | [<s>aṣṭamartya</s>s] ||65|| The chief (<s>jyeṣṭha</s>) | [<s>jyeṣṭha</s> | <s>asipakva</s> |] always (<s>viśvāhā</s>) | <s>vivasavān</s> | in the wind (<s>vāte</s>) | [<s>tanyanta</s>s | <s>vrālma</s> | <s>kāmpīvakam̐sa</s> | <s>jasyatya</s> | <s>jalālī</s> |] blind (<s>andha</s>) | seeing (<s>vipaśyan</s>) | <s>ayā ciṣṭhā</s> | [<s>āṃsā</s> | <s>rantu</s> | <s>tamāyīvaya</s>s |] <s>śamopyāt</s> | ankle (<s>gulpha</s>) | <s>biṣkale khargalā</s> | goad (<s>pratoda</s>) | <s>veda</s> | [<s>yatrāsmannata</s>s | <s>radhra</s> | <s>cikri</s> | <s>nulu</s> |] <s>pucchadhau</s> | [<s>suni</s> |] <s>apāṣṭha</s> | pillar (<s>medī</s>) | [<s>jyenā</s> |] young man (<s>marya</s>) | [<s>saptaghneta</s>s |] <s>vālini</s> | liberator (<s>yātāram</s>) | [<s>ruṣaṃki</s> | <s>sikta</s> |] with troops (<s>sagaṇā</s>s) | [<s>muḍimnānā</s> | <s>liṅgakā</s>s | <s>nādinā</s> |] <s>malva</s> | <s>amna</s> | [<s>jugu</s> |] <s>nīlāgalasālā</s> | <s>ailaba</s> | [poor (<s>daridra</s>) |] <s>nīlalohita</s> (blue-red) | wild beast (<s>śvāpada</s>) | having bad nails (<s>kunakhī</s>) | headdress (<s>kurīra</s>) | [<s>upasa</s> |] <s>tāduri</s> | [<s>kamatha</s> | <s>rumathā</s> | for all | this | the <s>adhvaryu</s> | illustrious (<s>dyumnī</s>) | <s>kuvita</s> | <s>damnanā</s> |] in the home (<s>duroṇe</s>) | [<s>parektauti</s>] | <s>titau</s> | [<s>utpavādhata</s> |] <s>kimīdī</s> | of the desirable (<s>vāmasya</s>) | one-wheeled (<s>ekacakram</s>) | folly (<s>amati</s>) | wisdom (<s>sumati</s>) | [<s>dayate</s> | <s>dayanti</s> | rice (<s>vrīhi</s>) | <s>vṛtte</s>] ||66|| I praise (<s>īḍe</s>) | <s>īḍe</s> | he dwells (<s>kṣayati</s>) | he burns (<s>tapati</s>) | he shines (<s>rajati</s>) — these are words with multiple meanings (<s>anekārthā</s>s)

body.text: (AVParis_48,117) prapitve | abhīke | prāptasya ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 48.117) At the arrival (<s>prapitve</s>) | in encounter (<s>abhīke</s>) — these are synonyms of 'attained' (<s>prāptasya</s>)

body.text: (AVParis_48,118) tiraḥ | sataḥ | aprāptasya ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 48.118) Beyond (<s>tiras</s>) | truly (<s>satas</s>) — these are synonyms of 'unattained' (<s>aprāptasya</s>)

body.text: (AVParis_48,119) tvaḥ | nemaḥ | ardhasya ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 48.119) <s>Tvas</s> | <s>nemas</s> — these are synonyms of 'half' (<s>ardhasya</s>)

body.text: (AVParis_48,120) ṛkṣāḥ | stṛbhiḥ | iti nakṣatrāṇām ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 48.120) Bears (<s>ṛkṣā</s>s) | with stars (<s>stṛbhis</s>) — these are synonyms of stars (<s>nakṣatrāṇām</s>)

body.text: (AVParis_48,121) vamrībhiḥ | upajihvikā | sīmikānām ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 48.121) With ants (<s>vamrībhis</s>) | secondary tongue (<s>upajihvikā</s>) — these are synonyms of worms/insects (<s>sīmikānām</s>)

body.text: (AVParis_48,122) rambhaḥ | [rathaḥ |] pinākam | iti daṇḍasya ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 48.122) <s>Rambha</s> (staff) | [<s>ratha</s> (chariot) |] <s>Pināka</s> — these are synonyms of the rod (<s>daṇḍasya</s>)

body.text: (AVParis_48,123) śepaḥ | vaitasaḥ | iti puṃsprajananasya ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 48.123) <s>Śepa</s> | <s>vaitasa</s> — these are synonyms of the male generative organ (<s>puṃsprajananasya</s>)

body.text: (AVParis_48,124) [paraṃgativilīke] | iti strīprajananasya ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 48.124) [<s>Paraṃgativilīke</s>] — this is a synonym of the female generative organ (<s>strīprajananasya</s>)

body.text:
(AVParis_48,125) anena | anayā | [panasya]]
(AVParis_48,126) maki | hvakir] | iti pratiṣedhasya ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 48.125-126) By this (<s>anena</s>) | by this (<s>anayā</s>) | [<s>panasya</s>] | <s>maki</s> | <s>hvakir</s>] — these are synonyms of prohibition (<s>pratiṣedhasya</s>)

body.text: (AVParis_48,127) varūtham | [asagram] | carmaṇo 'rutsāhasya ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 48.127) Shield (<s>varūtham</s>) | [<s>asagram</s>] — of leather, [a synonym] of valor (<s>sāhasya</s>)

body.text: (AVParis_48,128) paṇiḥ prakalavid vaṇijaḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 48.128) <s>Paṇi</s> (trader) | <s>prakalavid</s> — these are synonyms of merchant (<s>vaṇijas</s>)

body.text: (AVParis_48,129) śvaghnī | kitavasya | akṣadhūrtasya ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 48.129) <s>Śvaghnī</s> (dog-slayer) | of the gambler (<s>kitavasya</s>) — these are synonyms of the dice-cheat (<s>akṣadhūrtasya</s>)

body.text: (AVParis_48,130) [mṛṇyaḥ] | sīmikasya ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 48.130) [<s>Mṛṇya</s>s] — synonym of the creeping creature (<s>sīmikasya</s>)

body.text: (AVParis_48,131) kuṭasya | kuliśaḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 48.131) Of the <s>kuṭa</s> (hammer) | <s>kuliśa</s> (axe) [is the synonym]

body.text: (AVParis_48,132) agniḥ | jātavedāḥ | vaiśvānaraḥ | draviṇodāḥ | vanaspatir iti sūktabhāñji ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 48.132) <s>Agni</s> | <s>Jātavedas</s> | <s>Vaiśvānara</s> | <s>Draviṇodas</s> (wealth-giver) | <s>Vanaspati</s> (lord of the forest) — these are the verse-initial [deity names] (<s>sūktabhāñji</s>)

body.text: (AVParis_48,133) idhmaḥ | [viṣṇuḥ |] tanūnapāt | narāśaṃsaḥ | devīr dvāraḥ | uṣāsānaktā | daivyā hotārā | tisro devīḥ | tvaṣṭā | vanaspatiḥ | svāhākṛtaya iti nipātabhāñji ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 48.133) Fuel (<s>idhma</s>) | [<s>Viṣṇu</s> |] <s>Tanūnapāt</s> (self-born) | <s>Narāśaṃsa</s> (man-praiser) | the divine doors (<s>devīr dvāras</s>) | <s>Uṣāsānaktā</s> (Dawn and Night) | the two divine priests (<s>daivyā hotārā</s>) | the three goddesses (<s>tisro devīs</s>) | <s>Tvaṣṭā</s> | <s>Vanaspati</s> (lord of the forest) | the <s>Svāhā</s>-makers (<s>svāhākṛtayas</s>) — these are the formulaic insertions (<s>nipātabhāñji</s>)

body.text: (AVParis_48,134) indraḥ | viṣṇuḥ | somaḥ | parjanyaḥ | ṛtuḥ | agnāyī | pṛthivī | iḍā | bhṛgavaḥ | atharvāṇa iti saṃstavikās tasyaikavad bahuvat strīvac ca ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 48.134) <s>Indra</s> | <s>Viṣṇu</s> | <s>Soma</s> | <s>Parjanya</s> | <s>Ṛtu</s> (Season) | <s>Agnāyī</s> | <s>Pṛthivī</s> (Earth) | <s>Iḍā</s> | the <s>Bhṛgu</s>s | the <s>Atharvan</s>s — these are the deities to be praised together; and of these, [the forms are] singular, plural, and feminine.

body.text: (AVParis_48,135) vahanam <ca haviṣām āvāhanaṃ ca> devānāṃ yac ca dāeṣṭiviṣayikaṃ tad asya karma ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 48.135) The conveyance of oblations and the invocation of the gods, and whatever pertains to the domain of the <s>dāeṣṭi</s> (offering) — that is its ritual function.

body.text: (AVParis_48,136) ayaṃ lokaḥ | vasantaḥ | prātaḥsavanam | gāyatrī trivṛd rathaṃtaram iti tadbhaktīni ||67 ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 48.136) This world | spring | the morning pressing | <s>Gāyatrī</s> metre, the nine-versed <s>stoma</s>, and the <s>Rathantara</s> <s>sāman</s> — these are its allotments. ||67||

body.text: (AVParis_48,137) vāyuḥ | varuṇaḥ | indraḥ | rudraḥ | parjanyaḥ | bṛhaspatiḥ | brahmaṇaspatiḥ | vāstoṣpatiḥ | kṣetrasya patiḥ | kaḥ | yamaḥ | apāṃ napāt | mitraḥ | viśvakarmā | manyuḥ | tārkṣyaḥ | dadhikrāḥ | sarasvān | agniḥ | asunītiḥ | vājaḥ | kutaḥ | vātaḥ | ṛtaḥ | mṛtyuḥ | dhātā | vidhātā | purūravāḥ | gandharvāḥ | anaḍvān | prāṇāḥ | stambhaḥ | vrātya iti sūktabhāñji ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 48.137) <s>Vāyu</s> | <s>Varuṇa</s> | <s>Indra</s> | <s>Rudra</s> | <s>Parjanya</s> | <s>Bṛhaspati</s> | <s>Brahmaṇaspati</s> | <s>Vāstoṣpati</s> | Lord of the field | <s>Ka</s> (Who?) | <s>Yama</s> | <s>Apāṃ Napāt</s> (Son of Waters) | <s>Mitra</s> | <s>Viśvakarman</s> | <s>Manyu</s> (Wrath) | <s>Tārkṣya</s> | <s>Dadhikrā</s> | <s>Sarasvān</s> | <s>Agni</s> | <s>Asunīti</s> | <s>Vāja</s> | <s>Kutaḥ</s> | <s>Vāta</s> | <s>Ṛta</s> (Cosmic Order) | <s>Mṛtyu</s> (Death) | <s>Dhātṛ</s> | <s>Vidhātṛ</s> | <s>Purūravas</s> | the <s>Gandharva</s>s | the Bull | the <s>Prāṇa</s>s (life-breaths) | Pillar | <s>Vrātya</s> — these are the ones with [dedicated] hymns (<s>sūktabhāñji</s>).

body.text: (AVParis_48,138) prajāpatiḥ | candramāḥ | somaḥ | induḥ | aditiḥ | dhenavaḥ | ahir budhnya iti nipātabhāñji ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 48.138) <s>Prajāpati</s> | Moon | <s>Soma</s> | <s>Indu</s> | <s>Aditi</s> | the Milch-cows | <s>Ahir Budhnya</s> (Serpent of the Deep) — these are the ones occurring incidentally (<s>nipātabhāñji</s>).

body.text: (AVParis_48,139) sarasvatī | vāk | aditiḥ | urvaśī | gauḥ | dhenuḥ | saramā | uṣā | indrāṇī | pṛthivī | dasya | godhukasā | virāṭ | aghnyā | sinīvālī | kuhūḥ | anumatiḥ | rākā | yamī | saraṇyūḥ | pathyā | rodasī | devapatnyaḥ | marutaḥ | rudrāḥ | ṛbhavaḥ | aṅgirasaḥ | bhṛgavaḥ | atharvāṇa iti saṃstavikās tasyaikavad bahuvat strīvac ca ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 48.139) <s>Sarasvatī</s> | <s>Vāk</s> (Speech) | <s>Aditi</s> | <s>Urvaśī</s> | Cow | Milch-cow | <s>Saramā</s> | <s>Uṣas</s> (Dawn) | <s>Indrāṇī</s> | <s>Pṛthivī</s> (Earth) | <s>Dasyā</s> | <s>Godhukasā</s> | <s>Virāṭ</s> | the Inviolable one | <s>Sinīvālī</s> | <s>Kuhū</s> | <s>Anumati</s> | <s>Rākā</s> | <s>Yamī</s> | <s>Saraṇyū</s> | <s>Pathyā</s> | <s>Rodasī</s> | the Wives of the gods | the <s>Marut</s>s | the <s>Rudra</s>s | the <s>Ṛbhu</s>s | the <s>Aṅgiras</s>es | the <s>Bhṛgu</s>s | the <s>Atharvan</s>s — these are the deities to be praised together; and of these, [the forms are] singular, plural, and feminine.

body.text: (AVParis_48,140) snehānupradānaṃ vṛtravadho yā cakā ca balakṛtis tad asya karma ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 48.140) The bestowal of moisture, the slaying of <s>Vṛtra</s>, and whatever is a display of strength — that is its ritual function.

body.text: (AVParis_48,141) antarikṣalokaḥ | grīṣmaḥ | madhyaṃdinaṃ savanam | triṣṭup pañcadaśaḥ | bṛhad iti tadbhaktīni ||68 ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 48.141) The intermediate world (atmosphere) | summer | the midday pressing | <s>Triṣṭubh</s> metre, the fifteen-versed <s>stoma</s>, and the <s>Bṛhat</s> <s>sāman</s> — these are its allotments. ||68||

body.text: (AVParis_48,142) ādityaḥ | savitā | bhagaḥ | sūryaḥ | pūṣā | viṣṇuḥ | keśī | viśvānaraḥ | vṛṣākapiḥ | kālaḥ | brahmacārī | rohita iti sūktabhāñji ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 48.142) <s>Āditya</s> (the Sun) | <s>Savitṛ</s> | <s>Bhaga</s> | <s>Sūrya</s> | <s>Pūṣan</s> | <s>Viṣṇu</s> | <s>Keśin</s> | <s>Vaiśvānara</s> | <s>Vṛṣākapi</s> | <s>Kāla</s> (Time) | <s>Brahmacārin</s> | <s>Rohita</s> — these are the ones with [dedicated] hymns (<s>sūktabhāñji</s>).

body.text: (AVParis_48,143) dadhyaṅ | atharvā | yamaḥ | aja ekapāt | manuḥ | vivasvān | dakṣaḥ | aryamā | vaiśvānaraḥ | suparṇa iti nipātabhāñji ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 48.143) <s>Dadhyañc</s> | <s>Atharvā</s> | <s>Yama</s> | <s>Aja Ekapāt</s> (One-footed Goat) | <s>Manu</s> | <s>Vivasvān</s> | <s>Dakṣa</s> | <s>Aryaman</s> | <s>Vaiśvānara</s> | <s>Suparṇa</s> (the divine Eagle) — these are the ones occurring incidentally (<s>nipātabhāñji</s>).

body.text: (AVParis_48,144) uṣāḥ | sūryā | vṛṣākapāyī | sādhyāḥ | vasavaḥ | ādityā | sapta ṛṣayaḥ | vājinaḥ | viśve devā iti saṃstavikās tasyaikavad bahuvat strīvac ca ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 48.144) <s>Uṣas</s> (Dawn) | <s>Sūryā</s> | <s>Vṛṣākapāyī</s> | the <s>Sādhya</s>s | the <s>Vasu</s>s | the <s>Āditya</s>s | the Seven Sages | the <s>Vājin</s>s | the <s>Viśve Devāḥ</s> (All-gods) — these are the deities to be praised together; and of these, [the forms are] singular, plural, and feminine.

body.text: (AVParis_48,145) <rasādānam> raśmibhiś ca rasādhāraṇaṃ yac ca <pravalhitam> tad asta karma ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 48.145) The extraction of essence and the sustaining of essence by rays, and whatever has been propelled forth — that is its ritual function.

body.text: (AVParis_48,146) asya lokaḥ | varaṣās | tṛtīyasavanam | jagatī | saptadaśaḥ | vairūpām iti tadbhaktīni ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 48.146) The yonder world | the rains | the third pressing | <s>Jagatī</s> metre, the seventeen-versed <s>stoma</s>, and the <s>Vairūpa</s> <s>sāman</s> — these are its allotments.

body.text:
(AVParis_48,147) eteṣām eva lokānām ṛtuchandaḥstomapṛṣṭhānām ānupūrveṇa bhaktiśeṣo 'nukalpo
(AVParis_48,148) devatādvandve ca pūrvasyāparaḥ saṃstavikaḥ || pūrvasyāparaḥ saṃstavikaḥ ||69 ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 48.147-148) Of these same worlds, the remaining allotments of season, metre, <s>stoma</s>, and <s>pṛṣṭha</s> [are assigned] in sequential order; this is the alternative arrangement. And in a pair of deities, the latter is the companion-in-praise of the former. The latter is the companion-in-praise of the former. ||69||

body.text:
(Pariśiṣṭa_49. caraṇavyūhaḥ)
(AVParis_49,1.1) om athātaś caraṇavyūhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||
body.translated_text: (<s>Pariśiṣṭa</s> 49: The <s>Caraṇavyūha</s> [Classification of Vedic Schools]) (AVParis 49.1.1) Oṃ. Now we shall expound the <s>Caraṇavyūha</s> (classification of Vedic schools).

body.text: (AVParis_49,1.2) tatra catvāro vedā bhavanti | ṛgvedo yajurvedaḥ sāmavedo brahmavedaś ceti ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 49.1.2) Therein, there are four <s>Veda</s>s: the <s>Ṛgveda</s>, the <s>Yajurveda</s>, the <s>Sāmaveda</s>, and the <s>Brahmaveda</s> (i.e. <s>Atharvaveda</s>).

body.text: (AVParis_49,1.3) tatra ṛgvedasyārthaśāstram upavedaḥ | yajurvedasya dhanurvedopavedaḥ | sāmavedasya gāndharvavedopavedaḥ | brahmavedasyāyurvedopavedaḥ | abhicārakārthaśāstram ity ucyate ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 49.1.3) Of these, the subsidiary knowledge (<s>Upaveda</s>) of the <s>Ṛgveda</s> is the science of politics (<s>Arthaśāstra</s>); the <s>Upaveda</s> of the <s>Yajurveda</s> is the science of archery (<s>Dhanurveda</s>); the <s>Upaveda</s> of the <s>Sāmaveda</s> is the science of music (<s>Gāndharvaveda</s>); the <s>Upaveda</s> of the <s>Brahmaveda</s> is the science of medicine (<s>Āyurveda</s>). The sorcery [section] is called <s>Arthaśāstra</s> (science of practical aims).

body.text: (AVParis_49,1.4) ṛgveda ātreyasagotro 'gnir devatā | yajurvedaḥ kāśyapasagotro vāyur devatā | sāmavedo bhāradvājasagotro viṣṇur devatā | brahmavedo vaitāyanasagotro brahmā devatā ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 49.1.4) The <s>Ṛgveda</s> belongs to the <s>Ātreya</s> <s>gotra</s> (lineage) and has <s>Agni</s> as its deity. The <s>Yajurveda</s> belongs to the <s>Kāśyapa</s> <s>gotra</s> and has <s>Vāyu</s> as its deity. The <s>Sāmaveda</s> belongs to the <s>Bhāradvāja</s> <s>gotra</s> and has <s>Viṣṇu</s> as its deity. The <s>Brahmaveda</s> belongs to the <s>Vaitāyana</s> <s>gotra</s> and has <s>Brahmā</s> as its deity.

body.text: (AVParis_49,1.5) athāta ṛgvedaḥ pītavarṇaḥ padmapattrākṣaḥ suvibhaktagrīvaḥ kuñcitakeśaśmaśruḥ supratiṣṭhitajānujaṅghaḥ | pramāṇena sa vitastayaḥ pañca ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 49.1.5) Now, the <s>Ṛgveda</s> [personified] is of golden complexion, with eyes like lotus petals, with a well-proportioned neck, with curly hair and beard, with well-set knees and shanks; his measure is five <s>vitasti</s>s (spans) in height.

body.text: (AVParis_49,1.6) tatra ṛgvedasya sapta śākhā bhavanti | tad yathā | āśvalāyanāḥ | śāṅkhāyanāḥ | sādhyāyanāḥ | śākalāḥ | bāṣkalāḥ | audumbarāḥ | māṇḍūkāś ceti ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 49.1.6) Of the <s>Ṛgveda</s>, there are seven branches (<s>śākhā</s>s), namely: the <s>Āśvalāyana</s>s, the <s>Śāṅkhāyana</s>s, the <s>Sādhyāyana</s>s, the <s>Śākala</s>s, the <s>Bāṣkala</s>s, the <s>Audumbara</s>s, and the <s>Māṇḍūka</s>s.

body.text: (AVParis_49,1.7) teṣām adhyayanam | ṛcāṃ daśa sahasrāṇi ṛcāṃ pañca śatāni ca | ṛcām aśītiḥ pādaś ca etat pāraṇam ucyate ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 49.1.7) Their course of study [consists of]: ten thousand <s>ṛc</s>s (verses), five hundred <s>ṛc</s>s, and eighty [more] — and a quarter [verse]; this is declared the completion [of study].

body.text: (AVParis_49,2.1) tatra yajurvedasya caturviṃśatir bhedā bhavanti || tad yathā | kāṇvāḥ | mādhyaṃdināḥ | jābālāḥ | śāpeyāḥ | śvetāḥ | śvetatarāḥ | tāmrāyaṇīyāḥ | paurṇavatsāḥ | āvaṭikāḥ | paramāvaṭikāḥ | hauṣyāḥ | dhauṣyāḥ | khāḍikāḥ | āhvarakāḥ | carakāḥ maitrāḥ | maitrāyaṇīyāḥ | hāritakarṇāḥ | śālāyanīyāḥ | marcakaṭhāḥ | prācyakaṭhāḥ | kapiṣṭhalakaṭhāḥ | upalāḥ | taittirīyāś ceti ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 49.2.1) Of the <s>Yajurveda</s>, there are twenty-four divisions, namely: the <s>Kāṇva</s>s, the <s>Mādhyaṃdina</s>s, the <s>Jābāla</s>s, the <s>Śāpeya</s>s, the <s>Śveta</s>s, the <s>Śvetatara</s>s, the <s>Tāmrāyaṇīya</s>s, the <s>Paurṇavatsa</s>s, the <s>Āvaṭika</s>s, the <s>Paramāvaṭika</s>s, the <s>Hauṣya</s>s, the <s>Dhauṣya</s>s, the <s>Khāḍika</s>s, the <s>Āhvaraka</s>s, the <s>Caraka</s>-<s>Maitra</s>s, the <s>Maitrāyaṇīya</s>s, the <s>Hāritakarṇa</s>s, the <s>Śālāyanīya</s>s, the <s>Marcakaṭha</s>s, the <s>Prācyakaṭha</s>s, the <s>Kapiṣṭhalakaṭha</s>s, the <s>Upala</s>s, and the <s>Taittirīya</s>s.

body.text: (AVParis_49,2.2) teṣām adhyayanam | dve sahasre śate nyūne vede vājasaneyake | sakalaṃ parisaṃkhyātaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ tu caturguṇam ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 49.2.2) Their course of study [consists of]: in the <s>Vājasaneyi</s> <s>Veda</s>, two thousand [verses] less a hundred; the <s>Brāhmaṇa</s> in its entirety is enumerated as four times that.

body.text: (AVParis_49,2.3) aṣṭādaśa śatāni bhavanti | tāny eva triguṇam adhītya kramapāro bhavati | saptasu vīrāś ceti ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 49.2.3) There are eighteen hundred [mantras]; having studied those same threefold, one becomes a <s>Kramapāra</s> (completer of the step-by-step recitation); and [there are] heroes in seven [branches].

body.text: (AVParis_49,2.4) śākhās tisro bhavanti | tad yathā | vārcikam arthādhyayanīyāḥ | pāraścaryāḥ | pāraśramaṇīyāḥ | pārakramavaṭaḥ | kramapāraś ceti ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 49.2.4) There are three branches, namely: the <s>Vārcika</s> (verse-based) students, the <s>Pārascaryā</s>s, the <s>Pāraśramaṇīya</s>s, the <s>Pārakravaṭa</s>, and the <s>Kramapāra</s>.

body.text: (AVParis_49,2.5) ṣaḍ aṅgāny adhītya ṣaḍaṅgavid bhavati | śikṣā kalpo vyākaraṇaṃ niruktaṃ chando jyotiṣam iti ṣaḍ aṅgāni ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 49.2.5) Having studied the six limbs (<s>Aṅga</s>s), one becomes a knower of the six limbs. [They are:] <s>Śikṣā</s> (phonetics), <s>Kalpa</s> (ritual procedure), <s>Vyākaraṇa</s> (grammar), <s>Nirukta</s> (etymology), <s>Chandas</s> (metre), and <s>Jyotiṣa</s> (astronomy) — these are the six limbs.

body.text: (AVParis_49,2.6) atha yajurvedaḥ prāṃśuḥ pralambajaṭharaḥ sthūlagalakapālo rakto varṇena prādeśāḥ ṣaḍ dīrghatvena yajurvedasyaitad rūpaṃ bhavati ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 49.2.6) Now, the <s>Yajurveda</s> [personified] is tall, with a pendulous belly, with a thick skull, red in complexion; his length is six <s>prādeśa</s>s (spans) — this is the form of the <s>Yajurveda</s>.

body.text:
(AVParis_49,3.1) tatra sāmavedasya śākhāsahasram āsīd anadhyāyeṣv adhīyānāḥ sarve te śakreṇa vinihatāḥ | [pravilīnās]
(AVParis_49,3.2) tatra ke cid avaśiṣṭāḥ pracaranti | tad yathā | rāṇāyanīyāḥ | sādyamugrāḥ | kālapāḥ | mahākālapāḥ | kauthumāḥ | lāṅgalikāś ceti ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 49.3.1-2) Of the <s>Sāmaveda</s>, there were a thousand branches; those who studied during prohibited periods — all of them were destroyed by <s>Śakra</s> (<s>Indra</s>). [They were annihilated.] Of those, some remnants survive and are current, namely: the <s>Rāṇāyanīya</s>s, the <s>Sādyamugra</s>s, the <s>Kālapā</s>s, the <s>Mahākālapā</s>s, the <s>Kauthuma</s>s, and the <s>Lāṅgalika</s>s.

body.text: (AVParis_49,3.3) kauthumānāṃ ṣaḍ bhedā bhavanti | tad yathā | sārāyaṇīyāḥ | vātarāyaṇīyāḥ | vaitadhṛtāḥ | prācīnās tejasāḥ | aniṣṭakāś ceti ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 49.3.3) Of the <s>Kauthuma</s>s, there are six divisions, namely: the <s>Sārāyaṇīya</s>s, the <s>Vātarāyaṇīya</s>s, the <s>Vaitadhṛta</s>s, the <s>Prācīna</s>s, the <s>Tejasa</s>s, and the <s>Aniṣṭaka</s>s.

body.text: (AVParis_49,3.4) teṣām adhyayanam | aṣṭau sāmasahasrāṇi sāmāni ca caturdaśa | sohyāni sarahasyāni etat sāmagaṇaṃ smṛtam ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 49.3.4) Their course of study [consists of]: eight thousand <s>sāman</s>s and fourteen [more] <s>sāman</s>s; together with the <s>Ūhya</s>s (modifications) and the <s>Rahasya</s>s (esoteric portions) — this is remembered as the total count of <s>Sāman</s>s.

body.text: (AVParis_49,3.5) atha sāmavedaḥ suvarcāḥ sugandhis tejasvī mṛduvaktā brahmaṇyaḥ pralambabāhur duścarmī kṛṣṇo varṇena kātaraḥ svareṇeti ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 49.3.5) Now, the <s>Sāmaveda</s> [personified] is radiant, fragrant, lustrous, soft-spoken, devoted to <s>Brahman</s>, with long arms, of rough skin, dark in complexion, and wavering in tone.

body.text: (AVParis_49,3.6) ṣaḍaratniḥ pramāṇena ca smṛtaḥ | stuvanty ṛṣayo brahmā sāmāni tiṣṭhati saṃnidhau sa bhagavān sāmavedo maheśvarabhaktaḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 49.3.6) He is six forearm-lengths in measure, it is remembered. The sages praise <s>Brahmā</s> while the <s>Sāman</s>s stand near. That venerable <s>Sāmaveda</s> is devoted to <s>Maheśvara</s> (the Great Lord).

body.text:
(AVParis_49,4.1) tatra brahmavedasya nava bhedā bhavanti | tad yathā | paippalādāḥ | staudāḥ | maudāḥ | śaunakīyāḥ | jājalāḥ | jaladāḥ | brahmavadāḥ | devadarśāḥ | cāraṇavaidyāś ceti |
(AVParis_49,4.2) teṣām adhyayanam | ṛcāṃ dvādaśa sahasrāṇy aśītis triśatāni ca | paryāyikaṃ dvisahasrāṇy anyāṃs caivārcikān bahūn ity
(AVParis_49,4.3) etadgrāmyāraṇyakāni ṣaṭ sahasrāṇi bhavanti ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 49.4.1-3) Of the <s>Brahmaveda</s> (<s>Atharvaveda</s>), there are nine divisions, namely: the <s>Paippalāda</s>s, the <s>Stauda</s>s, the <s>Mauda</s>s, the <s>Śaunakīya</s>s, the <s>Jājala</s>s, the <s>Jalada</s>s, the <s>Brahmavada</s>s, the <s>Devadarśa</s>s, and the <s>Cāraṇavaidya</s>s. Their course of study [consists of]: twelve thousand <s>ṛc</s>s, eighty, and three hundred; the additional recitations number two thousand, and many other hymn-verses besides. The forest (<s>Āraṇyaka</s>) and village portions together amount to six thousand.

body.text: (AVParis_49,4.4) tatra brahmavedasyāṣṭāviṃśatir upaniṣado bhavanti | muṇḍakā praśnakā brahmavidyā kṣurikā cūlikā atharvaśiro atharvaśikhā garbhopaniṣan mahopaniṣad brahmopaniṣat prāṇāgnihotraṃ māṇḍukyaṃ nādabindu brahmabindu amṛtabindu dhyānabindu tejobindu yogaśikhā yogatattvaṃ nīlarudraḥ pañcatāpinī ekadaṇḍī saṃnyāsavidhiḥ aruṇiḥ haṃsaḥ paramahaṃsaḥ nārāyaṇopaniṣad vaitathyaṃ ceti ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 49.4.4) Of the <s>Brahmaveda</s>, there are twenty-eight <s>Upaniṣad</s>s: <s>Muṇḍaka</s>, <s>Praśna</s>, <s>Brahmavidyā</s>, <s>Kṣurikā</s>, <s>Cūlikā</s>, <s>Atharvaśiras</s>, <s>Atharvaśikhā</s>, <s>Garbhopaniṣad</s>, <s>Mahopaniṣad</s>, <s>Brahmopaniṣad</s>, <s>Prāṇāgnihotra</s>, <s>Māṇḍūkya</s>, <s>Nādabindu</s>, <s>Brahmabindu</s>, <s>Amṛtabindu</s>, <s>Dhyānabindu</s>, <s>Tejobindu</s>, <s>Yogaśikhā</s>, <s>Yogatattva</s>, <s>Nīlarudra</s>, <s>Pañcatāpin</s>, <s>Ekadaṇḍin</s>, <s>Saṃnyāsavidhi</s>, <s>Aruṇi</s>, <s>Haṃsa</s>, <s>Paramahaṃsa</s>, <s>Nārāyaṇopaniṣad</s>, and <s>Vaitathya</s>.

body.text: (AVParis_49,4.5) tatra gopathaḥ śataprapāṭhakaṃ brāhmaṇam āsīt tasyāvaśiṣṭe dve brāhmaṇe pūrvam uttaraṃ ceti ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 49.4.5) The <s>Gopatha</s> <s>Brāhmaṇa</s> formerly consisted of a hundred sections (<s>prapāṭhaka</s>s); of that, two <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>s remain — the earlier and the later.

body.text: (AVParis_49,4.6) tatra ṣaḍ aṅgāny adhītya ṣaḍaṅgavid bhavati ṣaḍ aṅgāni bhavanti, śikṣā kalpo vyākaraṇaṃ niruktaṃ chando jyotiṣam iti ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 49.4.6) Having studied the six limbs (<s>Aṅga</s>s), one becomes a knower of the six limbs. The six limbs are: <s>Śikṣā</s> (phonetics), <s>Kalpa</s> (ritual procedure), <s>Vyākaraṇa</s> (grammar), <s>Nirukta</s> (etymology), <s>Chandas</s> (metre), and <s>Jyotiṣa</s> (astronomy).

body.text: (AVParis_49,4.7) paKca kalpā bhavanti | nakṣatrakalpo vaitānakalpas tṛtīyaḥ saṃhitāvidhiḥ | caturtha āṅgirasaḥ kalpaḥ śāntikalpas tu pañcamaḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 49.4.7) There are five <s>Kalpa</s>s (ritual manuals): the <s>Nakṣatrakalpa</s>, the <s>Vaitānakalpa</s>, the third being the <s>Saṃhitāvidhi</s>; the fourth is the <s>Āṅgirasa Kalpa</s>, and the fifth is the <s>Śāntikalpa</s> (pacification manual).

body.text: (AVParis_49,4.8) lakṣaṇagranthā bhavanti | caturādhyāyikā prātiśākhyaṃ pañcapaṭalikā dantyoṣṭhavidhir bṛhatsarvānukramaṇī ceti ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 49.4.8) The ancillary texts (<s>Lakṣaṇagrantha</s>s) are: the <s>Caturādhyāyikā</s>, the <s>Prātiśākhya</s>, the <s>Pañcapaṭalikā</s>, the <s>Dantyoṣṭhavidhi</s> (rules on dental and labial sounds), and the <s>Bṛhatsarvānukramaṇī</s> (Great Complete Index).

body.text: (AVParis_49,4.9) tatra dvāsaptatiḥ pariśiṣṭāni bhavanti kauśikoktāni | kṛttikārohiṇī | rāṣṭrasaṃvargaḥ | rājaprathamābhiṣekaḥ | purohitakarmāṇi | puṣyābhiṣekaḥ | piṣṭarātryāḥ kalpaḥ | ārātrikam | ghṛtāvekṣaṇam | tiladhenuḥ | bhūmidānam | tulāpuruṣaḥ | ādityamaṇḍakaḥ | hiraṇyagarbhaḥ | hastirathaḥ | aśvarathaḥ | gosahasradānam | hastidīkṣā | aśvadīkṣā | vṛṣotsargaḥ | indrotsavaḥ | brahmayāgaḥ | skandayāgāḥ | saṃbhāralakṣaṇam | araṇilakṣaṇam | yajñapātralakṣaṇam | vedilakṣaṇam | kuṇḍalakṣaṇam | samillakṣaṇam | sruvalakṣaṇam | hastalakṣaṇam | jvālālakṣaṇam | lakṣahomaḥ | kāṅkāyanokto bṛhallakṣahomaḥ | koṭihomaḥ | gaṇamālā | ghṛtakambalam | anulomakalpaḥ | āsurīkalpaḥ | ucchuṣmakalpaḥ | samuccayaprāyaścittāni | brahmakūrcavidhiḥ | paiṭhīnasitaḍāgavidhiḥ | pāśupatavratavidhiḥ | saṃdhyopāsanavidhiḥ | snānavidhiḥ | tarpaṇavidhiḥ | śrāddhavidhiḥ | agnihotravidhiḥ | uttamapaṭalam | varṇapaṭalam | nighaṇtuḥ | caraṇavyūhaḥ | candraprātipadikam | grahayuddham | grahasaṃgrahaḥ | rāhucāraḥ | ketucāraḥ | ṛtuketulakṣaṇam | kūrmavibhāgaḥ | maṇḍalāni | digdāhalakṣaṇam | ulkālakṣaṇam | vidyullakṣaṇam | nirghātalakṣaṇam | pariveṣalakṣaṇam | bhūmikampalakṣaṇam | nakṣatragrahotpātalakṣaṇam | utpātalakṣaṇam | sadyovṛṣṭilakṣaṇam | gośāntiḥ | adbhutaśāntiḥ | svapnādhyāyaḥ | atharvahṛdayam | bhārgavīyagārgyabārhaspatyośanasādbhutāni | mahādbhutāni bṛhatsarvānukramaṇī ceti ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 49.4.9) There are seventy-two <s>Pariśiṣṭa</s>s (supplements), as stated by <s>Kauśika</s>: <s>Kṛttikā-Rohiṇī</s>; the <s>Rāṣṭrasaṃvarga</s> (seizure of kingdoms); the <s>Rājaprathamābhiṣeka</s> (first royal consecration); duties of the <s>Purohita</s> (royal priest); the <s>Puṣyābhiṣeka</s> (consecration under <s>Puṣya</s> asterism); the rite of the Flour-night; the lamp-waving ceremony; ghee-gazing; the Sesame-cow; land-donation; the Man-in-balance; the Solar disk; the Golden embryo; the Elephant-chariot; the Horse-chariot; the Gift of a thousand cows; elephant-consecration; horse-consecration; the Releasing of a bull; the Festival of <s>Indra</s>; the Sacrifice to <s>Brahmā</s>; the Sacrifices to <s>Skanda</s>; characteristics of materials; characteristics of the fire-drill; characteristics of sacrificial vessels; characteristics of the altar-ground; characteristics of the fire-pit; characteristics of the fuel; characteristics of the ladle; characteristics of gestures; characteristics of flames; the Hundred-thousand oblation; the Great hundred-thousand oblation taught by <s>Kāṅkāyana</s>; the Ten-million oblation; the <s>Gaṇamālā</s> (garland of gaṇas); the Ghee-blanket; the Direct rite; the <s>Āsurī</s> (demoniac) rite; the <s>Ucchuṣma</s> rite; the Collective expiations; the procedure of <s>Brahmakūrca</s>; the Reservoir-procedure of <s>Paiṭhīnasi</s>; the procedure of the <s>Pāśupata</s> observance; the procedure of twilight worship; the Bathing procedure; the Libation (<s>Tarpaṇa</s>) procedure; the <s>Śrāddha</s> (ancestor) procedure; the <s>Agnihotra</s> procedure; the <s>Uttamapaṭala</s> (supreme chapter); the <s>Varṇapaṭala</s> (chapter on phonemes); the <s>Nighaṇṭu</s> (glossary); the <s>Caraṇavyūha</s> (classification of schools); the Lunar-calendrical [text]; Planetary conjunctions; Compilation of planets; the Course of <s>Rāhu</s>; the Course of comets; Characteristics of seasonal comets; the Division of the tortoise [-shaped earth]; the Maṇḍalas (diagrams); Characteristics of burning directions; Characteristics of meteors; Characteristics of lightning; Characteristics of thunder; Characteristics of halos; Characteristics of earthquakes; Characteristics of asterism-planet portents; Characteristics of portents; Characteristics of immediate rain; the Cow-pacification; the Portent-pacification; the Chapter on dreams; the Heart of the <s>Atharvan</s>; the Portents of <s>Bhārgava</s>, <s>Gārgya</s>, <s>Bārhaspatya</s>, and <s>Auśanasa</s>; the Great portents; and the <s>Bṛhatsarvānukramaṇī</s> (Great Complete Index).

body.text: (AVParis_49,4.10) tatra pañcadaśopaniṣado bhavanti | muṇḍakā | praśnakā | brahmavidyā | kṣurikā | cūlikā | atharvaśiraḥ | atharvaśikhā | garbhopaniṣat | mahopaniṣat | brahmopaniṣat | prāṇāgnihotram | māṇḍūkyam | vaitathyam | advaitam | alātaśāntiś ceti ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 49.4.10) Of these, fifteen <s>Upaniṣad</s>s belong [to the <s>Atharvaveda</s>]: <s>Muṇḍaka</s>, <s>Praśna</s>, <s>Brahmavidyā</s>, <s>Kṣurikā</s>, <s>Cūlikā</s>, <s>Atharvaśiras</s>, <s>Atharvaśikhā</s>, <s>Garbhopaniṣad</s>, <s>Mahopaniṣad</s>, <s>Brahmopaniṣad</s>, <s>Prāṇāgnihotra</s>, <s>Māṇḍūkya</s>, <s>Vaitathya</s>, <s>Advaita</s>, and <s>Alātaśānti</s>.

body.text: (AVParis_49,4.11) tatra brahmavede 'ṣṭādaśa vratāni cariṣyan sāvitrīvratam | vedavratam | vedottaravratam | mailavratam | mailottaravratam | mṛgāravratam | rohitavratam | viṣāsahivratam | yamavratam | śāntivratam | śikhivratam | gaṇavratam | śirovratam | śikhāvratam | marudvratam | adhivratam | aṅgirovratam | pāśupatavrataṃ caret ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 49.4.11) In the <s>Brahmaveda</s> (Atharvaveda), there are eighteen observances (<s>vrata</s>s) to be practiced: the <s>Sāvitrī-vrata</s>, the <s>Veda-vrata</s>, the <s>Vedottara-vrata</s>, the <s>Maila-vrata</s>, the <s>Mailottara-vrata</s>, the <s>Mṛgāra-vrata</s>, the <s>Rohita-vrata</s>, the <s>Viṣāsahi-vrata</s>, the <s>Yama-vrata</s>, the <s>Śānti-vrata</s>, the <s>Śikhi-vrata</s>, the <s>Gaṇa-vrata</s>, the <s>Śiro-vrata</s>, the <s>Śikhā-vrata</s>, the <s>Marud-vrata</s>, the <s>Adhi-vrata</s>, the <s>Aṅgiro-vrata</s>, and the <s>Pāśupata-vrata</s>.

body.text: (AVParis_49,4.12) kṛcchram | taptakṛcchram | atikṛcchram | sarvakṛcchram | maundabhāyaḥ | tulāpuruṣaḥ | sāṃtapanam | mahāsāṃtapanaṃ ceti ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 49.4.12) [The penances are:] <s>kṛcchra</s> (mild penance), <s>taptakṛcchra</s> (heated penance), <s>atikṛcchra</s> (severe penance), <s>sarvakṛcchra</s> (total penance), <s>maundabhāya</s> (head-shaving [penance]), <s>tulāpuruṣa</s> (weighing against [gold]), <s>sāṃtapana</s> (burning penance), and <s>mahāsāṃtapana</s> (great burning penance).

body.text:
(AVParis_49,5.1) yo vai brahmavedeṣūpanītaḥ sa sarvavedeṣūpanito
(AVParis_49,5.2) yo vai brahmavedeṣv anupanītaḥ sa sarvavedeṣv anupanītaḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 49.5.1-2) He who is indeed initiated (<s>upanīta</s>) in the <s>Brahmaveda</s> is initiated in all the <s>Veda</s>s. He who is indeed not initiated in the <s>Brahmaveda</s> is not initiated in any of the <s>Veda</s>s.

body.text:
(AVParis_49,5.3) anyavede dvijo yo brahmavedam adhītukāmaḥ sa punar upaneyo
(AVParis_49,5.4) devāś ca ṛṣayaś ca brahmāṇam ūcuḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 49.5.3-4) A twice-born of another <s>Veda</s> who desires to study the <s>Brahmaveda</s> must be initiated again. The gods and the sages addressed <s>Brahmā</s>:

body.text: (AVParis_49,5.5) ko no [smo] jyeṣṭhaḥ | ka upanetā | ka ācāryaḥ | ko brahmatvaṃ ceti ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 49.5.5) 'Who is our eldest? Who is the initiator? Who is the teacher? Who holds the office of <s>Brahman</s> (chief priest)?'

body.text: (AVParis_49,5.6) tān brahmābravīt ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 49.5.6) <s>Brahmā</s> said to them:

body.text: (AVParis_49,5.7) atharvā vo jyeṣṭho 'tharvopanetātharvācāryo 'tharvā brahmatvaṃ ceti ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 49.5.7) '<s>Atharvan</s> is your eldest, <s>Atharvan</s> is the initiator, <s>Atharvan</s> is the teacher, and <s>Atharvan</s> holds the office of <s>Brahman</s>.'

body.text:
(AVParis_49,5.8) tad apy etad ṛcoktam | brahmajyeṣṭheti etayā |
(AVParis_49,5.9) iti tasyārhaṃ brahmavedaś caturṇāṃ vedānāṃ sāṅgopāṅgānām [tam] savākovākyānāṃ setihāsapurāṇānām ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 49.5.8-9) And this is also stated in a <s>Ṛc</s> (verse): 'The powers assembled are eldest in <s>Brahman</s>...' — with this [verse]. Thus the <s>Brahmaveda</s> is worthy of the four <s>Veda</s>s together with their limbs and sub-limbs, with their discussions and counter-arguments, and with their <s>Itihāsa</s>s and <s>Purāṇa</s>s.

body.text:
(AVParis_49,5.10) athāto brahmavedaḥ kapilo varṇena tīkṣṇaḥ pracaṇḍaḥ kāmarūpī viśvātmā jitendriyaḥ | sa tasmin bhagavati durvārajvālaḥ |
(AVParis_49,5.11) kṣudrakarmā sa ca bhagavān brahmavedaś caturmukho dvipakṣo dānto dharmī balavān prājñaḥ kṛtotthāpanīyaḥ krūraḥ ṣaḍrātrāṇi vimṛśī [ṣaḍrātrāṇi ṣaḍ] vaitāyano gotreṇa
(AVParis_49,5.12) ya ekaikasmin vedānāṃ nāmavarṇagotrarūpapramāṇaṃ ca kīrtayed yo vidvān jātismaro bhavati mṛtaḥ sa brahmalokaṃ gacchati ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 49.5.10-12) Now then, the <s>Brahmaveda</s> is tawny in color, sharp, fierce, assuming any form at will, the Self of all, with senses conquered; in that blessed one, [it has] flames difficult to resist. Its minor rites — and that blessed <s>Brahmaveda</s> is four-faced, two-winged, tamed, righteous, powerful, wise, one who raises up what has been created, fierce, deliberating for six nights, of the <s>Vaitāyana</s> lineage. He who would proclaim the name, color, lineage, form, and measure of each one of the <s>Veda</s>s — that learned one who remembers his past births, upon death goes to the world of <s>Brahman</s>.

body.text:
(Pariśiṣṭa_50. candraprātipadikam)
(AVParis_50,1.1) oṃ vṛttaṃ prātar amāvāsyāṃ paścād dṛśyeta candramāḥ | tasya varṇaṃ gatiṃ rūpaṃ sthānaṃ caivoccanīcatām ||
body.translated_text: (Pariśiṣṭa 50: Lunar Prognostication [<s>Candraprātipadika</s>]) (AVParis 50.1.1) Oṃ. When the moon is seen in the morning after the new-moon day, [observe] its color, movement, form, position, and whether it is high or low.

body.text: (AVParis_50,1.2) hrāsavṛddhiṃ ca śṛṅgāṇāṃ nakṣatraṃ yac ca yojayet | tāni lakṣeta somasya varṣāvarṣaṃ bhayābhayam ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 50.1.2) The waning and waxing of its horns and with which <s>nakṣatra</s> (lunar mansion) it is conjoined — one should observe these [signs] of <s>Soma</s> (the Moon) [to predict] rain or drought, danger or safety.

body.text: (AVParis_50,1.3) prathame darśane tv indoḥ samāsādya yadā graham | uttaraṃ vardhate śṛṅgaṃ nīcībhavati dakṣiṇam ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 50.1.3) When the moon at its first sighting approaches a planet, if the northern horn increases and the southern horn becomes low,

body.text: (AVParis_50,1.4) evam eva śraviṣṭhābhyas teṣām ante ca candramāḥ | udyacched dakṣiṇaṃ śṛṅgaṃ nīcībhavati cottaram ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 50.1.4) and likewise from <s>Śraviṣṭhā</s> (Dhaniṣṭhā) onward, when at their end the moon rises with the southern horn [raised] and the northern horn becomes low,

body.text: (AVParis_50,1.5) anupaśyeta rāṣṭraṃ ca antargirimahāgirim | vidarbhān madrakāṃś caiva bharatāṃś cāpi sarvataḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 50.1.5) one should observe the kingdom, the interior regions and great mountains, the <s>Vidarbha</s>s, the <s>Madraka</s>s, and the <s>Bharata</s>s on all sides.

body.text: (AVParis_50,2.1) sārāṇāṃ vijarāṇāṃ ca samudre ye ca dakṣiṇe | etāñ janapadān hanti yadā syād uttaronnataḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 50.2.1) [Also] the <s>Sāra</s>s and the <s>Vijarā</s>s, and those at the southern ocean — it afflicts these regions when [the moon] is elevated to the north.

body.text: (AVParis_50,2.2) kāśmīrān daradān darvāñ śūrasenān yayāvarān | śālvānāṃ ca virājānāṃ samudre ye ca paścime ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 50.2.2) The <s>Kāśmīra</s>s, the <s>Darada</s>s, the <s>Darvā</s>s, the <s>Śūrasena</s>s, the <s>Yayāvara</s>s, the <s>Śālva</s>s, the <s>Virāja</s>s, and those at the western ocean —

body.text: (AVParis_50,2.3) etāj janapadān hanti yadā syād dakṣinonnataḥ | puruṣaḥ strīnṛpaṃ hanti aparānto vinaśyati ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 50.2.3) it afflicts these regions when [the moon] is elevated to the south. A male [moon] slays the king of women; the western frontier is destroyed.

body.text: (AVParis_50,2.4) bālhikān yavanakāmbojāñ śālvān madrān uśīnarān | godhāṃś ca bhadrakāṃś caiva madhyaṃ ca kurubhiḥ saha ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 50.2.4) The <s>Bālhika</s>s, the <s>Yavana</s>s, the <s>Kāmboja</s>s, the <s>Śālva</s>s, the <s>Madra</s>s, the <s>Uśīnara</s>s, the <s>Godhā</s>s, the <s>Bhadraka</s>s, and the central [region] together with the <s>Kuru</s>s,

body.text: (AVParis_50,2.5) saurāṣṭrān sindhusauvīrān vāneyāṃś cāpi siṃsakān | kṣudrakān mālavān matsyān mlecchān saha pulindakaiḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 50.2.5) the <s>Saurāṣṭra</s>s, the <s>Sindhu-Sauvīra</s>s, the <s>Vāneya</s>s and the <s>Siṃsaka</s>s, the <s>Kṣudraka</s>s, the <s>Mālava</s>s, the <s>Matsya</s>s, the <s>Mleccha</s>s together with the <s>Pulindaka</s>s,

body.text: (AVParis_50,2.6) śastropajījikuḍyāṃś ca brāhmaṇā yodhinaś ca ye | etāñ janapadān hanti somaḥ puruṣalakṣaṇaḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 50.2.6) those who live by weapons, the <s>Jījikuḍya</s>s, and the <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>s who are warriors — <s>Soma</s> (the Moon) with male characteristics afflicts these regions.

body.text: (AVParis_50,3.1) lakṣaṇād vā bhavet sthūlaḥ kāye śṛṅge ca hīyate | alpe śarīre durbhikṣaṃ bhayaṃ rogaṃ vinirdiśet ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 50.3.1) From its characteristics [the moon] may appear large; when diminished in body and horns, [and] with a small body, one should predict famine, danger, and disease.

body.text: (AVParis_50,3.2) yadā pratipadaś candraḥ prakṛtyā vikṛto bhavet | anudbhinno vilūno vā rājamṛtyuṃ vinirdiśet ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 50.3.2) When the moon at the first day of the fortnight is altered from its natural state, unbroken or sheared, one should predict the death of a king.

body.text: (AVParis_50,3.3) ṣaṣṭhyāṃ madhyaṃ yadā gacched rājā vadhyeta pārthivaḥ | avantīnāṃ ca pūrvārdhaṃ māgadhāś ca viśeṣataḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 50.3.3) When [the moon] reaches the middle on the sixth day, a king, a sovereign, shall be slain — especially the eastern half of the <s>Avantī</s> [kingdom] and the <s>Māgadha</s>s.

body.text: (AVParis_50,3.4) paraṃ kumāreṣv aṣṭamyāṃ rājānaṃ daśamī param | evaṃ ca pakṣāpacaye madhye dṛśyeta dvādaśī ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 50.3.4) Beyond [the sixth], on the eighth, [it portends danger to] princes; on the tenth, to the king. And thus in the waning fortnight, when [the moon] is seen at the middle on the twelfth day,

body.text: (AVParis_50,3.5) hanti pañcanadaṃ tatra rājānaṃ sumahadbalam | sarvāṃś ca kuryād rājñas tu tasminn utpātadarśane ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 50.3.5) it slays in the <s>Pañcanada</s> (Punjab) region a king of very great power. One should perform [propitiatory rites] for all kings upon the sighting of that portent.

body.text: (AVParis_50,4.1) adbhutāni ca dṛśyante tasminn utpātadarśane | vaiśvānarapathaṃ prāptaḥ samudram api śoṣayet ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 50.4.1) And marvels are seen upon the sighting of that portent; having entered the path of <s>Vaiśvānara</s> (the universal fire), [the moon] could dry up even the ocean.

body.text: (AVParis_50,4.2) kṛttikānāṃ maghānāṃ ca rohiṇyāś ca viśākhayoḥ | eteṣām uttaro mārgo rājavīthīti tāṃ viduḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 50.4.2) Of <s>Kṛttikā</s>, <s>Maghā</s>, <s>Rohiṇī</s>, and <s>Viśākhā</s> — the northern path of these is known as the 'Royal Road' (<s>rājavīthī</s>).

body.text: (AVParis_50,4.3) yadīmaṃ mārgam āsthāya candramā vinivartate | nāvarṣā uttamā jñeyā yogakṣemaṃ tathaiva ca ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 50.4.3) If the moon, having taken this path, turns back, [the year] should be known as one without excessive rain and with the best security and prosperity.

body.text: (AVParis_50,4.4) gajavīthīṃ nāgavīthīṃ yadi gacchati candramāḥ | ..... govīthīti tadāpy āhur gargasya vacanaṃ yathā ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 50.4.4) If the moon goes along the 'Elephant Road' (<s>gajavīthī</s>) or the 'Serpent Road' (<s>nāgavīthī</s>)... they call it the 'Cow Road' (<s>govīthī</s>) — as is the statement of <s>Garga</s>.

body.text: (AVParis_50,4.5) aṣṭau sthānāni candrasya kroṣṭukir yāni veda vai | nausthāyī lāṅgalī caiva tṛtīyaś cottaronnataḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 50.4.5) The eight positions of the moon which <s>Kroṣṭuki</s> knows: the first is 'boat-standing' (<s>nausthāyī</s>), the second is 'plough-shaped' (<s>lāṅgalī</s>), and the third is 'elevated to the north' (<s>uttaronnata</s>),

body.text: (AVParis_50,4.6) daṇḍasthāyī caturthas tu daṇḍaśāyī tu pañcamaḥ | ṣaṣthas tu yūpasthāyī syāt pārśvaśāyī tu saptamaḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 50.4.6) the fourth is 'staff-standing' (<s>daṇḍasthāyī</s>), the fifth is 'staff-lying' (<s>daṇḍaśāyī</s>), the sixth is 'sacrificial-post-standing' (<s>yūpasthāyī</s>), and the seventh is 'side-lying' (<s>pārśvaśāyī</s>),

body.text: (AVParis_50,4.7) aṣṭamo 'vāṅśirāś caiva phalam asya nibodhata | rājānaḥ sveṣu rāṣṭreṣu yuktadaṇḍāḥ praśāsati ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 50.4.7) and the eighth is 'head-downward' (<s>avāṅśiras</s>). Learn their results: [when 'boat-standing',] kings in their own kingdoms, wielding the rod of justice, govern well.

body.text: (AVParis_50,5.1) lāṅgalī grasate lokān yugāntaṃ pratipādayet | mārīṃ samadhikām āhur yadā syād uttaronnataḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 50.5.1) The 'plough-shaped' [moon] devours the worlds, bringing about the end of an age; they declare an excessive plague when [the moon] is elevated to the north.

body.text: (AVParis_50,5.2) daṇḍasthāyī tv amātyānāṃ bhayaṃ rogaṃ vinirdiśet | śaktichedā granthichedā gostenāḥ pāradārikāḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 50.5.2) The 'staff-standing' [moon] portends danger and disease for ministers; spear-cutters, knot-cutters, cattle-thieves, and adulterers —

body.text: (AVParis_50,5.3) ete deśān vilumpanti daṇḍasthāyī yadā bhavet | daṇḍaśāyī tu viprāṇāṃ bhayaṃ tatra vinirdiśet ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 50.5.3) these plunder the lands when [the moon] is 'staff-standing.' The 'staff-lying' [moon] portends danger for the <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>s.

body.text: (AVParis_50,5.4) yūpasthāyī tu dhānyānāṃ bhayaṃ tatra vinirdiśet | harite śarīre somasya paśūnāṃ vadham ādiśet ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 50.5.4) The 'sacrificial-post-standing' [moon] portends danger to grains. When <s>Soma</s>'s body is green, it foretells the slaughter of cattle.

body.text:
(AVParis_50,5.5) kṛṣṇe śarīre somasya śūdrāṇāṃ vadham ādiśet | pīte śarīre somasya vaiśyānāṃ vadham ādiśet
(AVParis_50,5.6) rakte śarīre somasya rājñāṃ tu vadham ādiśet | śukle śarīre somasya brahmavṛddhiṃ vinirdiśet ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 50.5.5-6) When <s>Soma</s>'s body is dark, it foretells the slaughter of <s>Śūdra</s>s. When <s>Soma</s>'s body is yellow, it foretells the slaughter of <s>Vaiśya</s>s. When <s>Soma</s>'s body is red, it foretells the slaughter of kings. When <s>Soma</s>'s body is white, it indicates the prosperity of <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>s.

body.text: (AVParis_50,6.1) snigdhaḥ pītaḥ suvarṇābhaḥ pakṣādau yadi candramāḥ | gosthāyī saṃpradṛśyeta vipravṛddhiṃ vinirdiśet ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 50.6.1) When the moon at the beginning of the fortnight is unctuous, yellow, golden-hued, appearing in the 'cow-standing' position, it indicates the prosperity of <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>s.

body.text: (AVParis_50,6.2) uccasthāne yadā pītaḥ samaśṛṅgaḥ śaśī bhavet | nāgavīthīgataḥ snigdhaḥ sa sarvaguṇapūjitaḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 50.6.2) When the moon is yellow at a high position, with equal horns, having entered the 'Serpent Road,' unctuous — it is honored with all good qualities.

body.text: (AVParis_50,6.3) dhūmrābho lāṅgalasthāyī śrīmān salakṣmamaṇḍalaḥ | pakṣādau yadi dṛśyeta brahmakṣatrasukhāvaḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 50.6.3) Smoke-colored, in the 'plough-standing' position, resplendent, with a marked disk — if seen at the beginning of a fortnight, it brings happiness to <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>s and <s>Kṣatriya</s>s.

body.text: (AVParis_50,6.4) rājavīthīṃ tu saṃprāpta ugradaṇḍī yadā bhavet | haridrākuṅkumābhaś ca śmaśānam avalokayet ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 50.6.4) But when, having reached the 'Royal Road,' [the moon] wields a fierce rod, and is the color of turmeric and saffron, it gazes upon the cremation ground.

body.text: (AVParis_50,6.5) mṛtyuṃ saṃyojayet somo bālākṛtir avāṅchirāḥ | lākṣārudhirasaṃkāśo dhanuḥsthāyī yadā bhavet ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 50.6.5) <s>Soma</s> brings death — child-shaped, head-downward; when [the moon] appears like lac and blood, in the 'bow-standing' position,

body.text: (AVParis_50,7.1) saṃgrāmaṃ yojayet somo loke tu tumulaṃ bhayam | dvicandraṃ gaganaṃ dṛṣṭvā brūyād brahmavadho mahān ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 50.7.1) <s>Soma</s> portends battle and tumultuous fear in the world. Seeing two moons in the sky, one should declare a great slaughter of <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>s.

body.text: (AVParis_50,7.2) dvau sūryau vā yadā syātāṃ tadā kṣatravadho mahān | dṛṣṭvā tu caturaḥ sūryān uditān sarvatodiśam ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 50.7.2) When there are two suns, then [there is] a great slaughter of <s>Kṣatriya</s>s. Seeing four suns risen in every direction,

body.text: (AVParis_50,7.3) śastreṇa janamāreṇa tad yugāntasya lakṣaṇam | āditye pāṇḍuraṃ chattraṃ saṃdhyāvelāṃ yadā bhavet ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 50.7.3) [there will be] mass slaughter by weapons — that is the mark of the end of an age. When a white parasol appears near the sun at the twilight hour,

body.text: (AVParis_50,7.4) deśasya vidravaṃ sūryo rājamṛtyuṃ vinirdiśet | ādityasya rathaḥ śvetaḥ saṃdhyāvelāṃ yadā bhavet ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 50.7.4) the sun portends the flight of the country and the death of a king. When the chariot of the sun is white at the twilight hour,

body.text: (AVParis_50,7.5) pratyāsannaṃ bhayaṃ vidyāt tasminn utpātadarśane ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 50.7.5) one should know that danger is imminent upon the sighting of that portent.

body.text: (AVParis_50,8.1) ādityaḥ sarvataś chinno dvaidhībhutaḥ pradṛśyate. deśasya vidravaṃ sūryo rājamṛtyuṃ vinirdiśet ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 50.8.1) When the sun appears split on all sides, divided in two, the sun portends the flight of the country and the death of a king.

body.text: (AVParis_50,9.1) kṣemaṃ vikukṣile brūyāt sthālīpiṭharasaṃsthite | saṃkṣipte kṣīyate loko durbhikṣaṃ vajrasaṃsthite ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 50.9.1) One should predict security when [the moon is] in the 'belly-pitcher' position (<s>vikukṣila</s>); in the 'pot-bowl' position (<s>sthālīpiṭhara</s>), when compressed, the world diminishes; famine [comes] when in the 'thunderbolt' position.

body.text: (AVParis_50,9.2) divā hy asmin pataty ulkā satataṃ kampate mahī | aparvāśaninirghoṣāḥ saṃdhyā ca jvalanacchavā ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 50.9.2) When meteors fall by day, the earth trembles constantly, there are thunderclaps and lightning without an eclipse, and the twilight has the appearance of fire,

body.text: (AVParis_50,9.3) nakṣatrapātasyotpattir dhūmasya rajaso 'pi vā | śṛṅgaṃ bhavaty ādityasya tṛṇakāṣṭhaṃ ca śuṣyati ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 50.9.3) when there is the occurrence of falling stars, or smoke, or dust, when horns appear on the sun, and grass and wood dry up —

body.text: (AVParis_50,9.4) rājāno hy aśivās tatra citraṃ varṣati mādhavaḥ | dvādaśānāṃ tu māsānāṃ madhye naśyati pārthivaḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 50.9.4) kings are inauspicious there; <s>Mādhava</s> (spring) rains in a strange manner. Within twelve months, the sovereign perishes.

body.text: (AVParis_50,9.5) kārttikyāṃ śuklapakṣasya bahulasya trayodaśīm | vidyāt tu svātisaṃpātaṃ divasān ekaviṃśatim ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 50.9.5) On the full-moon day of <s>Kārttika</s>, the thirteenth of the dark fortnight — one should know the fall of <s>Svāti</s> [lasts] twenty-one days.

body.text: (AVParis_50,9.6) saptāhaṃ tu bhaved goṣu saptāhaṃ mṛgapakṣiṣu | mānuṣeṣu ca saptāhaṃ tataḥ śreyas tu kalpayet ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 50.9.6) For seven days [the effect is] on cattle, for seven days on deer and birds, for seven days on humans — after that, one should predict improvement.

body.text:
(Pariśiṣṭa_51. grahayuddham)
(AVParis_51,1.1) oṃ ke cid grahā nārarān āśrayante ke cid grahā [jyotiṣi] saṃgrahe ca | graho graheṇaiva hataḥ kathaṃ syād vijñāya tattvaṃ bhagavān bravītu ||
body.translated_text: (Pariśiṣṭa 51: Planetary Warfare [<s>Grahayuddha</s>]) (AVParis 51.1.1) Oṃ. Some planets take refuge in the stars, and some planets [engage] in conjunction with [other] luminaries. How can a planet be defeated by a planet? Having understood the truth, may the Blessed One declare [it].

body.text: (AVParis_51,1.2) evaṃ sa pṛṣṭo munibhir mahātmā provāca gargo grahayuddhatantram | parājayaṃ caiva jayaṃ ca teṣāṃ śubhāsubham(aśubhamñ) caiva jagaddhitāya ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 51.1.2) Thus asked by the sages, the great-souled <s>Garga</s> expounded the doctrine of planetary warfare — their defeat and victory, and the auspicious and inauspicious [effects] for the welfare of the world.

body.text: (AVParis_51,1.3) arko jātaḥ kaliṅgeṣu yavaneṣu ca candramāḥ | aṅgārakas tv avantyāyāṃ magadhāyāṃ budhas tathā ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 51.1.3) The Sun was born in <s>Kaliṅga</s>, and the Moon among the <s>Yavana</s>s; <s>Aṅgāraka</s> (Mars) in <s>Avantī</s>, and <s>Budha</s> (Mercury) likewise in <s>Magadha</s>.

body.text: (AVParis_51,1.4) bṛhaspatiḥ saindhaveṣu mahārāṣṭre tu bhārgavaḥ | śanaiścaraḥ surāṣṭrāyāṃ rāhus tu giriśṛṅgajaḥ | ketur malayake jāta ity etad grahajātakam ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 51.1.4) <s>Bṛhaspati</s> (Jupiter) among the <s>Saindhava</s>s, and <s>Bhārgava</s> (Venus) in <s>Mahārāṣṭra</s>; <s>Śanaiścara</s> (Saturn) in <s>Surāṣṭra</s>, and <s>Rāhu</s> is born on a mountain peak; <s>Ketu</s> was born in <s>Malayaka</s> — this is the nativity of the planets.

body.text: (AVParis_51,1.5) yasmin deśe tu yo jātaḥ sa grahaḥ pīḍyate yadā taṃ deśaṃ ghātitaṃ vidyād durbhikṣeṇa bhayena vā ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 51.1.5) In whichever land a planet was born, when that planet is afflicted, one should know that land is struck by famine or danger.

body.text: (AVParis_51,2.1) divākaraś caiva śanaiścaras tathā bṛhaspatiś caiva budhaś ca nāgarāḥ | prajāpatiḥ ketur athāpi candramās tathaiva rāhūśanasau ca yāyinaḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 51.2.1) The Sun, <s>Śanaiścara</s> (Saturn), <s>Bṛhaspati</s> (Jupiter), and <s>Budha</s> (Mercury) are 'city-dwellers' (<s>nāgara</s>); <s>Prajāpati</s> (a name for a planet), <s>Ketu</s>, and the Moon likewise, and <s>Rāhu</s> and <s>Uśanas</s> (Venus) are 'travelers' (<s>yāyin</s>).

body.text: (AVParis_51,2.2) yadā graho nagara eva nāgaraṃ vijeṣyate yāyy atha vāpi yāyinam | tadā nṛpo nāgara eva nāgaraṃ vijeṣyate vāyy atha vāpi yāyinam ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 51.2.2) When a planet that is a city-dweller conquers a city-dweller, or a traveler [conquers] a traveler, then [likewise] a king who is a city-lord conquers a city-lord, or a wanderer [conquers] a wanderer.

body.text: (AVParis_51,2.3) ārohaṇaṃ ca bhedaś ca lekhanaṃ savyadakṣiṇam | raśmisaṃsarjanaṃ caiva grahayuddhaṃ caturvidham ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 51.2.3) Mounting (<s>ārohaṇa</s>), splitting (<s>bheda</s>), left-and-right scraping (<s>lekhana</s>), and intermingling of rays (<s>raśmisaṃsarjana</s>) — planetary warfare is of four kinds.

body.text: (AVParis_51,2.4) prasavye vigrahaṃ brūyāt saṃgrāmaṃ raśmisaṃgame | lekhane 'mātyapūḍā syād bhedane tu janakṣayaḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 51.2.4) In retrograde motion one should declare conflict; in conjunction of rays, war; in occultation, the minister's destruction; and in splitting, the destruction of people.

body.text: (AVParis_51,2.5) sarveṣāṃ nabhasi samāgame grahāṇām uktṛṣṭo bhavati tathaiva raśmivān yaḥ | snigdhatvaṃ bhavati tu yasya [sa graho graheṇa] saṃyukto bhavati [tu yaḥ] parājayeta śeṣaḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 51.2.5) When all the planets meet together in the sky, the superior one prevails, and likewise the one possessing rays; but whichever one has smoothness, that planet [prevails] when conjoined with [another] planet — the remaining one would be defeated.

body.text: (AVParis_51,3.1) śyāmo vā vyapagataraśmimaṇḍalo vā rūkṣo vā vyapagataraśmivān kṛśo vā | ākrānto vinipatitas tato 'pasavyo vijñeyo hata iti sa graho graheṇa ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 51.3.1) Dark, or devoid of its halo of rays, or rough, or deprived of rays, or thin, or afflicted, or fallen down — such a planet should be known as retrograde and 'slain' by [another] planet.

body.text: (AVParis_51,3.2) budhaś ca bhaumaḥ śanibhārgavāṅgirāḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ yāti yadā niśākaram | anamayatvaṃ triṣu saukhyam uttamaṃ viparyaye cāpi mahāñ janakṣayaḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 51.3.2) When <s>Budha</s> (Mercury), <s>Bhauma</s> (Mars), <s>Śani</s> (Saturn), <s>Bhārgava</s> (Venus), and <s>Aṅgiras</s> (Jupiter) move clockwise around the moon, there is freedom from disease in all three [worlds] and supreme happiness; in the reverse, there is great destruction of people.

body.text: (AVParis_51,3.3) dhanakanakarajatasaṃcayāś ca sarve śamadamamantraparāś caye manuṣyāḥ | śakayavanatukhārabālhikāś ca kṣayam upayānti divākarasya ghāte ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 51.3.3) All accumulations of wealth, gold, and silver, and those people devoted to tranquility, self-control, and sacred counsel, and the <s>Śaka</s>s, <s>Yavana</s>s, <s>Tukhāra</s>s, and <s>Bālhika</s>s — they go to destruction when the sun is afflicted.

body.text: (AVParis_51,3.4) atha some hate vidyād dhrvaṃ rājño viparyayaḥ | saṃharanti ca bhūtāni bhūmipālāḥ pṛthakpṛthak ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 51.3.4) Now when the moon is afflicted, one should know that there is certainly a reversal for the king; and the rulers of the earth destroy living beings, each separately.

body.text: (AVParis_51,3.5) parasparaṃ virudhyante kṣudbhayaṃ cāpi dāruṇām | anāvṛṣṭibhayaṃ ghoraṃ vidyāt somaviparyaye ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 51.3.5) They are mutually hostile, and there is terrible fear of famine; one should know that there is dreadful fear of drought when the moon is adversely affected.

body.text: (AVParis_51,4.1) traigartāḥ kṣitipatayaḥ sayodhamukhyāḥ pīḍyante girinilayāgnijīvinaś ca | saṃgrāmāḥ sarudhirapāṃsuvarṣamiśrā durbhikṣaṃ bhavati dharāsutasya ghāte ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 51.4.1) The <s>Traigarta</s>s, rulers of the land together with their chief warriors, are afflicted, as are mountain-dwellers and those who live by fire; battles mixed with rains of blood and dust, and famine — these occur when <s>Mars</s> (the son of Earth) is afflicted.

body.text: (AVParis_51,4.2) sāgaranilayāḥ paurāḥ kṣayam upayānti narā vaṇikpradhānāḥ | bhavati tu [rājā] vijayī prayāyī budhabandhane prapatanti cātra sobhyāḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 51.4.2) Those dwelling by the ocean, city-dwellers, and men whose chief occupation is trade — they go to destruction; but [the king] becomes victorious and sets forth on campaign; when <s>Budha</s> (Mercury) is bound, the noble ones fall.

body.text: (AVParis_51,4.3) daivajñās tapasi ciraṃ suniścitārthāḥ syur dāntā nṛpatigaṇaḥ purohitāś ca | āgantur jayati vadhaś ca nāgarāṇāṃ trailokyam <ca> bhayam upaiti guros tu ghāte ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 51.4.3) Astrologers, those long steadfast in austerity with well-determined purposes, the self-controlled, the king's retinue, and court priests — the invader conquers, and there is slaughter of the citizens; the three worlds are seized by fear when <s>Guru</s> (<s>Bṛhaspati</s>, Jupiter) is afflicted.

body.text: (AVParis_51,4.4) yo rājā prathitaparākramaḥ pṛthivyāṃ vaṅgāṅgādiṣu madadhāḥ saśūrasenāḥ | ye yodhāḥ samaraṇabhumilabdhaśabdās te sainyaiḥ kṣayam upayānti śukraghāte ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 51.4.4) Whatever king of celebrated valor on earth, proud in <s>Vaṅga</s>, <s>Aṅga</s>, and other [lands], with armies of heroes, and whatever warriors who have gained renown on the battlefield — they with their armies go to destruction when <s>Śukra</s> (Venus) is afflicted.

body.text: (AVParis_51,4.5) mahiṣakavṛṣabhāḥ sabhasmapauṇḍrāḥ kṛṣipaśupālyaratāś ca ye manuṣyāḥ | vividhabhayasamāhitās tu sarve kṣayam upayānti śanaiścarasya ghāte ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 51.4.5) The <s>Mahiṣaka</s>s and <s>Vṛṣabha</s>s along with the <s>Bhasma</s>s and <s>Pauṇḍra</s>s, and those people devoted to agriculture and animal husbandry, and all who are beset by various fears — they go to destruction when <s>Śanaiścara</s> (Saturn) is afflicted.

body.text: (AVParis_51,5.1) ye ke cin nṛpatiṣu dāmbhikāḥ piśācāḥ kāryāṇāṃ vrataniyameṣu channapāpāḥ | ye cānye śabarapulindacedigādhā bādhyante yadi bhavate 'tra rāhughātaḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 51.5.1) Whatever deceitful demons among kings, secret sinners in observances and religious vows, and others such as the <s>Śabara</s>s, <s>Pulinda</s>s, <s>Cedi</s>s, and <s>Gādha</s>s — they are afflicted if there is an affliction of <s>Rāhu</s>.

body.text: (AVParis_51,5.2) ākrāntaṃ samanubhavanti yāyisaṃghā vadhyante yadi bhavate [paras] paro 'highātaḥ | saṃgrāmāḥ sarudhirapāṃsuvarṣamiśra durbhikṣaṃ bhavati tu ketupīḍanena ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 51.5.2) Traveling hosts experience the affliction; they are slain if there is the affliction of <s>Ketu</s> (the tail-node); battles mixed with rains of blood and dust, and famine occurs through the torment of a comet.

body.text: (AVParis_51,5.3) yat kiṃ cid divigatam antarikṣajaṃ vā bhaumaṃ vā bhavati nimittam apraśastam | tat savaṃ stanitamahābhrabidyudvarṣaiḥ śāntaṃ syād bhavati sadakṣiṇaiś ca homaiḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 51.5.3) Whatever inauspicious omen occurs in the sky, in the atmosphere, or on the earth, all that can be pacified by thunder, great clouds, lightning, and rains, and by oblations accompanied by proper gifts.

body.text: (AVParis_51,5.4) ye deśā grahagaṇabhinnabhūmikampā yeṣāṃ vā graha upayātacandrasūryaḥ | tān deśān [grahagaṇabhinnabhumikampān] parjanyaḥ śamayati saptarātravṛṣṭyā ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 51.5.4) Those regions [afflicted by] earthquakes caused by the host of planets, or where a planet has approached the sun or moon — <s>Parjanya</s> (the rain-god) pacifies those regions with seven nights of rain.

body.text: (AVParis_51,5.5) prasavyas triṣu māseṣu saṃsargo māsikaḥ smṛtaḥ | lekhane pakṣa ity āhur bhedane saptarātrikam ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 51.5.5) Retrograde motion [lasts] three months; conjunction is said to last one month; in occultation, a fortnight, they say; and in splitting, seven nights.

body.text: (AVParis_51,5.6) āgneyā vāsavāś caiva vāyavyā vāruṇās tathā | sarva eva śubhā jñeyā gargasya vacanaṃ yathā ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 51.5.6) The fiery, the <s>Vāsava</s> (of <s>Indra</s>), the windy, and the watery — all should be known as auspicious, according to the statement of <s>Garga</s>.

body.text:
(Pariśiṣṭa_52. grahasaṃgrahaḥ)
(AVParis_52,1.1) om atharvāṇaṃ namaskṛtya uvāca bhagavān ṛṣiḥ | kīdṛśā grahaputrāś ca kiyanto vā vadasva me ||
body.translated_text:
(Pariśiṣṭa 52: Collection of Comets)
(AVParis 52.1.1) Oṃ. Having saluted the <s>Atharvan</s>, the blessed sage spoke: 'What are the offspring of the planets like, and how many are they? Tell me.'

body.text: (AVParis_52,1.2) pṛṣṭaha sa śaunakenātha brāhmaṇānāṃ hitāya vai | saṃkhyām uvāca bhagavān padmayonimataṃ yathā ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 52.1.2) Thus questioned by <s>Śaunaka</s>, for the benefit of <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>s indeed, the blessed one stated their number according to the doctrine of <s>Padmayoni</s> (<s>Brahmā</s>).

body.text: (AVParis_52,1.3) dikcāriṇo divicarā bhūcarā vyomacāriṇaḥ | divācarā rātricarā divārātricarāś caye ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 52.1.3) Those that move through the directions, those that move through the sky, those that move on earth, those that move through space, those that move by day, those that move by night, and those that move by day and night,

body.text: (AVParis_52,1.4) pṛthikcarāś ca ye tatra te ca syuḥ saṃghacāriṇaḥ | caranty aparavīthīṣu ye ca vibhrāntamaṇḍalāḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 52.1.4) And those that move on the surface of the earth — they too are group-movers; those that move in the outer paths, and those with wandering orbits,

body.text: (AVParis_52,1.5) te grahāḥ saṃgraheṇāhaṃ śataśo 'tha sahasraśaḥ | anekavidhasaṃsthānaṃ pravakṣyāmy anupūrvaśaḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 52.1.5) Those comets I shall describe in summary, by hundreds and by thousands, of manifold configurations, in due order.

body.text: (AVParis_52,2.1) gokṣīrakumudaprakhyās tīvreṇa vapuṣānvitāḥ | caranty antaravīthīṣu snigdhā vipulatejasaḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 52.2.1) Resembling cow's milk and white lotuses, endowed with intense bodies, moving in the inner paths, smooth, of abundant radiance,

body.text: (AVParis_52,2.2) ete visarpakā nāma arciṣmanto mahāprabhāḥ | vijñeyāś caturaśītiḥ śukraputrā mahāgrahāḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 52.2.2) These are known as <s>Visarpaka</s>s (creeping ones) by name, flaming, of great splendor; eighty-four should be known — great comets, offspring of <s>Śukra</s> (Venus).

body.text: (AVParis_52,2.3) śuklā nikarāḥ saurābhās tyajanta iva cārciṣaḥ | sphuranta iva cākāśe bimbakā raśmibhir vṛtāḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 52.2.3) White, radiant, fragrant, emitting as it were their flames, flashing as it were in the sky, the <s>Bimbaka</s>s (disc-shaped ones), surrounded by rays,

body.text: (AVParis_52,2.4) prāyaśo dakṣiṇe mārge nīcair vibhrāntamaṇḍalāḥ | vikacāḥ pañcaṣaṣṭis te bṛhaspatisutāḥ smṛtaḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 52.2.4) Mostly in the southern path, moving low with wandering orbits, the <s>Vikaca</s>s (expanded ones) — those sixty-five are known as offspring of <s>Bṛhaspati</s> (Jupiter).

body.text: (AVParis_52,2.5) ye śvetāḥ kiṃcid ākṛṣṇā viśikhāḥ syur vitārakāḥ | te ṣaṣṭiḥ kanakā nāma śanaiścarasutā grahāḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 52.2.5) Those that are white, somewhat dark, without crests, and without stars — those sixty, named <s>Kanaka</s>s (golden ones), are comets, offspring of <s>Śanaiścara</s> (Saturn).

body.text: (AVParis_52,3.1) ekapaKcāśato jñeyās taskarāḥ sūkṣmaraśmayaḥ | baudhāḥ kamalagarbhābhāḥ kiṃcit pāṇḍuratejasaḥ ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 52.3.1) Fifty-one should be known as <s>Taskara</s>s (thieves), with faint rays, offspring of <s>Budha</s> (Mercury), resembling the interior of a lotus, with somewhat pale radiance.

body.text: (AVParis_52,3.2) kauṅkumā lohitāṅgasya putrā vidrumatejasaḥ | triśikhā vā tribhāgā vā ṣaṣṭir ity uttare pathi ||
body.translated_text: (AVParis 52.3.2) The <s>Kauṅkuma</s>s (saffron-hued), offspring of <s>Lohitāṅga</s> (Mars, the Red-Limbed one), with coral-like radiance, with three crests or three parts — sixty, in the northern path.

body.text: (AVParis_52,3.3) nānādhūmanibhā rūkṣā dhūmavyākularaśmayaḥ | śatam ekādhikaṃ mṛtyoḥ putrāḥ syur dhūmaketavaḥ ||
